articles.title: Micro-Edits: Computational Support for Fine-Scale Edits in Film
articles.content: In film editing, every frame matters. While macro, content-level edits shape the high-level narrative of a film, small local edits often control timing and direct visual attention. For example, editors can adjust the precise timing of clips to control the length of a meaningful silence, or cut to shots that highlight a specific character's reactions to important moments. These small, detailed edits are slow and tedious to make in standard editing tools because users have to map high-level narrative goals to low-level frame-by-frame adjustments. At the same time, these fine-scale adjustments, which we call micro-edits, can be nuanced and expressive, with different choices serving different creative goals. In this work, we start by conducting a formative study with professional editors to understand the structure of micro-edits and how they are used. We then derive a mathematical formalization for this structure to develop tools that leverage AI and optimization to make exploring micro-edits simpler and more efficient for users. Finally, we validate our tools in multiple user studies and a wide range of video examples.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 微编辑:对电影中精细版的计算支持
articles.content_zh: 在电影编辑中,每个帧都很重要. 虽然宏观,内容层面的编辑会塑造出一部电影的高层次叙事,但小的局部编辑往往会控制时间,并引导视觉关注. 例如,编辑可以调整剪辑的准确时间来控制有意义的沉默的长度,或者剪接到突出特定人物对重要时刻的反应的镜头. 这些小而详细的编辑方式在标准编辑工具中是缓慢而乏味的,因为用户必须将高层次的叙事目标映射到低层次的逐帧调整. 同时,这些细微的尺度调整,我们称之为"微版",可以细微而有表现力,不同的选择服务于不同的创造性目标. 在这部作品中,我们首先与专业编辑进行成形研究,以了解微编辑的结构以及如何使用. 然后我们为这个结构得出一个数学形式化,以开发出能利用AI和优化的工具来使探索微编辑器对用户更加简单和高效. 最后,我们在多个用户研究和各种视频实例中验证我们的工具。

articles.title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
articles.content:
The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce the reported gains, but show that they do not require this geometric explanation. Perturbing a single decoder block already recovers much of the improvement, while keeping the model entirely frozen and adding a random bias to its output logits matches or exceeds full-weight perturbations on most reasoning tasks. This suggests an alternative explanation based on output diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. We formalize this view as Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV), a general procedure that generates perturbed predictors, selects high-performing members on a small validation set, and aggregates their predictions.
  This interpretation connects Neural Thickets to established inference-time methods, including sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. A first-order analysis further shows that small weight perturbations act primarily through their induced logit shifts. We extend this analysis to vision, where logit PSV substantially improves performance under domain shift, including on Earth observation, while full-weight perturbations provide little additional benefit. Together, these results suggest that the gains attributed to nearby weight-space experts can instead be obtained through output diversity, selection, and voting. Logit PSV realizes these benefits with a fully frozen model, providing a simple, training-free alternative to full-weight perturbation ensembles across language and vision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重新思考无重压神经细胞
articles.content_zh:
神经病假说认为,预先训练的语言模型位于任务特定专家在重量空间的密集街区,随机的高斯人扰动可以发现. 我们重复所报告的进展,但表明它们不需要这种几何解释。 扰动单个解码器块已经恢复了大部分改进,同时保持了模型完全被冷冻并在其输出对数中添加了随机偏差相匹配或超过大多数推理任务的全重扰动. 这表明基于产出多样性、基于验证的选择和表决的另一种解释。 我们将此观点正式化为"Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV)"(Persturb-Select-Vote (PSV)),这是一种一般程序,它产生被扰动的预测器,在小型验证组上选择高性能的成员,并汇总他们的预测.
这种解释将神经发作与既定的推论时间方法相连接,包括采样,自相容性,以及验证器-导取. 一阶分析进一步表明,小重量扰动主要通过它们诱发的对数变化来作用. 我们把这一分析扩大到远景,在目测PSV中,在包括地球观测在内的域位转移下,其性能大有改进,而全重扰动则几乎没有带来额外好处。 这些结果加在一起表明,通过产出多样性、选择和表决,可以取得由附近加权空间专家获得的收益。 Logit PSV以完全被冻结的模式实现这些好处,提供了一种简单、无培训的替代语言和视觉全重扰动综艺。

articles.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
articles.content: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 读取、 分配、 路由: 像素- 空间基因变换器角色关联调试
articles.content_zh: 像素空间基因 变形器通常每个图像补丁都使用一款令牌,因此捕捉更细细的细节需要更多的使使全球注意力越来越昂贵. 我们注意到,更细化的细节并不一定需要更多的全球交流:低频结构得益于全球交流,而高频的细节可以在当地建模. 基于这种洞察力,我们引入了 SpecSlot,一个像素-空间修正-流量变换器,它将输出细节与全球关注序列的长度脱钩. 光谱 槽将每个空间锚地扩展为多个槽,每个槽都指定了DCT系数的脱联带;这将锚地密度与光谱分解区分开来. 只有来自每个主播的最低频段参与全球关注,而所有频段都在当地互动. 这使得模型可以在不扩大全球序列的情况下增加光谱细节. 空间头进一步为光谱预测增加了局部校正,而基因状态,目标,和丢失则仍然停留在像素空间. 在ImageNet-256上,SpecSlot实现了可比较的最终FID到FLOPs相配的JiT控制,同时更快地聚合. 在ImageNet-512上,它比控制改进了2.84,减少了3.9%的FLOP,并且仅以38.2%的低成本进入了JiT-B/16的0.69FID. 在文本到图像生成上,SpecSlot在DPG-Bench上以40.6%的远期成本以1.06的比分超越了JiT-B/8.

articles.title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
articles.content: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery). It enables the association of observations of the same luggage across disjoint camera views in complex environments such as airports, train stations and border crossing. While existing approaches primarily focus on appearance-based cropped image matching under relatively clean conditions, real-world scenarios are characterized by frequent occlusions, cluttered background and crowded scenes which significantly degrade performance. Yet, strategies leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views from different video streams is overlooked. In this paper, we study strategies for an end-to-end pipeline that operates from multiple video streams to detect and re-identify luggage. We evaluate different variants on a benchmark dataset acquired in real-world environments to address the questions of selecting and merging different views and shots of the same luggage as well as training on different environment datasets for an overall ReID performance improvement in practical applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 行李重新识别: 现实世界应用战略研究
articles.content_zh: 行李再识别(ReID)是影像监控中的一项关键任务,用于鉴证,安全或边境管理(可疑或被抛弃的行李识别),以及行李管理(丢失的行李回收). 它使得同一行李的观察能够通过在机场、火车站和过境点等复杂环境中的不相干相机观察。 虽然现有方法主要侧重于在相对清洁的条件下以外观为主的收成图像匹配,但现实世界情景的特点是经常被遮住、背景杂乱和场景拥挤,严重降低性能。 然而,利用来自不同视频流的多镜头和观点的互补性的战略被忽略了。 在本文中,我们研究一个从多条视频流运行的端到端管道的战略来检测并重新识别行李. 我们评价在现实世界环境中获得的基准数据集上的不同变体,以解决选择和合并同一行李的不同观点和镜头的问题,以及对不同环境数据集的培训,以便在实际应用中全面改进ReID性能。

articles.title: SonoWorld4D: From One Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization
articles.content: Recent progress in visual scene generation has extended beyond static 3D scenes toward the more challenging problem of generating dynamic 4D scenes from minimal input. However, sound, despite being intrinsically coupled with dynamic objects and events, remains largely unmodeled in prior work. We introduce Video-to-4DAVScene, a new task that turns a video into an explorable, time-varying 4D audio-visual scene, and present the SonoWorld4D framework for this task. Given a monocular video, our method generates a 360 static background, reconstructs explicit motion trajectories of dynamic, sound-emitting foreground objects, and synthesizes a physically-grounded sound field consistent across multiple sources through dual-space audio diffusion synchronization. The resulting 4D scene supports real-time novel-view visual and spatial audio rendering. Evaluation on real-world dynamic scenes and a user study demonstrates SonoWorld4D generates 4D audio-visual scenes with perceptually realistic, physically grounded spatial audio consistent with scene geometry and visual content.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SonoWorld4D:通过传播同步从一款视频到一款4D视听相机
articles.content_zh: 视觉场景生成的近期进展已经超越了静态3D场景,而到了从最小输入生成动态4D场景这一更具挑战性的问题. 然而,虽然声音与动态物体和事件有着内在的结合,但在以前的作品中仍然基本上没有模型化. 我们引入了Video-to-4DAVScene,这个新任务将一个视频变成一个可扩展的,有时间变化的4D视听场景,并且为这个任务呈现出SonoWorld4D的框架. 鉴于一个单相相相片,我们的方法产生了360个静态背景,重建了动态,发声前地物体的明显运动轨迹,并通过双相空间音频传播同步,合成了多个来源相容的物理地基音场. 由此产生的4D场景支持实时小说视觉和空间音频渲染. 对现实世界动态场景的评价和用户的研究表明,SonoWorld4D生成的4D视听场景具有与场景几何和视觉内容相符合的感知现实性,实体化的空间音频.

articles.title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
articles.content: An observer sees only part of the surrounding world, yet must keep track of what lies beyond the current view. Spatial perception therefore involves more than recognizing individual images: it calls for a persistent spatial state that is updated under self-motion and used to guide action. Do visual foundation models provide representations that support such a state? We study this question through four levels of spatial capability---spatial structure, object persistence, predictive spatial update, and actionability---using frozen-feature probes on ten representations under streaming egocentric observations of static indoor environments. The resulting capability profiles vary across tasks, network layers, and prefix lengths: strong readout of the visible scene does not ensure accurate object persistence or future-feature retrieval. Matched controls separate readout accuracy from reliance on visual history and motion. Native future prediction retains recoverable spatial structure, but a spatial reader trained on real features does not transfer to predicted features unchanged. Finally, goal-dependent candidate selection does not establish reliable continuous action utility: predicted actions respond to goal changes, yet supplying the correct goal does not reliably improve progress. Across the four levels, object persistence and actionability build on camera-pose readout, whereas feature prediction builds on visible-scene readout. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial representations not only by what can be decoded from them, but by whether that information is maintained beyond observation, updated predictively, and used for goal-directed action.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 探索视觉基金会模型中的空间国家代表
articles.content_zh: 观察者只看到周围世界的一部分,但必须跟踪当前观点以外的事物。 因此,空间感知不仅仅涉及识别个人图像:它要求有一个持续的空间状态,在自動下被更新并被用来指导行动. 视觉基础模型是否提供支持这种状态的表示? 我们通过空间能力的四级研究这个问题 -- -- 空间结构、物体的持久性、预测性空间更新,以及可操作性 -- -- 使用冷冻地层探测器,在静态室内环境的流出自负式观测下进行十种表达。 由此而来的能力剖面因任务,网络层,和前缀长度的不同而有差异:显相场景的强烈读出并不能确保准确的对象持续或未来地貌检索. 相匹配的控制将读出精度与依赖视觉历史和运动分开. 本地未来预测保留了可回收的空间结构,但受过实际特征培训的空间读取器不会向预测的地物转移而不变. 最后,依赖目标的候选人选择没有建立可靠的连续行动效用:预测的行动响应目标的变化,但提供正确的目标并不能可靠地改善进展. 在整个四个层面,物体的持久性和可操作性建立在相机上的读取基础上,而特征预测则建立在可视场的读取之上。 这些结果加在一起,不仅促使对空间表示进行评价,而且促使评价可以从空间表示中解码哪些信息,以及这种信息是否维持在观察之外、进行预测更新并用于目标行动。

articles.title: SymAnt: Grounding Long-Horizon Action Anticipation with Adaptable Symbolic Priors
articles.content: As robots and intelligent systems increasingly interact with humans, they must anticipate long sequences of future actions from only brief observations. While purely neural models typically require extensive observations to predict future actions and remain difficult to interpret and adjust, symbolic priors offer a structured alternative. To this end, we introduce SymAnt, a novel neuro-symbolic approach that unifies the expressiveness of neural networks with the structured reasoning of scene and knowledge graphs. Given a short video, SymAnt performs a joint-search over both graphs to construct a symbolic context, enabling unified reasoning over spatial relationships, object attributes, affordances, and associated actions. This symbolic context serves as a prior for an iterative refinement process that progressively generates and improves the sequence of future actions. By grounding predictions in symbolic context, SymAnt anticipates long-horizon actions from short observation windows in a parameter-efficient manner, while enabling users to directly edit the underlying knowledge to adjust predictions without further training. Through our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of SymAnt, particularly when only short observation contexts are available, across five diverse datasets: Breakfast, 50 Salads, EPIC-KITCHENS, EGTEA Gaze+, and Assembly101.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SymAnt:用可适应的符号前传设定长视距行动定位
articles.content_zh: 随着机器人和智能系统越来越多地与人类互动,它们必须只从短暂的观测中预想出未来行动的长序. 虽然纯粹的神经模型通常需要广泛的观测来预测未来的行动,并且仍然难以解释和调整,但象征性的前科提供了一个结构化的替代品. 为此,我们引入了"SymAnt"(SymAnt),这是一种用场景和知识图的结构推理来统一神经网络的表达力的新型神经-同义方法. 由于视频很短,SymAnt对两个图表进行联合搜索,以构建一个象征性的上下文,从而能够就空间关系、物体属性、负担和相关行动进行统一推理。 这种象征性的背景是反复改进过程的前奏,逐步产生和改进未来行动的顺序。 SymAnt通过将预测定位在象征性的上下文中,以参数高效的方式从短观测窗口中预测出长视距行动,同时使用户能够直接编辑基础知识来调整预测,而无需进一步训练. 通过我们的实验,我们展示了SymAnt的有效性,特别是在只有短期观测的情况下,它涉及五个不同的数据集: 早餐、50个沙拉、EPIC-KITCHEN、EGTEA Gaze+和Assembly101。

articles.title: Difficulty Calibration Across Time for Membership Inference in Diffusion Models
articles.content: Modern diffusion models are trained on massive datasets that often include copyrighted or private images. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) address this by testing whether a given image was in a model's training set. The standard approach scores an image by its reconstruction loss and flags low-loss images as members. This often fails because some images are simply easier to reconstruct than others, so a simple unseen image can score a lower loss than a complex training image. Difficulty calibration separates memorization from how difficult an image is to begin with. We show how to calibrate along two axes of time: training time and diffusion time. First, across training time, we introduce Reference-Model Calibration (RMC), which compares a fine-tuned model's loss against an earlier checkpoint. This cleanly isolates newly memorized data and gives near-perfect auditing, even without text captions. Since earlier checkpoints are not always available, we next present Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC), which calibrates across diffusion time using only a single model. Our key observation is that an image's difficulty persists across noise levels, whereas memorization is localized in time. By comparing the loss at a target timestep against neighboring timesteps from the same model, TSC attenuates image difficulty using the model's own trajectory. Empirically, our methods beat the state of the art by a wide margin, and unlike most existing attacks, generalize across different model parameterizations such as $x$-, $v$-, and $ε$-prediction models. Code is available at https://github.com/MichaelJoseph777/TSC.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 成员在扩散模型中的推论的难度
articles.content_zh: 现代的传播模型在大型数据集上接受培训,这些数据集往往包括有版权的或私人的图像. 会员推论攻击(MIAs)通过测试一个给定的图像是否在模型的训练集中来解决这个问题. 标准方法通过重建损失和标出低损失图像作为成员来评分. 这往往因为有些图像比其他图像简单更容易重建而失败,所以一个简单的隐形图像可以比复杂的训练图像得到更低的得分. 难以校正的校正将记忆与图像开始的难度区分开来. 我们示范如何按照两个时间轴进行校正:培训时间和传播时间。 首先,在整个培训期间,我们采用参考模型校正(RMC),将一个经过微调的模型的损失与一个较早的检查站进行比较。 这样干净地将新记忆的数据隔离开来,并给予近乎完美的审计,即使没有文本标题. 由于以往的检查站并非总有,我们接下来是临时自我解析(TSC),在扩散期间只使用单一模式校正。 我们的主要观察是,图像的难度在噪声水平之间持续存在,而记忆则是及时本地化的. 通过将目标时间步上的损失与相邻时间步上相同的模型进行比较,TSC利用模型自己的轨迹来减轻图像难度. 从经验上看,我们的方法以相去甚远的距离击败了最先进的技术,并且与大多数现有的攻击不同,概括了不同的模型参数,比如$x-,$v-,和$$-预测模型. 代码见https://github.com/MichaelJoseph777/TSC.

articles.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
articles.content: Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on either temporal context or explicit 3D memory, both of which scale poorly because memory grows with the length of the generated stream. Moreover, explicit 3D memories condition latent video generators by re-encoding RGB renderings, which precludes real-time generation. In this paper, we introduce a Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G) that combines the efficiency of feed-forward reconstruction with a compact, rapidly renderable scene representation. Building on this memory, we propose L3G-World, in which a memory updater and a video diffusion transformer (DiT) alternate autoregressively to generate spatially consistent worlds. The memory updater spawns Gaussians in newly observed regions and refines existing ones, so that the memory grows with scene extent rather than stream length. Each Gaussian further stores a VAE latent feature, allowing the memory to be rendered directly into the DiT's latent space without VAE re-encoding. Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and long-horizon spatial consistency, with up to $38.6\times$ fewer 3D primitives, $3.2\times$ faster memory updates, and $359\times$ faster memory rendering relative to the most efficient prior 3D-memory baseline for each metric, enabling real-time world generation at 9 FPS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: L3G- 世界: 具有Latent 3D高斯记忆的实时无限世界代
articles.content_zh: 互动的世界模型产生以用户行动为条件的可视内容,但实时在长视距探索中保持空间一致性仍然具有挑战性。 现有方法依赖时间上下文或明确的3D内存,两者的尺度都很差,因为内存随着所生成流的长度而增长. 此外,清晰的3D记忆通过重新编码RGB渲染来给潜伏的视频生成器附加条件,这排除了实时生成. 在本文中,我们引入了Latent 3D高斯记忆(L3G),它结合了向导重建的效率与紧凑,可快速渲染的场景表现. 基于这种记忆,我们提出L3G-World,其中内存更新器和视频扩散变压器(DIT)可自动递归来生成空间相容的世界. 内存更新器在新观测到的地区培育出高斯人并完善了已存在的地区,使内存随着场景范围而不是流长而增长. 每个高斯人还进一步存储了VAE潜伏特性,使得内存可以在没有VAE再编码的情况下被直接渲染入DiT潜伏空间. 实验显示,L3G-World实现了最先进的生成质量和长相空间相容性,最多能减少38.6\times的3D原始人, 3.2\times的内存更新速度快,359\times的内存渲染速度快于每公尺前最高效的3D-相模基线,能以9FPS的速度实现实时世界相容.

articles.title: Fight World Model: Customizable Combat through Visual Interaction Proxies
articles.content: A playable, programmable game world must maintain persistent state, enforce executable rules, and support extensible gameplay mechanics. Existing video world models can generate plausible combat, yet struggle to keep hit reactions and health updates consistent with game rules. We introduce Fight World Model (FWM), which separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering. An executable engine maintains state and resolves interactions. A deterministic compiler encodes these outcomes and attempted actions in a spatially and temporally aligned interaction proxy. The proxy aligns action and skill windows, brief hit reactions, and persistent health by fighter identity and timing. These cues can be controlled separately to render interactions under modified rules. Identity-bound references preserve character appearance across side switches. We train FWM on FightWorld Corpus, spanning 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas. Without retraining the renderer, FWM supports damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, lifesteal, and multi-stage skill mechanisms beyond the native game. It also allows character and arena customization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FWM, which outperforms existing game world models in action fidelity, hit reactions, health-state consistency, and character appearance preservation. Our project is available at https://fight-world-model.github.io.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 战斗世界模式: 通过视觉互动的自定义战斗
articles.content_zh: 一个可播放,可编程的游戏世界必须保持持续状态,执行可执行规则,并支持可扩展的游戏玩法力学. 现有的影视世界模型可以产生可信的战斗,但为了保持打击反应和健康更新符合游戏规则而奋斗. 我们引入了"战斗世界模型"(Fight World Model (FWM)),它将统治的战斗处决与视频渲染区分开来. 可执行引擎保持状态并解决相互作用. 一个决定性的编译器将这些结果编码,并试图在一个空间和时间对齐的交互代理中进行动作. 代理机将动作和技巧窗口,短暂的命中反应,以及由战斗机身份和时间造成的持续健康. 这些提示可被单独控制,以根据被修改的规则进行交互. 带有身份的参考文献保存了侧开关之间的字符外观。 我们在FightWorld Corpus上训练FWM, 包括52个技能效果,187个人物出场变体和15个竞技场. FWM在不再培训出产者的情况下,支持损害缩放,受限的免疫,活体,以及超越本土游戏的多阶段技能机制. 它还允许人物和竞技场定制. 实验演示了FWM的功效,在动作忠贞性,命中反应,健康状态一致性,以及人物外观保存方面,它比现有的游戏世界模型表现得更好. 我们的项目可查阅https://fight-world-model.github.io。

articles.title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
articles.content: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or a single fused mesh, while CHARM, the only generator of stylized hair cards, decodes a hairstyle autoregressively as a long sequence of control points. Observing that a card hairstyle is an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, we propose HairDeck, which generates it as one: each card is a single token, and a set diffusion transformer denoises all cards together. From a single image, HairDeck generates the cards and the spring-bone chains that drive them, yielding an animatable asset that exports to ready-to-use downstream formats. On CHARM's own test set, it lowers Chamfer distance by 44% and card-orientation error by more than half while running 33 times faster, and from single images it outperforms CHARM, image-to-3D pipelines and strand-based methods. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/HairDeck
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HairDeck:动画-从单一图像中提取的静态发卡
articles.content_zh: 游戏和相声中花纹化人物的发型由发卡来构建:艺术家-被放置的丝带,其几何是可见发型,由春骨作动画. 现有的以影像为基础的方法产生出现实的发型或单一的有丝网状的发型,而CHARM作为分型发卡的唯一生成者,会自发地解码出发型,作为长序的控制点. 观察到一卡通发型是一组无序由艺术家定义的原始人,我们提出"海尔德克"(HairDeck),将它产生为一卡通:每张卡是单一的代币,而一卡通扩散变压器则将所有卡通都一起取出. HairDeck从一幅相片中生成出卡和驱动出卡的弹簧骨链,从而产生出一个向现成使用下游格式输出的可想象资产. 在CHARM自己的测试设定上,它将Chamfer距离降低了44%,卡向误差在运行快33倍时降低了一半以上,从单个图像来看,它的表现超过了CHARM,图像到到到3D的管道和线程方法. 项目网页:https://hyz cluster.github.io/HairDeck

articles.title: Beyond Ground Truth: A Heuristic Unsupervised Quality Assurance Engine for Diagnosing Calibrational Blindness in Dental Segmentation
articles.content: In real-world clinical settings, dental X-ray segmentation using deep learning methods suffers from reliability issues. Even when the segmentation quality is bad, deep learning models show high confidence in their predictions (calibrational blindness). Moreover, in real use, doctors do not have ground-truth masks to check their accuracy. To address this problem, we introduce a simple quality-checking engine called HUS-QA with three stages. We train it on the PRAD (Periapical Dental X-ray) dataset to build our SimCLR self-supervised ResNet-18 U-Net model, which generates the segmentation mask and then evaluates its quality. Our HUS-QA checks the segmentation mask quality without a ground-truth mask. Prediction confidence, edge sharpness, shape connectivity, and area-size penalty are the simple indicators considered in this research. Results show that standard confidence methods fail (r = -0.1394, p = 1.7864e-3, ROC AUC = 0.4275). By contrast, our HUS-QA shows a positive correlation with actual Dice scores (r = 0.4647, p = 3.7510e-28) and achieves a strong ROC-AUC of 0.8405. Therefore, HUS-QA serves as a practical tool for clinical quality control.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Ground Truth:用于诊断牙科部位校正失明的无监督高压质量保证引擎
articles.content_zh: 在现实世界的临床环境中,使用深层学习方法进行牙科X射线分解有可靠性问题. 即使分化质量不佳,深层学习模型也表现出对其预测(校正失明)的高度信心. 此外,在实际使用中,医生没有地面真实的口罩来检查其准确性。 为了解决这个问题,我们采用了一个名为HUS-QA的简单质量检查引擎,分三个阶段. 我们在PRAD(Periapical Dental X-ray)数据集上对其进行培训,以构建我们的SimCLR自控的ResNet-18 U-Net模型,该模型生成分解口罩并随后评价其质量. 我们的HUS -QA检查 分解口罩的质量 没有地面真实口罩。 预测性自信,边缘锐度,外形连通性,和面积大小的判罚是本研究中考虑的简单指标. 结果显示,标准置信方法失败(r=-0.1394,p=1.7864e-3,ROC AUC=0.4275)。 相形之下,我们的HUS-QA显示与实际的Dice分数(r = 0.4647,p = 3.7510e-28)呈正相关,并实现了0.8405的ROC-AUC强势. 因此,HUS-QA是临床质量控制的实用工具.

articles.title: RADIOlogy: A Single-Pass Approach to Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Current zero-shot anomaly detection methods often rely on complex prompt-learning techniques or computationally expensive sliding-window strategies to achieve fine-grained visual alignment to detect small-scale anomalies. This reliance stems from the fundamental limitation of standard CLIP architectures, where [CLS] token attention and spatial patch pooling struggle to capture subtle, localized anomaly features. While prompt-learning approaches aim to bridge this gap, they typically require a large number of ground-truth segmentation masks from auxiliary datasets, which are often unavailable in specialized domains. In this work, we show an emerging property of multi-head attention pooling in vision-language models: remarkable zero-shot anomaly localization and detection right out of the box. We translate this property into a single-pass anomaly detection technique, RADIOlogy, that does not require dense, windowed execution and significantly outperforms other training-free baselines. Instead, the method relies on a simple contrastive scoring approach that compares the average similarity between vision features and a suite of normal and abnormal prompts. Furthermore, we leverage the agglomerative features of RADIO models to enhance pixel-level anomaly segmentation using a dense anomaly refinement pipeline. Finally, we show how the vision-language family of training-free zero-shot anomaly detection techniques can be applied successfully to the medical domain with minimal modifications. Code is available at https://github.com/jacomof/RADIOlogy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 放射性:对无培训的零发热异常检测采取单管办法
articles.content_zh: 目前零发异常探测方法往往依靠复杂的即时学习技术或计算昂贵的滑动窗口策略来实现细纹视觉对接以检测出小规模异常. 这种依赖源于标准CLIP架构的根本局限,其中[CLS]表示注意和空间补丁集合斗争,以捕捉微妙,局部的异常特征. 虽然即时学习办法旨在弥合这一差距,但它们通常需要从辅助数据集中取出大量地面-真实分解口罩,而这些口罩往往在专门领域得不到。 在这部作品中,我们展示了在视觉语言模型中集合多头注意力的新兴属性:显著的零发反常局部化和从盒子中检测出. 我们把这个属性转化为一个单行道异常检测技术,即RADIOlogy,它不需要密集而有窗口地执行,并且大大地超过了其他没有训练的基线. 相反,该方法依赖于一种简单的对比分法,比较视觉特征与一组正常和异常的提示之间的平均相似性. 此外,我们利用RADIO模型的凝聚性特性,利用密集的异常改进管来增强像素级异常分化. 最后,我们表明,无训练零发反常检测技术的视觉语系如何能在最小的修改下成功地应用于医疗领域。 代码见https://github.com/jacomof/radiology。

articles.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
articles.content: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VeriCUA:作为计算机使用代理人的代理勘探的核查
articles.content_zh: 跨越桌面、移动和网络环境建立和扩展计算机使用代理,需要对数据整理、评价和强化学习进行可靠的任务完成核查。 典型的自动化方法会促使视觉语言模型(VLMs)来判断轨迹或生成程序来检查应用状态. 然而,两者都依赖于对复杂数字环境的部分观点. VLM法官仅限于提供观察,而生成的程序取决于无障碍状态. 这些意见可能忽略决定性证据,或使完成判决得不到支持。 对不同的平台和访问设置进行单独的核查,增加了进一步的工程成本。 我们介绍VeriCUA,这是一个通过代理人探索进行核查的平台不可知框架。 它将核查视为在跨平台和观测模式的在线和离线设置共同程序范围内的动态证据收集和评估。 在检查可用上下文以构建一个任务标题后,核查者会选择GUI或代码检查未解决的要求,并根据明确的证据规则综合其调查结果. 实验表明,在比较基线的基础上,这些环境的参考标签更加一致,在困难案件中离线收益最大,网上更强烈地拒绝虚假的完成索赔。 进一步的分析将这些成果与补充证据和试验时间探索联系起来。

articles.title: PhysCount: Do MLLMs Count Visual Appearances or Physical Entities?
articles.content: Images reveal appearances, but counting often asks about physical objects. A single entity may be visible directly, in several reflections, or through glass, so detecting every visible occurrence does not determine how many entities are present. Existing visual counting benchmarks rarely separate these two operations. We introduce PhysCount, a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish what appears in an image from what physically exists in the scene. PhysCount contains 546 real-world images and 4,595 human-written questions organized into 651 target-specific groups. For each group, annotators locate the relevant appearances, label how each is observed, and identify appearances of the same entity. Four complementary question families test the enumeration of appearances, the enumeration of physical entities, image-formation-specific counting, and appearance--entity correspondence. We measure both accuracy on each family and the proportion of groups answered entirely correctly. Across 40 MLLMs, counting visible appearances is substantially easier than recovering the identities that connect them. Even the strongest model answers every question correctly in only 13.36\% of groups. Performance declines when one entity produces many appearances or when its appearances cross observation modes. Higher image resolution improves access to visual evidence but brings limited gains in complete-group accuracy, whereas answering related questions jointly produces a marked improvement. These results expose a gap between recognizing what is visible and correctly recovering the physical entities behind those observations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PhysCount: MLLMs 是否计算视觉外观或物理实体?
articles.content_zh: 图像显示出外观,但计数时常会询问物理物体. 一个单一的实体可能直接可见,在几个反射中,或者通过玻璃可以被看见,所以检测出每个可见的发生并不决定有多少实体存在. 现有的可视计数基准很少将这两个业务分开. 我们引入了PhysCount,这是评价多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)是否能够区分图像中出现的东西和现场实际存在的东西的基准. PhysCount包含546个真实世界的图像和4,595个人写问题,被组织成651个目标群体. 对于每一组,注释者确定相关外观的位置,对每个外观进行标记,并标明同一实体的外观。 四个补充问题家庭测试外观的取出,物理实体的取出,图像成形特定取出,外观实体取出. 我们既衡量每个家庭的准确性,又衡量完全正确回答的群体比例。 在40个MLLM中,计算可见外观比恢复连接它们的身份要容易得多。 即使是最强的模型 也只正确回答了13.36分组的每个问题 当一个实体产生出许多外观时或其外观交叉观察模式时,性能会下降. 更高的图像分辨率可以改善视觉证据的获取,但在完整组的准确性方面带来有限的收益,而共同回答相关问题则会产生明显的改善. 这些结果暴露出在识别可见的事物和正确恢复这些观测背后的物理实体之间存在着差距。

articles.title: CrossWeave: Cross-Modal Scene and Instance Retrieval from Sparse 2D-3D Alignment
articles.content: Cross-modal scene and instance retrieval aims to retrieve a corresponding 3D environment or object given query 2D images, serving as a foundational mechanism for spatial reasoning in robotics and AR/VR. Existing methods achieve this by learning alignment only at the level of whole scenes or objects, which provides no supervision for the fine-grained local structure within them. In this work, we show that supervision on a set of sparse 2D-3D correspondences, without scene- or instance-level contrastive objectives, is sufficient to train a single model for both scene- and instance-level retrieval. Specifically, we propose $\textbf{CrossWeave}$, a novel framework for cross-modal retrieval that learns sparse patch-point alignment, which alone outperforms existing methods. An optimal transport-based aggregator over the aligned features gives further gains by clustering structurally redundant regions, freeing descriptor capacity for semantically distinct local features. CrossWeave achieves state-of-the-art performance on both scene- and instance-level retrieval on ScanNet and 3RScan with a $\textit{single model}$, whereas existing methods require separate models for each task. Our results suggest that whole-scene encoding is unnecessary for cross-modal retrieval and that sparse local correspondence supervision is a more effective and flexible alternative.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CrossWeave: 从 Sparse 2D-3D 对齐中获取相模场景和实例
articles.content_zh: 跨模式场景和实例检索旨在取回相应的3D环境或给定的查询2D图像对象,作为机器人和AR/VR空间推理的基础机制. 现有方法通过只学习整个场景或物体的校正来达到这个目的,这种校正无法对内部精细的局部结构进行监督. 在这项工作中,我们显示,对一组稀少的2D-3D通信进行监管,没有场景或实例层面的对比目标,就足以为场景和实例层面的检索培训单一模式。 具体地说,我们提议$\textbf{CrossWeave}$,这是一个跨模式检索的新框架,它学习了稀有的补丁点对接,单靠它就超过了现有的方法。 将结构上多余的区域组合起来,将描述性能力腾出来,以便形成当地特有的特征,从而使基于运输的集聚器相对于对接性特征而言有了进一步的好处。 CrossWeave在ScanNet和3RScan的场景和实例级检索上都实现了最先进的性能,使用$\textit{ single model}$,而现有的方法需要针对每项任务分别使用模型. 我们的结果表明,全场编码对于跨模式检索来说是不必要的,而且很少的当地通信监督是一种更有效和灵活的选择。

articles.title: LucidLyra: Feed-Forward Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction and Joint Understanding via Multi-Task Distillation
articles.content: We present LucidLyra, a framework that makes generatively reconstructed 3D scenes directly queryable for semantics and instances in a feed-forward manner from video latents. While generative 3D reconstruction can synthesize virtual environments from a single image, downstream applications in robotics and physical AI require not only visual realism but also access to scene semantics and object identities. Existing 3D understanding approaches, however, require captured multi-view scenes, have limited generalization capabilities, or rely on expensive per-scene processing and optimization. To bridge this gap, our method distills complementary knowledge from a camera-controlled video diffusion model and frozen 2D vision foundation models into a unified model to jointly infer 3D Gaussians encoding geometry, appearance, open-vocabulary semantics, and class-agnostic instance cues. The resulting scenes support novel-view rendering, open-vocabulary segmentation, and object grouping without per-scene optimization, while training requires neither manual 3D annotations nor captured multi-view data. Our method outperforms baselines combining state-of-the-art 3DGS segmentation approaches with generative 3D scene reconstruction on curated synthetic and real-image-conditioned benchmarks, while preserving reconstruction quality. Furthermore, our latent formulation naturally extends to monocular video, reconstructing structured dynamic 3D scenes across time. By turning renderable but unstructured outputs into queryable 3D worlds, LucidLyra enables downstream applications including 3D scene editing, 3D asset mining, and robotic simulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LucidLyra:通过多任务分解进行3D场景再造和共同理解
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍LucidLyra, 这个框架使基因重建的 三维场景可以直接查询语义学和实例, 虽然基因3D重建可以从单一图像中合成虚拟环境,但下游在机器人和物理AI中的应用不仅需要视觉现实主义,还需要获得场景语义和对象身份. 然而,现有的三维理解方法需要捕捉到多视图场景,具有有限的通俗化能力,或者依赖于昂贵的人均场景处理和优化. 为了弥补这一差距,我们的方法从相机控制的视频传播模型和被冻结的2D视觉基础模型中提炼出互补知识,并形成一个统一的模型,共同推断出3D高斯人编码几何,外观,开口的语义学,以及类不可知实例提示. 由此产生的场景支持小说-视图渲染,开放式-vocabulary分集,以及对象分组而不进行每个场景优化,而训练则既不需要手动3D说明,也不需要抓取多视图数据. 我们的方法超越了将最新技术的3DGS分解方法与基因三维场景重建相结合的基线,同时保持了重建质量。 此外,我们的潜在配方自然延伸至单相机视频,重建结构化的动态立体场景。 LucidLyra通过将可变而无结构的输出转化为可查询的3D世界,实现了下游应用,包括3D场景编辑,3D资产挖掘和机器人模拟.

articles.title: MetaRefine: Score Refinement with Multi-Level Features for Image Assessment
articles.content: An image's original dimensions, aspect ratio, and composition provide important cues that can affect its technical and aesthetic quality. Image assessment methods use resizing, cropping, padding, or patch sampling to accommodate different input sizes. However, these operations can alter or obscure original geometric and compositional cues. Existing assessment models also encode rich multi-level visual evidence that can be further extracted and exploited to improve existing models. This motivates us to combine visual evidence with original-image geometry for score refinement without changing the original scoring pipelines. In this paper, we introduce MetaRefine, a metadata-aware score refinement architecture whose lightweight residual heads predict score corrections from geometry, multi-level visual features, and the frozen model's original score. Across 100 configurations on 21 datasets, MetaRefine improves PLCC in 88 configurations and SRCC in 85, with average relative gains of 7.55% and 7.10%, respectively. It reduces MAE in 90 configurations and RMSE in 89, with average relative reductions of 23.27% and 21.93%, respectively. The median parameter overhead is only 1.11%. MetaRefine can further improve state-of-the-art (SOTA) assessment models on multiple benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MetaRefine: 图像评估多层次特性的分数改进
articles.content_zh: 图像的原始维度,外观比和组成提供了能影响其技术和美学质量的重要提示. 图像评估方法采用再大小、裁剪、粘贴或补丁取样,以容纳不同的输入大小。 然而,这些操作可以改变或模糊原有的几何和构成提示. 现有的评估模型还编码了丰富的多层次视觉证据,可以进一步取出和利用这些证据来改进现有的模型。 这激励了我们结合视觉证据和原作-图像几何来进行分数修饰,而不改变原作分数管. 在本文中,我们介绍了MetaRefine,一种元数据意识分数完善架构,其轻量级剩余头部预测分数从几何,多层次视觉特征,被冻结模型的原始分数中校正. 在21个数据集的100个配置中,MetaRefine在88个配置中改进了PLCC,在85个配置中改进了SRCC,平均相对收益分别为7.55%和7.10%. 它减少了90个配置的MAE和89个RMSE,平均相对减少了23.27%和21.93%. 中位参数间接费用仅为1.11%. MetaRefine可以进一步改进关于多个基准的先进(SOTA)评估模型.

articles.title: AVPS-360: A Spatial Audio-Visual Benchmark for Instance Segmentation and Tracking of Sound-Producing Persons
articles.content: Audio-visual instance segmentation (AVIS) segments and tracks individual sound-producing objects in videos. Existing benchmarks predominantly use monaural audio, which lacks inter-channel cues for spatially distinguishing concurrent sound sources. We introduce AVPS-360 (Audio-Visual Person Segmentation 360), a spatial audio-visual benchmark bridging AVIS and sound event localisation and detection (SELD). Built upon STARSS23, it pairs first-order Ambisonics audio with synchronised 360° video across 230 recordings totalling 10.5 hours. Recordings average 164.0 seconds. The dataset captures intermittent sound production in real-world interactions dominated by speech, alongside laughter, clapping, and footsteps. It provides 31,678 manually reviewed instance masks linked to source identities and sound-event labels. We also present a baseline that integrates spatial audio with visual features for frame-level segmentation and identity association across frames. Experiments on AVPS-360 show that existing AVIS methods struggle with detection and identity association in long recordings with intermittent sound production, while our baseline substantially improves performance in both aspects.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AVPS-360: 声音制作人分门别类和跟踪的空间视听基准
articles.content_zh: 视听实例分块(AVIS)分块,并跟踪视频中单个出声对象. 现有基准主要使用寺院音频,这些音频缺乏在空间上区分并行音源的跨频道提示。 我们引入了AVPS-360(视听人物分块360),这是一个空间视听基准,连接AVIS和声音事件定位和探测。 它建于STARSS23上,用同步360°的视频将一等声波配对为230个录音,共计10.5小时. 记录平均164.0秒. 数据集在以语音为主的现实世界互动中捕捉断断续续的音效制作,并伴有笑声,鼓掌和脚步. 它提供了31 678个人工审查的与源身份和声音事件标签相连接的实例口罩。 我们还提出一个基线,将空间音频与视觉特征相结合,用于帧层分层和跨帧身份关联。 对AVPS-360的实验表明,现有的AVIS方法在长录音中与检测和身份联系,与断断续续的音效制作相冲突,而我们的基线则大大改善了这两个方面的性能。

articles.title: Accurate MRI-free PET Quantification and Reliability Assessment via CT-to-MRI Synthesis and Conformal Prediction
articles.content: Standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) quantification of amyloid PET commonly relies on a subject-specific T1-weighted MRI, yet a usable MRI is not always available. We therefore combined CT-to-MRI synthesis with conformal prediction for MRI-free PET quantification with reliability assessment. A slice-consistent Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model was strengthened with multi-dataset training and data-source conditioning to enrich the anatomical prior learned from MRI, and with expanded multi-slice CT context to exploit the through-plane continuity of subject-specific anatomy in CT. Synthetic MRI was used for FreeSurfer-based anatomical parcellation and PET quantification, while deep-ensemble uncertainty was calibrated with conformal prediction to estimate a plausible range for the corresponding real MRI-based SUVR. On $^{11}$C-PiB PET from OASIS-3, the proposed method achieved the highest synthesis and parcellation fidelity among the compared methods. Mean cortical SUVR from the proposed synthetic MRI agreed closely with the real MRI-based reference (MAE $0.016 \pm 0.015$, Pearson $r = 0.9987$) and yielded the same amyloid-positivity classification as the real MRI in all 87 test subjects at the prespecified cut-off. Conformal prediction achieved empirical coverage close to the prespecified levels, and at 90% target coverage, 85 of 87 subjects had prediction intervals that supported an unambiguous amyloid-positivity decision. Zero-shot evaluation on an independent external cohort showed that the proposed CT-to-MRI model could support PET quantification without retraining, although conformal calibration required target-cohort recalibration to recover the intended coverage. These findings support CT-to-MRI-based MRI-free PET quantification as a promising approach for providing accurate SUVR measurements and an explicit assessment of their reliability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 精确无核磁共振PET 通过CT-MRI综合和正式预测进行定量和可靠性评估
articles.content_zh: 酰胺PET的标准化吸收值比(SUVR)量化通常依赖于一个主题特定的T1加权核磁共振,然而并不总是有可用的核磁共振. 因此,我们将CT到MRI的合成与无核磁共振核磁共振定量的一致预测和可靠性评估结合起来。 通过多数据集培训和数据源调制,强化了切片相容的布朗桥分解模型,以丰富先前从核磁共振中吸取的解剖学知识,并扩展了多切片CT上下文,以利用CT中特定对象解剖学的通过平面连续性. 合成核磁共振用于FreeSurfer基解剖分解和PET分解,而深度不确定性则被校正为符合性的预测,以估计相应的以核磁共振为主的真正SUVR的可视范围。 在OASIS-3的$C-PiB PET上,拟议方法实现了比较方法中最高的合成和分解忠诚度。 提议的合成核磁共振中的平均皮层SUVR与基于核磁共振的实际参考物(MAE 0.016美元\pm 0.015美元,Pearson $r = 0.9987美元)非常一致,并得出了与所有87个试验对象在预先规定的停产时的真正核磁共振相同的酰胺-可视性分类。 正式预测实现了接近预先确定水平的实证覆盖,在目标覆盖率为90%时,87个学科中有85个学科的预测间隔支持了明确无误的酰胺-可感性决定。 对一个独立的外部群体进行的零射出评价表明,拟议的CT-MRI模型可以支持不进行再培训的PET量化,尽管一致性校正需要目标-曲线再校正以恢复预期的覆盖范围。 这些调查结果支持基于CT到MRI的无核磁共振的PET量化,作为提供准确的SUVR测量和明确评估其可靠性的有希望的方法.

articles.title: InfantNet: A Large Scale Dataset for Infant Body Pose and Shape Estimation
articles.content: Infant pose and shape estimation is essential for applications in childcare, developmental monitoring, and medical diagnosis. However, existing methods and datasets are largely designed for adults, and direct transfer to infants fails due to substantial differences in body proportions, articulation limits, and frequent self-occlusion. To address this gap, we introduce InfantNet, the largest real-image infant dataset to date, comprising 108,902 RGB images of infants aged 6-18 months. Each image is annotated with 2D keypoints, and a curated subset of 11,642 images additionally includes 3D pose and shape annotations with full SMIL parameters, verified through multi-view rendering and reprojection-error filtering. We use an iterative annotation pipeline to ensure high fidelity across both 2D and 3D labels. InfantNet establishes a large-scale, comprehensive benchmark for infant 2D keypoint detection and 3D pose-and-shape recovery. Baseline experiments demonstrate that state-of-the-art adult pose estimators do not generalize well to infants, whereas fine-tuning on InfantNet yields a consistent improvement. The gains are even more pronounced for 3D pose and shape estimation, where SMIL-based estimation demonstrates robust performance with accuracy comparable to results reported for SMPL-based models. By releasing the InfantNet dataset and benchmark, we provide a vital resource for advancing infant pose analysis and related healthcare applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: InfanteNet:用于婴儿身体起伏和形状估计的大型数据集
articles.content_zh: 婴儿的姿势和形状估计对于儿童保育、发育监测和医学诊断方面的应用至关重要。 然而,现有的方法和数据集主要是为成年人设计的,由于身体比例、表达限制和经常自我隔离方面的巨大差异,直接向婴儿转移失败。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了InfanteNet,这是迄今为止最大的真实图像婴儿数据集,包含108,902个6至18个月婴儿的RGB图像。 每个图像都以2D键点作注释,由11,642个图像组成的被曲解的子集还包含有全 SMIL 参数的 3D 姿势和形状说明,通过多视图渲染和再投射-error 过滤来验证. 我们使用迭代注解管道,以确保2D和3D标签的高度忠诚。 InfanteNet为婴儿2D键点检测和3D姿势和形状恢复确定了一个大规模、全面的基准。 基线实验表明,最先进的成年人构成的估算器对婴儿并不普遍,而对InfantNet的微调则带来持续改善。 立体模型和形状估计的增益更为明显,其中基于SMIL的估算显示,与基于SMPL的模型报告的结果相比,性能强劲,准确性可观。 通过发布InfantNet的数据集和基准,我们为推进婴儿姿势分析和相关的保健应用提供了重要资源。

articles.title: A Unified Benchmark for Aerial-Enhanced Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Aerial Dataset
articles.content: Aerial imagery provides complementary spatial context for autonomous driving by exposing road structure beyond the immediate perception range of onboard sensors. Yet map construction from aerial imagery, aerial-assisted online HD mapping, and cross-view localization are typically studied on separate data and benchmarks. We introduce KITScenes Aerial, an extension of the KITScenes Multimodal dataset that augments synchronized onboard sensor data, vehicle poses, and rich Lanelet2 map annotations with spatially associated aerial imagery and higher-resolution neural representations, providing a common basis for a variety of research tasks. Our mapping evaluation focuses on all 53 KITScenes map classes across different model designs, spatial ranges, and aerial resolutions, while retaining compatibility with the widely used three-class setting. Representative baselines show that aerial context is particularly beneficial for fine-grained and extended-range mapping, more than doubling 53-class mAP at the larger mapping extent. Higher-resolution aerial imagery yields a further 4.3 mAP (+24 %) improvement, with gains extending to challenging map elements such as traffic lights. We additionally evaluate cross-view localization under geographically disjoint conditions, where an adapted fine-grained feature-matching baseline achieves a mean translation error of 5.13 m. KITScenes Aerial thus enables unified study of aerial and ground-level information across complementary mapping and localization tasks. Project page: https://kitscenes.com/aerial
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 空中增强自主驾驶的统一基准:KITScenes 空中数据集
articles.content_zh: 空中图像通过暴露超出机上传感器即时感知范围的道路结构,为自主驾驶提供了互补的空间环境. 然而,从航空图象、空中协助的在线HD绘图和横视本地化中绘制的地图,一般都是根据单独的数据和基准加以研究的。 我们介绍了KITScenes Air,这是KITScenes多式联运数据集的延伸,该数据集增加了船上的同步传感器数据、车辆外观以及丰富的Lanelet2地图说明,并附有空间相关航空图像和高分辨率神经表达,为各种研究任务提供了共同的基础。 我们的绘图评价侧重于所有53个KITScenes地图类别,涵盖不同的模型设计、空间范围以及航空分辨率,同时保持与广泛使用的三等相兼容。 具有代表性的基线表明,空中环境对精细和扩展的测绘特别有利,在更大的测绘范围内,比53级的多一倍多。 高分辨率的航空图象进一步提高了4.3mAP(+24%),收益扩大到交通灯等具有挑战性的地图要素。 我们还在地理上不相连的条件下对交叉视图本地化进行了评价,在这种条件下,经过调整的精细的特征比对基线可以实现5.13米的平均翻译误差。 因此,KITScenes Air能够统一研究空中和地上信息,以完成互补的测绘和本地化任务。 项目网页:https://kitscenes.com/aerial

articles.title: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
articles.content: We present PhysInsert, a framework for physically plausible reference-based object insertion that jointly adapts objects and their surrounding scenes. Existing methods often rely on masked inputs, generation-based pairs, or training pairs with limited viewpoint variation, leaving pose and illumination adaptation and bidirectional object-scene interactions insufficiently constrained. We construct the Insert World dataset with strictly aligned Blender-rendered counterfactual pairs and object references across viewpoints and lighting conditions. Building on these data, Geometry-Guided Adaptation couples a VGGT geometry stream with image and text streams under target-scene feature supervision to guide spatially consistent insertion. Complementary 2D Object-Scene Spatial Supervision jointly supervises object occupancy and environmental changes while grounding spatial instructions in object regions through image-text attention. We introduce PhysInsert-Bench with dedicated cross-environment and cross-view cases requiring illumination and pose adaptation beyond appearance copying. Experiments on PhysInsert-Bench and DreamBooth demonstrate improved image fidelity; a user study further shows more accurate placement and improved lighting integration, perspective, and pose plausibility.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 物理内置: 物理外置对象插入有几何前缀和双向对象-场面相互作用
articles.content_zh: 我们提出物理Insert,这是物理上可行的基于参考对象插入的框架,它共同适应物体及其周围场景。 现有方法往往依赖遮掩输入、基于生成的对等或视差有限的培训对等,使姿势和光线适应以及双向物体-场面相互作用受到的限制不够。 我们用严格对齐的Blender反事实对和对象参考来构建“插入世界”数据集。 在这些数据的基础上,几何指南适应夫妇在目标场景的监督下,用一股有图像和文字流的VGGT几何流来指导空间相容的插入。 补充的2D对象-场景空间监督联合监督物体占用和环境变化,同时通过图像-文字关注在物体区域进行空间指令的地面. 我们介绍PhysInsert-Bench, 包含专门的跨环境和交叉视图案例, 需要发光, 并做出超出外观复制的适应。 关于PhysInsert-Bench和DreamBooth的实验显示图像忠贞性得到提高;一项用户研究进一步显示更准确的放置并改进了照明的融合,视角,并提出了可信度.

articles.title: Soil Moisture Estimation in Precision Agriculture: A Knowledge Distillation Approach
articles.content: Accurate soil moisture estimation is critical for precision agriculture, influencing irrigation, fertilization, and harvesting strategies. Traditional methods primarily rely on meteorological and soil property data, while recent approaches incorporate visual modalities such as aerial and geospatial imagery. However, these high-resolution images are expensive and computationally demanding to analyze. In this work, we propose Soil Moisture Distillation (SMD), a Knowledge Distillation (KD)-based multimodal learning framework that leverages unimodal teachers to enhance multimodal soil moisture estimation. SMD surpasses not only traditional multimodal fusion techniques, including MIS-ME, but also outperforms unimodal models, demonstrating the benefits of guided unimodal knowledge transfer. Additionally, we conduct a comparative analysis of soil patches and crop images, showing that crop images provide superior visual cues, leading to improved prediction accuracy. SMD achieves a 2% improvement in MAPE for soil patches and 1.2% for crops over state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of leveraging both meteorological and visual data through knowledge distillation for enhanced soil moisture forecasting.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 精密度的土壤湿度估计 农业:知识消沉方法
articles.content_zh: 准确的土壤湿度估计对于精确的农业、影响灌溉、受精和收割战略至关重要。 传统方法主要依靠气象和土壤财产数据,而最近的方法包括空中和地理空间图像等视觉模式。 然而,这些高分辨率的图像昂贵,在计算上要求进行分析. 在这项工作中,我们提出土壤湿度稀释(SMD),这是一个基于知识稀释(KD)的多模式学习框架,利用单模式教师加强多模式土壤湿度估计。 SMD不仅超越了传统的多模式聚变技术,包括MIS-ME,而且还超越了单模式模式,显示了指导性单模式知识转让的好处。 此外,我们对土壤补丁和作物图像进行了比较分析,显示作物图像提供了更好的视觉提示,从而提高了预测的准确性。 SMD使土壤补丁的MAPE和作物的MAPE分别比最新基线提高2%和1.2%,突出了通过知识分馏利用气象和视觉数据促进土壤湿度预报的有效性。

articles.title: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
articles.content: Semiconductor manufacturing is a complex, multi-step process that requires both high precision and low operating costs. Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production. However, most state-of-the-art deep learning approaches require a full scan of the surface, which hinders the development of high-throughput inspection systems. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis (UFLD), a novel algorithm that employs reinforcement learning for adaptive measurement acquisition and provides a prediction uncertainty level after each step, stopping the process once sufficient information is obtained. Unlike existing methods that rely on ensemble models or auxiliary confidence estimation deep learning models, UFLD utilizes a more parameter-efficient conformal prediction framework to determine the optimal stopping time. The proposed UFLD reduces acquisition time by about $40\%$ and achieves $98.4\%$ inspection accuracy, without requiring an additional learned confidence-estimation network. We validated our approach on the MixedWM38 dataset, demonstrating its advantages over existing adaptive acquisition procedures and standard convolutional neural networks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不确定的反馈循环诊断:将强化学习和一致性预测结合起来,以便进行可靠的瓦费尔缺陷分类
articles.content_zh: 半导体制造是一个复杂多步骤的过程,需要高精度和低操作成本. 因此,在高容量环境中发现缺陷是用于可靠生产的瓦费尔地图分析的重要组成部分。 然而,大多数最先进的深层学习方法都需要对地表进行全面扫描,这阻碍了高通量检查系统的发展. 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用不确定的反馈循环诊断(UFLD),这是一种新颖的算法,利用强化学习来获取适应性测量,并在每一步骤之后提供预测的不确定性水平,一旦获得充分的信息就停止这一过程。 与依赖于综艺模型或辅助置信估计深层学习模型的现有方法不同,UFLD使用一个更具有参数效率的相容性预测框架来确定最优的停止时间. 拟议的UFLD将采购时间缩短了约40美元并实现了98.4美元检查精度,而不需要额外的有学识的信任估计网络. 我们验证了我们在MixedWM38数据集上的方法,显示出它比现有的适应性获取程序和标准进化神经网络有优势.

articles.title: Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
articles.content: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 持续行动世界模式:学习跨时间动态
articles.content_zh: 我们采用了连续行动世界模型,这是一个学习跨表现的动态学前述学的框架,支持机器人在各种表现和执行频率上产生行动。 其核心是一个共享的潜在函数空间,能捕捉机器人动作的空间和时间结构. 我们通过两个阶段学习这个空间. 首先,功能前培训将不同表现和取样频率的轨迹纳入共同的表述,通过行动重建以及时间抽样观点的一致性来学习共同的动态前奏。 这一阶段通过容纳不同的机器人轨道,扩大了可用于预训的数据来源范围,并便利了向更大和更多样化的数据集的扩展。 其次,我们把预先训练的功能空间与世界模型主干网连接起来,使观测,语言指令,以及目前的机器人状态能够对潜在动作功能的预测条件化. 单个解码器需要任何查询时间并返回相应的终端效应动作. 通过将共享的动态前兆与任务条件行动选择和时间抽样区分开来,我们的方法为将机器人经验跨出变相和控制频率提供了一个统一的基础。

articles.title: HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HIFOR:以行动指导的世界展望-语言-行动模式进行分级展望
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言-行动(VLA)模型通过融合视觉感知,语言理解和动作生成,在机器人操纵方面展现出充满希望的能力. 最近的进展进一步纳入了未来的预测,以增进对环境动态和任务进展的理解。 然而,现有方法往往将短期动态和长期任务目标分别建模,同时将预测的未来直接纳入行动政策,而没有充分考虑到它们与当前行动要求的相关性。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议以行动指导世界检索为主的等级展望框架HIFOR。 具体来说,分级前瞻预测联合预测短期状态演化,语义里程碑,最终目标通过分级依赖性面具(HDM)来说明,建立跨时界的依赖性. 基于这些预测,结构-有意识的Latent World Modeling沿着地平线、视野和空间维度组织未来的潜在表述,以方便精细的检索。 此外, " 以行动为指针 " 的 " 因素世界检索 " 适应性地从结构化的潜在世界中取回相关未来信息,其依据是在解密期间不断变化的行动表述,为产生行动提供有针对性的指导。 两项模拟基准和六项现实世界机器人操纵任务的广泛实验,显示了我们的方法的有效性。

articles.title: Wizard: Manipulate Any World in Real Time via Agentic Control
articles.content: Recent advances in video world models have enabled the generation of increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. Agentic frameworks further advance this direction by decoupling explicit game logic and controllable world representations from visual generation. However, existing approaches support only simple game settings and predefined motion patterns, generalize poorly to unseen environments and characters, and offer limited real-time interactivity. In this paper, we introduce Wizard, an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise control over character motions while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions. To achieve this, we construct a diverse dataset spanning 750 scenes and 178 characters, incorporating skeleton and geometry information as structured representations. We leverage these representations as intermediate proxies to condition a video generation model, together with an adaptive masking mechanism that improves alignment between the conditioning signals and generated video rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic framework that explicitly maintains and updates game states, allowing players to freely configure their virtual worlds and exercise fine-grained control over character motions while preserving visual quality and gameplay consistency. By combining agentic control with structured proxy-based generation, our framework unlocks new possibilities for player-driven game creation with real-time, generalizable, and mechanically consistent world simulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 向导: 通过代理控制实时操纵任意世界
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模式的近期进步使得产生越来越现实和互动的虚拟环境成为可能,为玩家定制游戏游戏开辟了新的可能. 代理框架通过将明确的游戏逻辑和可控制的世界表现与视觉一代脱钩来进一步推进这个方向. 然而,现有方法只支持简单的游戏设置和预先定义的运动模式,对看不见的环境和人物的概括性差,提供有限的实时交互. 在本文中,我们介绍了"巫师"(Wizard),这是一个代理游戏世界模式,它能够实时,精确地控制人物动作,同时将零镜头概括到新奇的场景,人物,和行动. 为此,我们构建了一个涵盖750个场景和178个字符的多种数据集,将骨架和几何信息作为结构化的表述。 我们利用这些表示作为中间代词,来附带一个视频生成模型,以及一个适应性的遮罩机制,改善调取信号和产生视频的推出之间的相接性. 此外,我们引入了一种明确维持和更新游戏状态的代理框架,允许玩家自由配置虚拟世界,对角色动作进行精细控制,同时保持视觉质量和游戏播放一致性. 通过将代理控制与结构化的代用生成相结合,我们的框架为玩家驱动的游戏创造提供了新的可能性,具有实时,通俗,机械一致的世界模拟.

articles.title: RFW-A: Agentic Procedural Generation of 400K Articulated Assets over 500 Categories
articles.content: High-quality articulated assets are essential for embodied perception, simulation, and manipulation, yet constructing them at scale remains difficult. Manual annotation and procedural modeling require substantial human effort. Recent agentic systems automate asset construction through program synthesis, but repeat costly reasoning and refinement for every new asset. Our key observation is that assets within a category can share construction logic despite variations in structure and appearance. Agentic synthesis and procedural generation are therefore complementary: agents can construct reusable programs, while procedural execution reuses the resulting logic across many samples. We therefore present RFW-A, which combines the two in a new articulated-asset generation paradigm. Starting from existing articulated programs, RFW-A organizes reusable components and their dependencies into category-level generators. Agents test and refine these generators across sampled configurations and motion states. Once constructed and validated, the generators produce diverse assets through procedural execution with no further model calls or token charges. The estimated API cost of generator authoring averages $10.62, amortizing to $0.05 per asset over 200 assets, versus $1.24 for the sampled per-asset agentic synthesis baseline. Using RFW-A, we built RFW-A-400K, containing over 400K sim-ready articulated assets across more than 500 categories. Experiments show high structural and kinematic validity and stable execution across physics simulators. Beyond asset validity, training with RFW-A-400K improves part-level articulation estimation on seen and unseen categories, while policies trained in simulation with retrieved and program-edited assets transfer zero-shot to real articulated objects.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RFW-A:超过500个类别的400K人工资产的代理程序生成
articles.content_zh: 高质量的明确资产对体现感知、模拟和操纵至关重要,但构建这些资产的规模仍然很困难。 人工注释和程序模型编制需要大量人力努力。 近期的代理系统通过程序合成使资产构建自动化,但重复每个新资产的昂贵推理和完善. 我们的主要看法是,一个类别中的资产尽管结构和外观各有不同,但仍可以分享建筑逻辑。 因此,活性合成和程序生成是互补的:活性剂可以构建可再用的程序,而程序执行则可以在许多样本中再用由此产生的逻辑. 因此,我们提出了RFW-A,它将两者结合起来,形成新的明确资产生成模式。 从现有的明确程序开始,RFW-A组织可再使用组件及其依赖性,形成类别级生成器. 特工测试和完善这些发电机 跨越抽样配置和运动状态。 一旦建造和验证,发电机通过程序执行产生各种资产,不再使用型号呼叫或象征性收费。 生成器的API费用估计数平均为10.62美元,200多件资产每件资产摊销为0.05美元,而每件资产样本合成基线为1.24美元。 利用RFW-A,我们建造了RFW-A-400K,包含超过400K sim-ready的分明资产,涵盖500多个类别。 实验显示在物理模拟器之间结构上和运动上都具有很高的有效性和稳定的执行. 除了资产有效性之外,使用RFW-A-400K的培训还改进了对所见和所不见类别进行部分表述的估计,同时在模拟收回和由程序编辑的资产方面培训的政策将零射入实际明确的目标。

articles.title: Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support
articles.content: Radiological risk stratification and management planning are essential downstream tasks in medical imaging. Automating these tasks is challenging because clinical guideline criteria are distributed across prose, tables, and cross-referenced definitions. We present Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph), a framework that decouples guideline compilation from case evaluation. During compilation, a large language model partitions guidelines into section-based chunks, extracts local decision subgraphs with linked definitions, and aggregates related branches into an executable decision graph. During inference, a fast System One model answers localized clinical questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic, turning opaque single-pass predictions into a traceable decision path without task-specific training. Across 347 cases spanning renal cyst, adnexal mass, and thyroid nodule guidelines, GDGraph improves System One accuracy from 57.3% to 90.8%, outperforming retrieval-augmented GPT-4o (80.1%) and graph-guided GPT-4o with chain-of-thought (82.7%) at substantially lower latency and cost. The source code will be available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 提供高效临床决策支助的参考决定图
articles.content_zh: 辐射风险分层和管理规划是医疗成像中的重要下游任务。 自动化这些任务具有挑战性,因为临床准则标准分布在道词,表和交叉引用的定义之间. 我们提出由准则产生的决定图(GDGraph),这个框架将准则汇编与案例评价脱钩。 在编译过程中,一款大型语言模型将分出准则分入以节为主的块中,取出带有链接定义的本地决定子图,将相干分支汇总成可执行的决定图. 在推论期间,快取系统一号模型解答了局部的临床问题,而决定性的转录解析了布尔逻辑,将不透明的单行道预测转变为可追踪的决定路径而无需接受特定任务的培训. 在涵盖肾囊肿、肾上腺质和甲状腺结核准则的347个病例中,GDGraph改进了System 1的精度从57.3%到90.8%,优于回收增生的GPT-4o(80.1%)和以图示指导的GPT-4o,其延迟和成本低得多。 源代码将可用.

articles.title: Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features provides broad coverage by constraining all directions equally, but lacks semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot performance. To address these issues, we propose Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG), which constrains visual representation drift using the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embeddings. Specifically, TRAG constructs anchor-level constraints from the response directions and magnitudes around semantic anchors, then aggregates them using pre-trained image--anchor relevance, yielding an image-adaptive constraint. Extensive experiments across architectures and tasks demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance. Further analysis shows that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image--text relationships.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型零热强性文字响应-智能指导
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)表现出强烈的零射通俗化,但仍然容易受到对抗攻击. 现有的对抗性微调方法往往使用经过预先训练的模型指导来保持图像-文本相接,同时提高稳健性. 我们对视觉表现漂移的分析表明,两种有代表性的指导形式具有互补性的局限性。 相匹配的视觉特征通过平等地约束所有方向提供了广泛的覆盖,但缺乏语义上的重点. 相匹配的预测分布会优先确定与目的相关的方向,但仍然受到候选文本和预测概率的限制. 这些限制会妨碍预训图像-文本关系的保存并降低零镜头性能. 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了文字反应-智能指导(TRAG),它利用预先训练的文字编码器对输入嵌入中局部变化的响应来限制视觉表现漂移. 具体地说,TRAG从反应方向和大小上围绕语义锚地构建了锚层约束,再用预先训练的图像-锚地相关性来进行聚合,产生出图像-适应性约束. 跨越建筑和任务的广泛实验显示了最先进的清洁而有力的性能. 进一步的分析表明,TRAG有助于保存预先训练的图像-文本关系.

articles.title: Self-training for cross-centre coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography using pre-contrast frame subtraction
articles.content: Deep learning models for coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography often perform poorly on data from centres that were not represented in training. Apart from differences in equipment, the labels of the largest public dataset (ARCADE) are incomplete, as only the segments defined in the SYNTAX score are annotated. In this study, we evaluated whether self-training with pseudo-labels can improve performance on external data without additional manual annotation. Pseudo-labels were generated from two sources, namely the predictions of an nnU-Net model trained on ARCADE and a contrast map obtained by subtracting a pre-contrast frame from the same sequence. The nnU-Net predictions were extended along the contrast map, and pixels detected only in the subtraction image were assigned an ignore label and excluded from the loss. Six models were trained and tested on ARCADE and on two external datasets (XCAD and XACV). All first-round models initialised with the baseline predictions performed better than both the baseline and a control model fine-tuned for the same number of epochs. The model trained on the XCAD pool improved the macro-averaged Dice score by 2.7 points (95% CI 2.3-3.2), while the control decreased it by 0.6 points. A second round of self-training did not lead to further improvement. When an external model trained on 50 fully annotated images was used to generate the initial labels, the XCAD Dice score increased from 0.623 to 0.745 without any XCAD labels, although performance on XACV did not improve because large main vessels were missed. These results suggest that the benefit of self-training depends largely on the sensitivity of the model used to generate the initial pseudo-labels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在X射线血管造影学中采用预接框减法进行跨中心冠状血管分化的自训练
articles.content_zh: X射线血管造影术中冠状血管分化的深层学习模型往往在来自没有参加培训的中心的数据上表现不佳。 除了设备的差异外,最大的公共数据集(ARCADE)的标签不完整,因为只有SYNTAX分数中定义的片段才被注释. 在这项研究中,我们评价了使用伪标签的自学训练是否能够在没有额外人工注释的情况下改善外部数据的性能. Pseudo-label是来自两个来源的,即:对一个经过ARCADE培训的nnU-Net模型的预测和通过从同一个序列中去掉一个相接前框架而获得的对比图. nU-Net的预测沿对比图被扩展出,仅在减法图像中检测到的像素被分配到被忽略的标签并被排除出损失. 在ARCADE和两个外部数据集(XCAD和XACV)上培训和测试了6个模型. 所有首轮模型,加上基线预测,都表现优于基线和控制模型,对相同数量的时代进行了微调。 在XCAD池上接受训练的模型将宏平均得分提高2.7分(95% CI 2.3-3.2),而控制则降低了0.6分. 第二轮自我培训没有导致进一步改善。 当经过50个全注解图像培训的外部模型被用来生成初始标签时,XCAD Dice分数从0.623分增加到了0.745分而没有任何XCAD标签,尽管由于大型主舰被错过,XACV上的性能没有改善. 这些结果表明,自我训练的好处很大程度上取决于用于生成初始伪标签的模型的敏感性.

articles.title: LoRe-MIM: Lost-or-Replaced Masked Image Modeling for Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Whole-Body PET/CT
articles.content: Deep learning models for whole-body positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) hold significant clinical potential for disease detection, treatment planning, and response assessment. However, the time and cost associated with expert annotations remain major bottlenecks in developing robust and generalizable models. Although self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising approach to mitigating annotation scarcity, its application to whole-body PET/CT remains relatively underexplored due to the limited availability of large-scale datasets and the challenges associated with learning complementary cross-modal representations. To address these limitations, we curate a heterogeneous, multi-tracer, multi-institutional cohort comprising 6,531 whole-body PET/CT scans and propose LoRe-MIM (Lost-Or-Replaced Masked Image Modelling), a novel self-supervised framework designed to learn multimodal representations through masked image reconstruction. Specifically, LoRe-MIM introduces a masking strategy in which image regions are either replaced with zeros (Lost) or substituted with corresponding complementary imaging modality (Replaced), encouraging the model to capture both modality-specific characteristics and cross-modal relationships. We evaluate the learned representations across multiple downstream tasks, including multimodal PET/CT image reconstruction, patch-based classification into cancer vs. non-cancer, whole-body lesion segmentation, label-efficient training, and robustness assessment. Experimental results demonstrate that LoRe-MIM consistently outperforms the corresponding state-of-the-art baselines across these tasks, highlighting its potential as a scalable and generalizable self-supervised learning framework for whole-body PET/CT analysis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LoRe-MIM:用于全博迪PET/CT中自我监督代表学习的被丢失或被替换的外罩图像模型
articles.content_zh: 全身正体排放成像学/复合成像学(PET/CT)的深层学习模型在疾病检测、治疗规划和反应评估方面具有巨大的临床潜力。 然而,与专家说明有关的时间和费用仍然是发展强有力和可通用模式的主要瓶颈。 尽管自我监督的学习(SSL)已成为缓解注解稀缺性的有希望的方法,但由于大规模数据集有限,与学习互补的跨模式表述有关的挑战,其对全身PET/CT的应用仍然相对不足. 为了克服这些限制,我们管理了一个由6,531个全身PET/CT扫描组成的多机构组合,并提议Lore-MIM(丢失或被替换的相片模型),这是一个新的自我监督框架,旨在通过蒙面相片重建学习多模式表述。 具体地说,LoRe-MIM引入了一种遮掩策略,即图像区域要么被取而代之为零(Lost),要么被取而代之的是相应的互补成像模式(被取而代之),鼓励模型既捕捉模式特定特征又捕捉到跨模式关系. 我们评价在多个下游任务中汲取的教训,包括多模式PET/CT图像重建、基于补丁的癌症与非癌症的分类、全身损伤分解、标签效率高的培训以及强健性评估。 实验结果表明,LoRe-MIM在所有这些任务中的业绩始终超过相应的最先进的基线,突出了它作为全身PET/CT分析的可扩展和可概括的自我监督学习框架的潜力。

articles.title: TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents
articles.content: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner-controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. A causal Transformer controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent observations to predict discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step. We train the system in three stages: planner training, controller pretraining, and joint alignment. Experiments in Minecraft show that TaskFrame is competitive with general-purpose vision-language models on instruction decomposition, and that in closed-loop evaluation the agent achieves a higher combat success rate than the evaluated baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TaskFrame:将任务级别规划与游戏代理的框架级别控制相连接
articles.content_zh: 在快速变化的视觉环境中,建设一般游戏代理既需要高级任务推理,也需要低纬度动作控制. 这些能力有利于计算剖面图有很大相去甚远的模型,使它们难以在一个单一模型内实现. 在这项工作中,我们提出了TaskFrame,一个分级的规划者控制器框架,将任务级别的规划与帧级键盘和-mouse控制相接. 一个视觉语言的任务规划者将一个高层次的目标分解成一个有序的原子指令序列,并通过监督学习和依赖意识的GPRO来优化. 终止每个原子指令的特殊目标符号的隐藏状态提供连续目标嵌入,被缓存并跨控制步骤再利用. 一个因果变形器控制器将活性目标的嵌入与最近的观测结合起来,以预测离散键盘和鼠标-按钮动作以及每个游戏步骤的持续相机运动. 我们分三个阶段对系统进行培训:规划员培训、控制员预训和联合调整。 在Minecraft的实验显示,TaskFrame在指令分解上与通用视觉语言模型具有竞争力,在闭路评估中,剂的战斗成功率高于被评估的基线.

articles.title: Benchmarking color judgment in multimodal LLMs with CIE-computable ground truth
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are now used as zero-shot judges of image quality, but their color judgments are rarely tested with colorimetric ground truth. We present a five-task benchmark based on the CIE colorimetric framework: AWB pair judgment, skin-tone bias direction, CCT estimation, CIE Delta E 2000 pair ordering, and color naming under changing illuminants. We test eight MLLM endpoints, including four Qwen3-VL variants, GLM-4.5V, GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.7, and Gemini-3.1-Pro. The models often solve coarse binary AWB judgments, but they remain weak on numeric CCT estimation and on some fine color-difference judgments. On ColorChecker-24 stimuli, the three closed-weight frontier models reach CCT MAE of 715-1056 K, compared with 1358-2133 K for the five open-weight models. A non-ColorChecker control shows that this advantage is partly template-dependent. The results suggest that current MLLMs have useful color words and coarse visual priors, but their color judgments are not reliably calibrated to CIE-computable color differences.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以CIE可计算的地面真相作为衡量多式联运有限责任公司颜色判断的基准
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)现在被作为图像质量的零镜头判断器使用,但其色彩判断很少被用色度地真能测试. 我们提出了一个基于CIE色度框架的五大任务基准: AWB配对判断,皮肤通向偏向方向,CCT估计,CIE Delta E 2000配对定购,以及变化光子下的颜色命名. 我们测试了8个MLLM端点,包括4个Quen3-VL变体,GLM-4.5V,GPT-5.4,克洛德-奥普斯-4.7和双子座-3.1-Pro. 这些模型往往能解决粗细的二进制AWB判断,但在数值CCT估计和一些精细的分色判断上仍然很弱. 在ColorChecker-24的刺激上,三种闭量边框型号达到了715-1056 K的CCT MAE,而五个开量边框型号的闭量边框型号为1358-2133 K. 非ColorChecker控制显示,这种优势部分依赖于模板. 结果表明,目前的MLLMs有有用的色彩单词和粗糙的视觉前缀,但其色彩判断不可靠地被校正为CIE-可计算色彩差异.

articles.title: Decision-Level Error Attribution and Depth-Aware Safety Evaluation of Monocular RGB Human Tracking for Autonomous Robot Navigation
articles.content: Monocular RGB tracking is useful for robots operating near people, but perception errors affect binary stop/proceed decisions in ways that geometric accuracy metrics do not capture. We examine how much decision error arises from the safety rule versus perception. We prove that lateral-only distance is a lower bound on planar distance: with accurate positions, it cannot miss dangers identified by the planar rule, but it produces unnecessary stops. We introduce a two-factor Shapley attribution separating rule and perception contributions, and further distinguish missed detections from localization errors. Experiments use ETH and UCY pedestrian videos with simulated stationary robots, disjoint calibration and evaluation pedestrians, and time-block bootstrap intervals. Across 898 pedestrians in three scenes, the lateral rule missed no dangers on annotated positions but achieved only 5.6-31.9% stop precision. In two scenes with RGB perception, calibrated ground-plane localization achieved 0.59 m and 0.51 m planar RMSE, compared with 1.72 m and 1.39 m for a geometric baseline and 0.81 m and 0.68 m for calibrated Depth Anything V2. Detection recall of 0.43 and 0.26 made missed detections the leading source of missed danger. A two-standard-deviation safety margin with ground-plane localization matched or improved on the lateral rule's missed-danger rate in all eight scene-threshold settings and reduced unnecessary stops in seven. All robot interactions are simulated, and outcomes are offline decision classifications, not demonstrations of collision avoidance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自主机器人导航单体RGB载人跟踪决策级误差归属和深度智能安全评价
articles.content_zh: 单曲 RGB跟踪对在人附近运行的机器人有用,但知觉错误会以几何精度度测量不捕捉的方式影响二进制停止/处理决定. 我们审查安全规则与感知之间产生多少决定错误。 我们证明平面相距是平面相距的下限:有精确的位置,不能错过平面相距规则所识别出的危险,但会产生不必要的停站. 我们引入了将规则和感知贡献区分开来的两个因素的Shapley归属,并进一步区分了错失的检测和本地化错误. 实验使用ETH和UCY行人视频,并配有模拟的固定机器人,分解校正和评价行人,以及时阻靴间隔. 纵观三个场景的898名行人,平面规则没有错过注释位置上的危险,但只实现了5.6-31.9%的停站精度. 在有RGB感知的两个场景中,校正地平面本地化实现了0.59米和0.51米平面RMSE,而几何基线的校正地平面为1.72米和1.39米,而校正地平面深度为0.81米和0.68米. Anything V2. 0.43和0.26的探测召回使探测缺失成为危险缺失的主要来源。 地面飞机本地化的双标准降低安全系数与所有8个场景门槛设置的平面规则误入危险率相匹配或改进,并在7个场景中减少了不必要的停站. 所有机器人的相互作用都是模拟的,结果都是离线决定分类,而不是避免相撞的表现.

articles.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
articles.content: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation challenges of these systems. Second, agentic world modeling, where harnesses mediate observation, control, execution, and state. We discuss hybrid designs in which game engines or agent-written programs maintain world state while video models render observations, and how agents and world models can mutually evaluate and improve one another. Third, recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video model development, distinguishing output revisions, updates to harness state, generator parameters, and evaluators, and changes to the improvement procedure itself. We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development. Across these directions, we analyze essential agent capabilities, including audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, code-based interaction, feedback-guided control, skill reuse, and multi-agent coordination. We conclude with challenges in autonomous video production, lifelong memory, programmable hybrid control, autonomous model development, provenance, cost accounting, and evaluation linking video quality and task performance to sustained improvements in models and harnesses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视频生成满足代理哈内斯:代理视频生成,代理世界建模和回溯自我改进
articles.content_zh: 视频生成正在从端到端的合成转向代理生成,其中规划,工具使用和反馈可以实现连贯,可控制的多镜头视频. 与此同时,视频世界模型提供有行动条件的观测和预测未来,作为代理商的互动环境. 我们通过代理工具来研究它们的相交点:一个可执行的运行时间,构建上下文,曝光工具,保持状态,路径反馈,并管理围绕视频模型的预算. 本报告审查了三个方向。 首先,制作代理视频,在这些系统中协调脚本、拍摄规划、资产管理、制作和编辑,同时应对这些系统的评价挑战。 第二,代理世界建模,利用调解观测、控制、执行和状态。 我们讨论了游戏引擎或代理写作程序在视频模型提供观测时维持世界状态的混合设计,以及代理和世界模型如何相互评价和改进. 第三,视频模型开发中的递归自改进(RSI),区分出输出修改,更新来利用状态,生成参数,以及评价者,以及改进程序本身的变化. 我们确定这些改进如何反馈到以后的发展之中。 在这些方向上,我们分析必要的代理能力,包括视听感知、长视距规划、记忆、基于代码的互动、反馈指导控制、技能再利用和多代理协调。 最后,我们在自主视频制作、终身记忆、可编程混合控制、自主模式开发、出处、成本核算和评价方面面临挑战,将视频质量和任务业绩与持续改进模式和利用联系起来。

articles.title: AdMuse: Skill-Guided Creative Advertising Image Generation
articles.content: An outstanding creative advertising image should both attract attention and communicate a product's positioning. How to choose a persuasive conceptual bridge before rendering begins is challenging for advertising generation. We present AdMuse, a skill-guided multi-agent framework that distills high-quality advertisements into reusable creative skills for cross-domain advertising strategy. Rather than retrieving isolated exemplars, AdMuse abstracts recurring bridge patterns into a skill library that can guide new product briefs. At generation time, AdMuse coordinates skill routing, multi-candidate ideation and selection, and VLM-guided visual refinement: diverse skills propose alternative concepts, relative judgment selects the most promising direction, and vision-language feedback helps realize the selected intent in the final image. This design treats advertising creativity as a structured decision process rather than a single prompt-writing step. Experiments across diverse product and brand positionings show that AdMuse produces visually compelling advertisements that faithfully communicate product positioning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AdMuse: 技能指导 创意广告 图像生成
