articles.content_zh: 一个杰出的有创意的广告形象既能吸引人们的注意,又能传达产品的定位. 如何在渲染开始前选择有说服力的概念桥,对于广告生成来说是一个挑战. 我们介绍AdMuse,这是一个技术指导的多代理框架,将高质量的广告提炼成跨领域广告战略的可重复使用的创造技能。 AdMuse摘要不但没有检索孤立的例子,反而将反复出现的桥接模式输入一个能指导新产品简报的技能库. 在一代人的时间,AdMuse协调技能的路由,多扫描的创意和选择,以及由VLM指导的视觉改进:多种技能提出替代概念,相对判断选择最有希望的方向,视觉语言反馈帮助实现最终图像中选定的意图. 这种设计将广告创意视为结构化的决策过程,而不是单一的即时写作步骤. 跨越不同产品和品牌定位的实验显示,AdMuse制作的具有视觉说服力的广告忠实地传达出产品定位.

articles.title: Beyond CCT: Multi-channel SPD recovery for per-shot camera color correction
articles.content: Modern cameras correct color via two or three pre-calibrated 3x3 matrices interpolated by Correlated Color Temperature (CCT). This collapses the illuminant SPD to a scalar. LEDs, fluorescents, and mixed sources sit off the Planckian locus, and metameric illuminants with the same chromaticity demand different optimal CCMs that a CCT pipeline cannot distinguish. We recover the illuminant SPD instead using non-negative least squares against a basis dictionary, conditioned on the camera white point and a multi-channel ambient-light sensor (ALS). A closed-form 3x3 CCM is then fit per shot. On a synthetic benchmark of 300 illuminants and 3,100 reflectances, mean angular error drops from 1.89 to 1.20 degrees, with a 1.7x tail reduction on the LED-like off-Planckian group (n=45) where metameric ambiguity is tangible. The gain holds under realistic ALS imperfections and observation noise, and the same off-Planckian advantage carries over to 1,684 real measured SPDs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超过CCT:多频道 每发相机颜色校正的SPD恢复
articles.content_zh: 现代相机通过由Cor相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这把光辉的SPD摔倒了 LED,荧光,和混合源坐落在普朗克的蝗体外,具有相同色相的元光子需要不同的最佳CM,而CCT管无法区分. 我们用非阴性最小的平方来取回光亮的SPD, 以相机白点和多通道环境光传感器为条件。 闭式3x3 CCM 后被每发相接. 在300个照明剂和3100个反射物的合成基准上,指角误差从1.89度下降到1.20度,在LED等外普朗克(n=45)组上有1.7x尾的还原,其中元模模糊度是明显的. 收益在现实的ALS缺陷和观测噪声下得到控制,同样的非普朗克优势延续到1,684个实际测量的SPD.

articles.title: EventSeeColor: Learning to Reconstruct Color from Monochrome Events
articles.content: Event cameras capture visual brightness changes under challenging lighting conditions. However, traditional event-based image reconstruction targets grayscale intensity and produces images without scene color. Color distinguishes surfaces with similar intensity. Reconstructing color from events can reveal appearance differences that reconstructed grayscale images cannot express. Although monochrome event cameras do not directly measure color, their event-triggering patterns depend on surface reflectance, illumination, and the sensor's spectral response. These patterns may contain cues that support color reconstruction. In this paper, we present EventSeeColor, which uses event-reconstructed grayscale and aligned events to jointly guide a diffusion colorizer. Grayscale-derived semantic context supports color inference, while region-balanced chroma supervision and local RGB refinement improve color distribution, brightness, and texture. In the combined evaluation on two real event datasets, EventSeeColor achieves the best structural similarity, learned perceptual scores, and chromatic-region color difference among the external methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 事件见 Color: 从单色事件学习重建颜色
articles.content_zh: 事件相机在具有挑战性的照明条件下捕捉到视觉亮度的变化. 然而,传统的以事件为基础的图像重建目标为灰色尺度强度并产生没有场景颜色的图像. 颜色以相似的强度区分出表面. 从事件重构颜色可以揭示出外观上的差异,而再重建出灰度图像无法表达. 虽然单色事件相机不直接测量颜色,但其事件触发模式取决于表面反射,发光,以及传感器的光谱反应. 这些模式可能包含支持色彩重建的提示. 在本文中,我们介绍Eventure See Color,它使用由事件重构而成的灰度和对齐的事件来共同引导一种扩散色器. Grayscale-衍生语义上下文支持色推论,而区域平衡的染色体监督和地方RGB改进则能改善色分布,亮度和纹理. 在两个真实事件数据集的综合评价中,Event See Color实现了最好的结构相似性,学到了知觉分数,以及外在方法之间的色相-区域颜色差异.

articles.title: Hierarchical Step Decomposition for Training-free Online Video Step Grounding
articles.content: Given a set of procedural steps, Video Step Grounding (VSG) aims to identify which steps occur in a video and localize when they are performed. Existing methods are either offline, requiring access to the full video before making predictions, or online, but relying on fixed-length video segments producing noisy, over-segmented outputs. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Step Decomposition (HSD), a training-free framework for online VSG that leverages the semantic understanding capabilities of Large Multimodal Models. HSD addresses two central challenges in online grounding: constructing semantically coherent temporal segments from a streaming video, and bridging the semantic gap between coarse procedural step descriptions and visual observations. To construct elementary temporal units, HSD incrementally groups incoming segments into semantically consistent events, using an anchor caption that is continuously validated against the visual stream. Based on these events, we perform zero-shot procedural step classification and selectively refine uncertain predictions by decomposing candidate steps into finegrained substeps that capture more nuanced visual evidence. By operating on semantically coherent events rather than every fixed-length segment, HSD reduces redundant computation and produces more stable predictions. Experiments on HT-Step, Ego4D Goal-Step, and CrossTask show that HSD substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods, overall achieving better step recognition, more accurate temporal localization, and faster inference.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 等级步骤解析无培训在线视频步骤
articles.content_zh: 鉴于一系列程序步骤,录像台阶定位(VSG)旨在确定录像中出现的步骤,并在进行这些步骤时加以本地化。 现有方法要么是离线的,在作出预测之前需要访问完整的视频,要么是在线的,但依赖固定长度的视频片段,产生吵闹的,过于分化的产出. 在这项工作中,我们提出分级阶梯分解(HSD),这是在线VSG的无培训框架,利用大型多式联运模型的语义理解能力. HSD解决了在线地平面上的两个中心挑战:从流出视频中构建出精密一致的时间段,并弥合粗糙的程序步骤描述和视觉观察之间的语义差距. 为了构建基本时间单元,HSD将接入的片段逐渐地组合成整体上一致的事件,使用一个持续验证可视流的锚标标题. 基于这些事件,我们进行了零镜头程序步骤分类,并通过将候选步骤分解为能捕捉出更细微视觉证据的细微分步骤,有选择地完善了不确定的预测. HSD通过在相模一致的事件上而不是在每个固定长度的片段上操作来减少冗余计算并产生更稳定的预测. HT-Step、Ego4D Goal-Step和Cross上的实验 任务显示,HSD大大超过最先进的方法,总体上实现更好的步骤识别,更准确的时间定位,更快的推论.

articles.title: NeurEO: dissecting Earth observation embeddings with computational neuroscience
articles.content: Earth embeddings are compressed representations of rich Earth observation data that enable downstream models to tackle a wide range of complex geospatial tasks. Yet, this increase in performance comes at the cost of decreased interpretability, as the semantic meaning of Earth embeddings is unknown. To address this challenge, we borrow methods from the field of computational neuroscience, which aim to interpret activity in (biological) neurons. Here, we adapt and apply these methods to assign meaning to AlphaEarth embeddings. We analyse embedding features both as stand-alone data, equivalent to spontaneous neural activity, and in relation to land cover and elevation correlates, equivalent to stimulus-response neural activity. We demonstrate correlational and multi-scale structure in the embedding features. Embedding features can display highly specific and directional tuning to land cover and elevation, such as a `North vs South woodland edge' response. When we remove the main trends of combined land cover responses (like water versus land tuning), we discover fine-grained representational details with increased effective dimensionality. Together, our analyses start to unravel what these Earth embeddings represent, which is critical for developing trustworthy downstream applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NeurEO:用计算神经科学来解析地球观测嵌入
articles.content_zh: 地嵌入是丰富的地球观测数据的压缩表示,使下游模型能够完成广泛的复杂的地理空间任务. 然而,这种性能的提高是以可解释性下降为代价的,因为地球嵌入的语义含义是未知的. 为了应对这一挑战,我们借用了计算神经科学领域的方法,这些方法旨在解释(生物)神经元中的活动。 在这里,我们适应并应用这些方法来给AlphaEarth嵌入物分配意义. 我们分析嵌入特征,既作为独立数据,相当于自发神经活动,又与土地覆盖和高地相关,相当于刺激-反应神经活动。 我们在嵌入式特征中展示了相关和多尺度的结构。 嵌入特征可以表现出高度具体和方向性地调整到土地覆盖和高地,例如“北对南林地边缘”反应。 当我们去除土地覆被综合反应的主要趋势(如水与地调)时,我们发现精细的描述性细节,增加了有效的维度. 我们的分析一起开始解析这些嵌入地球的事物,这对开发可信赖的下游应用至关重要。

articles.title: VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now process hour-long videos, making extended multi-turn dialogue over a single video a natural mode of use. Sustaining such a dialogue requires more than answering each question in isolation: the model must retrieve and reuse information established earlier in the conversation, both what it has seen and what it has said, an ability we term in-context video memory. Existing video QA benchmarks leave this ability unmeasured: their questions are mutually independent, never reference one another, and each is answerable from the video alone, so nothing ever requires carrying information across turns. We introduce VideoMemBench, in which each sample pairs a single video with a long multi-turn dialogue, whose turns are connected by typed cross-turn dependencies: an Episodic Dependency refers back to a visual episode described in an earlier turn, probing memory of what the model has seen, while an Answer Dependency builds on the model's own earlier answer, probing memory of what the model has said. Every dependency is verified considering two properties: 1) necessity, meaning the question cannot be answered without its earlier turns, and 2) non-leakage, meaning the question does not restate the information from its earlier turns. To enforce these properties, we design a construction pipeline with three LLM roles: a planner, a generator, and a judger, with each dialogue reviewed by human experts. VideoMemBench comprises 326 videos with 2,476 turns, of which 1,387 depend on earlier turns, including multi-parent dependencies and long-range call-back. Among over 20 evaluated open- and closed-source MLLMs, Claude Opus 5 performs the best with an overall score of only 45.7\%, highlighting the challenge of in-context video memory. Our dataset and evaluation are released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视频Mem Bench:MLLMs在视频对话中如何记忆?
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)现在可以处理长达小时的视频,使单个视频上的扩展多回合对话成为自然的使用模式. 维持这种对话不仅需要孤立地回答每个问题:模型必须检索和再利用对话中早些时候建立的信息,无论是它所看到的信息还是它所说的话,我们称之为内文视频记忆的能力。 现有的视频QA基准使得这种能力没有被衡量:他们的问题是相互独立的,从不相互参照,每个问题都可以从视频中单独回答,因此没有任何东西需要将信息带过转弯. 我们引入了VideoMem Bench,其中每个样本将单个视频配对并带有长多回合对话,其转折由打入的交叉回合依赖关系连接: 一个Episodic依赖关系是指在更早的转折中描述的一出视觉剧集,探究模型所见所闻的内存,而一个Answer依赖关系则建立在模型自己更早的答案上,探究模型所言的内存. 考虑到两个属性,每个依赖都得到核实: 1)危急情况,指问题若没有早先的转折就无法解答;2)非漏损,指问题不重复早先转折中的信息. 为了强制执行这些地产,我们设计了一条建筑管道,它有三个LLM的作用:一个规划员,一个发电机,一个法官,每个对话都由人类专家审查. VideoMem Bench由326个有2,476个转弯的视频组成,其中1,387个转弯依赖于更早的转弯,包括多父母依赖和远程回调. 在超过20个被评价的开源和闭源MLLMs中,克洛德·奥普斯5成绩最好,总得分只有45.7分,凸显了内文视频内存的挑战. 我们的数据集和评价已经发布。

articles.title: It Takes Two to Probe, Thousands to Retrieve: Putting Vision--Language Probes to the Retrieval Test
articles.content: Vision--language models (VLMs) are tested for fine-grained understanding with image--text matching probes, a model must prefer the correct image or caption over handcrafted negative. In retrieval, the correct item must beat thousands of alternatives. We measure how these two evaluation methods relate by using two probing benchmarks, \svo{} and SugarCrepe, for retrieval tasks. For 100 image and caption queries we judge the top-10 retrievals from full dataset of six VLMs, with human annotators and an LLM assessor. We than compare how well models rank pool of items on the same queries, while changing only where the negatives comes from: the benchmark, a random draw, or the judged-incorrect retrievals of other models. On \svo{} the accuracy of retrieving a positive over handcrafted negatives is significantly higher than for retrieved ones (the correct item is preferred in 85\% against 77\% of the time). Using pool of ten retrieved negatives leads to same accuracy as when one uses pool of 200 to 430 random negatives. On SugarCrepe the order is reversed: its handcrafted negatives are harder than the retrieved ones. Incomplete relevance labels explain most of the low retrieval scores on \svo{}, where the top-ranked item is correct for 54--90\% of the queries under human labels against 6--21\% under the benchmark's labels. However, we detect no association between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first. The LLM assessor o3 agrees with individual annotators ($κ$ 0.57--0.61) slightly less than they agree with each other (0.64--0.68).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 它需要2到探测,数千到检索: 将视觉-语言探测器放到检索测试中
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)通过图像-文字匹配探测器进行精细的理解测试,一个模型必须选择正确的图像或标题而不是手动的负. 在取回时,正确的物品必须战胜上千种替代品. 我们通过使用两个测试基准,\svo{}和SugarCrepe来衡量这两种评估方法之间的关系。 对于100个图像和字幕查询,我们从6个VLM的完整数据集中判断出10个最高检索率,并配有人类注释员和一个LLM评估员. 我们比比较模型在相同的查询上排列项目库的级别好得多,而只改变负数的来源:基准、随机抽取或其他模型的判断不正确检索。 在\svo{}上,取出正反手动底片的准确性明显高于取回底片的准确性(正确的项目在85\%对时间的77\%). 使用10个检索到的底片池,与使用200至430个随机底片池一样准确。 在SugarCrepe上,订单被反转:其手动底片比取回的底片更难. 不完整的关联性标签解释了\svoQQ上大多数低检索分数,其中排行榜上的项目在人类标签下54-90QQ对基准标签下6-21QQ的查询是正确的. 然而,我们发现,通过探测器进行查询与首先取回正确物品之间没有任何关联。 LLM评估员o3同意个别注释员(0.57-0.61美元)的意见,略低于他们彼此之间的一致意见(0.64-0.68)。

articles.title: Learning a Motion Manifold to Constrain Ambiguity in Unsupervised 4D Medical Image Interpolation
articles.content: Unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation reconstructs intermediate anatomical states from temporally sparse observations without intermediate supervision. Distinct motion fields may attain comparable endpoint agreement while producing different intermediate anatomy, giving rise to motion ambiguity. This ambiguity is difficult to constrain when many independently adjustable motion variables must be estimated from the observed endpoints. We develop a framework that learns a motion manifold to restrict candidate motion fields while retaining sample-specific variation. Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning extracts recurring motion structure from endpoint-derived dense estimates and encodes it in a shared spectral basis. Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation uses predicted motion coordinates to rotate the effective motion directions for each endpoint pair without increasing the number of independent coordinates. Their composition defines a nonlinear family of complete velocity fields across endpoint pairs, accommodating anatomical and motion-state differences within a restricted representation. Integrating each predicted field supports bidirectional reconstruction at arbitrary intermediate times. Theoretical analysis establishes sufficient conditions under which endpoint observations distinguish nearby motions within the learned family. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods trained without intermediate volumes and competitive results against methods using intermediate supervision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在无监督的 4D 医学图像内嵌中学习动作磁盘
articles.content_zh: 未受监督的4D医学影像内插从时空稀疏的观测中重建出中间解剖状态而无需中间监督. 不同的运动场可能在产生不同的中间解剖时达成类似的终点协议,从而引起运动模糊. 当许多可独立调整的运动变量必须从观测到的终点来估计时,这种模糊性就难以限制. 我们开发一个框架,学习运动多面性,限制候选运动场,同时保留特定样本的变化。 跨分光谱基础学习从端点产生的密集估计中提取出反复运动结构,并用共享光谱基础编码. 有条件的样本 Cayley Base 重新定向使用预测的运动坐标来旋转每个端点对的有效运动方向而不会增加独立坐标的数量. 他们的构成定义了一个由横跨端点对的完整速度场组成的非线性家族,在受限制的代表权范围内容纳解剖和运动状态的差异. 将每个预测的字段整合在一起,支持任意中间时间的双向重建. 理论分析确立了充分的条件,在这种条件下,端点观测可以区分所学家庭内附近的动议. 有关非洲催化分解中心和4D-Lung的实验显示,经过培训的经评价方法的性能最先进,没有中间卷,也没有利用中间监督方法取得竞争结果。

articles.title: SynthFaces: Balanced Large Scale Human Dataset
articles.content: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation. In this work we propose a pipeline for controllable generation of dataset with diverse faces for generative models training and finetuning. We achieve this by expanding foundational Arc2Face diffusion model with a flow matching generative model in the manifold of identity embeddings. We demonstrate that such approach achieves both goals of generative fidelity and label diversity not present in real human-centric datasets. As a result we collect and further contextualize a highly balanced identity-centric dataset of humans named SynthFaces. By design, our released images and identities are synthetic, reducing direct reliance on real personal images; we empirically check identity separation with a nearest-neighbor non-leakage metric. We purpose it for training and tuning of fair models for various downstream tasks, and showcase its usability in finetuning an existing adapter-based method for personalized generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 合成法:平衡的大型人类数据集
articles.content_zh: 现实世界数据集的固有偏见和隐私风险严重地阻碍了在以人为中心的任务中实现公正和平等的AI,这些数据提供了身份的不平衡表述,并往往包含敏感的个人信息。 因此,在这种扭曲的数据方面受过培训的最先进的基因模型显示出不公平的表现,特别是在保存身份方面。 在这项工作中,我们提议为基因模型的培训和微调提供一个可控数据集的管道,其面孔多种多样。 我们通过扩展基础Arc2Face扩散模型来实现这一点,在身份嵌入的多面体中用流相匹配的基因模型. 我们表明,这种做法既能实现基因忠诚的目标,又能实现真正以人为中心的数据集中没有的标签多样性的目标。 因此,我们收集和进一步将一个高度平衡的、以身份为中心的名为合成花样的人类数据集联系起来。 通过设计,我们释放的图像和身份是被合成的,减少了对真实个人图像的直接依赖;我们以经验来检查身份分离,用最近的邻居非漏出度量衡. 我们的目的是培训和调整各种下游任务的公平模式,并展示其可用性,以微调一种基于适应器的现有个人化生成方法。

articles.title: SelfThinker: Self-Evolving Reasoning via Reliability-Verified Intrinsic Visual Thoughts
articles.content: Unified multimodal models can both generate and understand images within a single set of weights, offering an opportunity to use image synthesis as training supervision for visual comprehension. However, existing visual chain-of-thought methods rely on human-annotated helper images during training and require slow image generation at test time. We present SelfThinker, the first self-evolving framework that turns a unified model's self-generated visual thoughts into stronger understanding without human image annotations. Given a visual problem, SelfThinker samples candidate helper images from its generation pathway and uses its frozen understanding pathway to score each candidate via conditional pointwise mutual information. High-utility visual thoughts then refine the generator via flow matching and serve as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation. At inference, SelfThinker reasons directly from the original image in text without generating intermediate images. Although trained only on small synthetic visual-search and navigation datasets, SelfThinker transfers broadly to natural-image and spatial benchmarks, raising the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B from 52.7 to 64.0 (+11.3 points). Controlled image-perturbation probes further show that SelfThinker surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and its pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by up to 23.2 points across fine-grained and spatial perception tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhangquanchen/SelfThinker.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SelfThinker:通过可靠性-经验证的视觉思想实现自我演变的理性
articles.content_zh: 统一的多模式模型既可在一组加权内生成并理解图像,也提供了利用图像合成作为视觉理解培训监督的机会。 然而,现有的视觉思维链方法在训练时依赖于人附加说明的帮助者图像,需要测试时缓慢地生成图像. 我们介绍SelfThinker,这是第一个将一个统一的模型的自生视觉思想转化为没有人类形象说明的更强理解的自生自灭的框架. 由于视觉问题,SelfThinker从生成路径中取出候选帮助者图像,并使用被冻结的理解路径通过有条件的指向相互信息对每个候选者进行分分. 高功用视觉思想然后通过流量比对来完善生成器,并充当政策自我消化的特权教师背景. 推论中,SelfThinker在文本中直接从原始图像中推理,而不产生中间图像. SelfThinker虽然只接受过小型合成视觉搜索和导航数据集的培训,但广泛向自然成像和空间基准转移,将ThinkMorph-7B的7个基准平均值从52.7分提高到64.0分(+11.3分). 被控制的图像-扰动探测器进一步显示,SelfThinker超越了ThinkMorph-7B最多40.4分,其预先训练的BAGEL-7B主干线跨精细和空间感知任务最多23.2分. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/zhangquanchen/SelfThinker上查阅。

articles.title: RepConTUR: A Report-Conditioned Volumetric Multimodal Model for Abdominal Tumor Segmentation
articles.content: Tumor delineation is required for radiotherapy planning, yet automatic segmentation is limited by errors, predominantly false positives, that distort dose and increase editing time. The radiology report accompanies the scan and localizes disease at the suborgan level, but existing text-promptable models condition on short referring phrases, and most operate in 2D. We present RepConTUR, a single native-3D early-fusion multimodal model that conditions volumetric abdominal tumor segmentation on the narrative report. We extend AbdomenAtlas 3.0 to a suborgan-level promptable segmentation dataset and generate report-based VQA pairs, yielding four report-derived tasks on the same annotations: referring segmentation (RES), report-grounded segmentation (GSEG), report generation (RRG), and visual question answering (VQA). We train RepConTUR, comprising a 3D CT encoder, an early-fusion language model, and a native-3D segmentation module, jointly on the four tasks. Across liver, kidney and pancreas, RepConTUR attains the highest Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), instance-wise precision, and detection F1 among the text-promptable baselines, and adding the report raises mean precision while leaving recall comparable. Against two vision-only specialists, nnU-Net and the report-supervised R-Super, RepConTUR attains the highest value on every in-domain metric for liver and pancreas and the highest mean DSC, recall, precision, and detection F1 over the four out-of-distribution public cohorts. Ablations indicate that conditioning on the narrative report raises detection F1 from 0.499 to 0.528 within the same model, that joint GSEG training raises RES F1 from 0.450 to 0.482, and that the native-3D segmentation module raises GSEG F1 from 0.139 to 0.528 over its 2D counterpart. Code is available at https://github.com/Oncosoft-Research/RepConTUR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重置:一个报告格式的腹膜肿瘤分解多式模型
articles.content_zh: 放射治疗规划需要肿瘤分解,然而自动分解受到错误的限制,主要是假阳性,扭曲剂量并增加编辑时间. 放射学报告伴有扫描并局部分泌出子器官层面的疾病,但现有的文本快取模型条件在短引用短语上,大部分操作在2D. 我们提出RepConTUR,一种单一的原生-三维早期聚变多模式模型,在叙述报告中将体积腹部肿瘤分化作为条件。 我们把AbdomenAtlas 3.0扩展至一个次级机构一级的可快速分解数据集,并生成基于报告的VQA对,在同一说明中得出了四个基于报告的任务:参考分解(RES),基于报告分解(GSEG),报告生成(RRG)和可视问题回答(VQA). 我们培训RepConTUR,包括一个3D CT编码器,一个早期聚变语言模型,以及一个土生土长的3D分块模块,共同执行这四个任务. 在整个肝脏、肾脏和胰腺中,RepContur在文字快速基线中达到最高的Dice相似系数(DSC),并检测出F1,加上报告提高了平均精确度,同时使召回具有可比性。 NNU-Net和由报告监督的R-Super这两个仅视专家,在肝脏和胰脏的每个域内衡量值上,RepConturour都达到最高值,在4个分布外公共群体中,平均DSC、召回、精确和检测值最高。 通缩表明,在叙述报告中的限定条件将同一型号内的检测F1从0.499提高到0.528;GSEG联合培训将RES F1从0.450提高到0.482;原生-3D分化模块将GSEG F1从0.139提高到0.528,高于2D对等. 代码见https://github.com/Oncosoft-Research/RepConturt.

articles.title: Neural Blind Deconvolution for Image Scanning Microscopy
articles.content: Image scanning microscopy (ISM) acquires one scanned image per detector element, which are then fused into a single image by multi-image deconvolution to obtain a super-resolved image. Its accuracy, however, depends on point spread function (PSF) models that sample- and system-induced aberrations often invalidate. Since differences between the scanned images encode aberration information, we propose a training-free blind Deep Image Prior (DIP) framework that jointly estimates the specimen and the detector-dependent PSFs. The PSFs are parametrised through the detector geometry and shared excitation and emission PSFs, reducing the unknowns while preserving the physical ISM model, and a Gaussian pre-initialisation stabilises the blind optimisation. On experimental tubulin data, blind DIP recovers finer filamentous structures than multi-image deconvolution and DIP with fixed theoretical PSFs, while adapting the PSFs to the measurements.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 图像扫描显微镜的神经盲解析
articles.content_zh: 图像扫描显微镜(ISM)获得每个探测器元件一个被扫描的图像,然后由多图像分解而被熔化为单一的图像来得到超解的图像. 然而,它的准确性取决于点散函数(PSF)模型,而样本和系统引起的异常往往无效. 由于扫描图像编码异常信息之间的差异,我们建议建立一个无训练的盲深图像前导(DIP)框架,共同估计标本和检测器依赖的PSF. PSF通过探测器几何和共享的激出并释放出PSF来进行截取,在保留物理的ISM模型的同时减少未知数,并使用高斯语进行初始化前稳定盲优化. 在实验管子素数据上,盲DIP恢复了比多成像分解更细的丝状结构并带有固定理论PSF的DIP,同时使PSF适应测量.

articles.title: Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network for Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Accurate multi-organ segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for computer-aided diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. However, substantial variations in organ shape and size, together with low tissue contrast and ambiguous boundaries, complicate the modeling of heterogeneous anatomical structures. To address these challenges, we propose a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network (MCDNet), which integrates adaptive local structural enhancement with channel-decoupled long-range modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled State-Space (MCSS) block that divides feature channels into separate processing groups, allowing differentiated structural representations to be learned within an efficient state-space framework. Within each group, a Morphology-Aware Enhancement Module (MAEM) combines deformable convolutions with channel attention to adapt local feature extraction to anatomical shape variations. Group-wise state-space modeling then captures long-range spatial dependencies, and channel gating adaptively integrates the resulting features. Experiments on the Synapse abdominal CT dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of MCDNet, achieving an average Dice Similarity Coefficient of 81.61% for multi-organ segmentation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 口腔- 智能通道- 十进制 医疗图像分块曼巴网络
articles.content_zh: 计算机辅助诊断、治疗规划和疾病监测必须精确地进行多器官分解。 然而,器官形状和大小的巨大差异,加上组织对比度低和界限模糊,使不同解剖结构的模型制作复杂化. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立一个莫菲克-阿瓦雷频道-Decoupled Mamba网络(MCDNet),该网络将适应性局部结构增强与频道断接的远程建模相结合。 具体地说,我们引入了一个莫菲克-智能通道-Decoupled State-Space(MCSS)块,将特征通道划分为单独的处理组,从而可以在高效的状态空间框架内学习不同的结构表示. 在每组内,一个自传-智能增强模块(MAEM)会将可变变形的演化和信道注意力结合起来来使局部地物提取适应解剖形状的变化. 分组状态-空间模型然后捕捉出远程空间依赖性,并因地制宜地将由此而来的特点相融合而分道扬镳. 在突触腹部CT数据集上进行的实验证明了MCDNet的有效性,实现多器官分解的平均Dice相似性系数为81.61%.

articles.title: Uncertainty-aware Coarse-to-Fine Main Pancreatic Duct Segmentation for Width Measurement in 3D MRCP
articles.content: Assessment of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) from volumetric magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) scans is an essential task for ductal dilatation diagnosis and pancreatic cancer analysis. However, manual assessment is affected by reader variability in which automated analysis may assist. Nevertheless, fully automated and uncertainty-aware MPD analysis from volumetric MRCP remains underexplored area of research. In this study, we propose an automatic and uncertainty-aware deep learning-based pipeline for MPD segmentation and maximum-width analysis from MRCP scans. A coarse localisation model first identifies the ductal region-of-interest, followed by a fine model that segments the MPD within the region. The dataset consists of 256 MPD-segmented MRCP scans from 69 patients. A randomly selected holdout test subset of 14 patients with 55 MRCP volumes was used for evaluation. We employed a five-model cross-validation ensemble for improved performance and uncertainty estimation. The best MPD segmentation performance was 0.634 DSC, 0.744 precision, and 0.593 recall. The mean absolute error for maximum MPD width prediction was 0.355~mm and dilated MPD ($\geq 5$~mm) was detected with 75.0\% sensitivity and 74.4\% specificity. These novel results suggest that automated MPD segmentation can be used to aid MRCP-based duct measurements.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不确定的粗至细主阴道 3D MRCP 中宽度测量的 Duct分解
articles.content_zh: 通过体积磁共振胆兰基蛋白学(MRCP)扫描对主要胰腺管(MPD)进行评估,是进行管状分解诊断和胰腺癌分析的一项基本任务. 然而,人工评估受到读者变化的影响,自动化分析可能对此有所帮助。 然而,从体积多氯二苯并呋喃(MRCP)中进行完全自动化的和对不确定性认识的多氯二苯并呋喃分析,仍然是未得到充分探讨的研究领域。 在这项研究中,我们提议从MRCP扫描中为MPD分解和最大宽度分析提供自动和有不确定性意识的深层学习管道。 一个粗糙的本地化模式首先确定了具有利益的管道区域,然后是将磁共振在区域内分割的精细模式。 数据集由来自69个病人的256个MPD分块MRCP扫描组成. 随机选取的由14名患者组成的持有55个MRCP卷的搁置测试子集用于评价. 我们采用了五种模式的交叉验证组合,以改进业绩和不确定性估计。 最佳的MSD分解性能为:0.634 DSC,0.744精度和0.593回想. 最大 MPD 宽度预测的平均绝对误差为 0.355~mm,放大的 MPD (\geq 5$~mm) 被检测出75.0~%的敏感度和74.4~%的特异性. 这些新颖的结果表明,可以使用自动化的MPD分解来帮助基于MRCP的管道测量.

articles.title: BRACHIO: Broad Representations Across Centres for Head-and-neck Imaging Oncology (HECKTOR 2026)
articles.content: The HECKTOR 2026 challenge benchmarks machine learning for head and neck cancer, where teams delineate primary and nodal tumour volumes, perform TN staging, and predict recurrence-free survival (RFS). This report describes the submissions for the HECKTOR challenge of team nucli. As the three tasks span both dense and global information from multicentric PET/CT scans, we utilise self-supervised pre-trained encoders, training a 2D DINOv2 encoder (PET-DINOv2-MIPs) on HECKTOR 2026's PET scans. Our final test submission ensembles a DynUNet trained from scratch with a SwinUNETR whose Swin trunk was initialised from a SimMIM-pre-trained checkpoint for segmentation, reaching a mean Dice of 0.5409. For TN staging, GTVp/GTVn geometric features from the segmentation masks are fit to stage probabilities by logistic regression (LR) and fused with PET-DINOv2-MIPs deep features (PCA + LR) via a second-level LR, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.3962 (T-stage) and 0.6432 (N-stage). For the RFS prognosis task, we fine-tune the last two blocks of the PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S encoder jointly with an MLP head under a CoxPH loss, concatenating clinical covariates with the imaging features, reaching a test Harrell's C-index of 0.6577 and a weighted challenge score of 0.5802. The prognosis result is comparable to the best entry of the previous edition and consistent with our internal cross-validation, while our segmentation result is well below it and limits the staging results that depend on it.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 巴西:广泛代表性 头颈成像肿瘤中心(HECKTOR 2026)
articles.content_zh: HECKTOR 2026挑战基准机用于头部和颈部癌症的学习,团队在其中划定了初级和节点肿瘤体积,进行TN中转,并预测无再生存活(RFS). 本报告介绍了为Nucli团队的HECKTOR挑战而提交的资料。 由于这三项任务跨越了多中心PET/CT扫描的密集信息和全球信息,我们使用自我监督的预先训练的编码器,在HECKTOR 2026的PET扫描上培训了一台2D DINov2编码器(PET-DINOv2-MIPs). 我们最后的测试呈文集合了用SwinUNETR从头开始训练的一款DynUNet,其Swin干线是从一个SimMIM预先训练的检查站关闭的,用于分道扬镳,达到0.5409的平分. 对于TN中转,从分片口罩取出GTVp/GTVn几何特征,适合通过物流回归(LR)进行相位概率,并通过二级LR与PET-DINOv2-MIPs深层特征(PCA + LR)相接,达到0.3962(T级)和0.6432(N级)的平衡速率. 对于RFS的预后任务,我们微调了PET-DINOv2-MIPs VIT-S编码器后两块与CoxPH损失下的一个MLP头相联编码器,使临床同成像特征相配合,达到了测试哈雷尔的C-指数0.6577和加权挑战得分0.5802. 预后结果可与上版的最佳入门相媲美并符合我们的内部交叉验证,而我们的分解结果则远远低于分解结果,并限制了依赖于分解结果的起跑结果.

articles.title: Localizing Concepts in Visual Autoregressive Models
articles.content: Understanding the internal routing of visual concepts is crucial for the safe and controllable adaptation of generative models. While concept localization has been widely studied in diffusion models, the emerging paradigm of next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce LoCo, the first model-agnostic framework to localize where and when specific concepts emerge within autoregressive models. Driven by the native coarse-to-fine nature of next-scale generation, our method precisely maps conceptual knowledge across three distinct dimensions: Layer, Scale, and Position. To systematically localize and evaluate concept routing without context bias, we propose LoCoBench, a comprehensive dataset spanning 10 diverse categories. Extensive probing on image and video autoregressive models like Infinity, HunyuanImage-3.0, and InfinityStar shows that the localized positions are both interpretable and causally related to concept emergence. Building on these insights, we apply our localization method to three key applications: concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial concept injection. Experiments demonstrate that our targeted intervention achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially reducing computational overhead while preserving benign utility. Overall, our findings offer insights into how conceptual knowledge is routed during autoregressive generation, introducing a practical pathway for more interpretable, efficient, and secure adaptation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在视觉自动递减模型中将概念定位
articles.content_zh: 了解视觉概念的内部路径对基因模型的安全和可控制的适应至关重要。 虽然概念本地化在扩散模型中被广泛研究,但正在形成的下级视觉自递模型的范式基本上仍未被探索. 在本文中,我们介绍了LoCo,这是第一个模型不可知性框架,用于在自递性模型中出现具体概念的地方和时间本地化. 由下一代的原始粗糙至细小的性质驱动,我们的方法精确地绘制了三个不同维度的概念知识:地层、尺度和位置。 为了系统地确定和评价概念的路径,不带上下文的偏差,我们提出LoCo Bench,一个涵盖10个不同类别的综合数据集。 对"无限","HunyuanImage-3.0"和"无限之星"等图像和视频自相递进模型的广泛探究表明,本地化位置既可被解释,又与概念的出现有因果关系. 在这些洞察力的基础上,我们把本地化方法应用到三个关键应用上:概念去除,模型个性化,和对抗性的概念注入. 实验表明,我们有针对性的干预取得了最新业绩,大大减少了计算间接费用,同时保持了良性效用。 总体而言,我们的调查结果提供了对概念知识如何在自动递减生成过程中的路由的深刻见解,为更可解释、高效和安全的适应引入了实用途径。

articles.title: EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis
articles.content: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical cohorts with distinct scanner geometries and projection sources. For JUST, the physics constraints used measured clinical raw CBCT projections acquired with an Elekta system, whereas for SynthRAD2025 the projection data were simulated from the reference CT using a Varian geometry with Poisson photon statistics. EPC-RawDC achieved an SSIM of 0.97 in both cohorts and improved PSNR over DDPM by 2.66 dB on SynthRAD2025 and 2.10 dB on JUST, while reducing mean MAE by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. On SynthRAD2025, projection consistency and equivariant errors were reduced by 55.0% and 41.4% relative to DDPM. These results demonstrate that combining a volumetric diffusion prior with scanner geometry and scan specific projection measurements improves quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis across both simulated and measured projection domains. Code available after publication at https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics 将 CBCT 与 Raw Data相容性三维分泌到 CT 图像合成
articles.content_zh: 圆锥束计算成像仪(CBCT)被广泛用于图像引导和适应性放射治疗,但散射、噪音、重建文物和不准确的Hounsfield单元限制了其数量使用。 最近CBCT到CT合成的传播方法在很大程度上仍然是由图像驱动的,对基础获取物理的使用有限. 我们提出EPC-RawDC,这是一个有条件的3D潜在扩散框架,将体积基因模型与来自同一扫描仪特定CBCT前方模型的两个互补限制结合起来。 首先,几何等效投影约束通过通过相应的变换参考预测来监督被合成的CT,利用CBCT前方操作员的旋转等效. 第二,原始数据一致性使用对个人获取的噪音预测测量,作为培训期间的扫描具体监督。 对两个独立的临床组群对该框架进行了评价,这些组群具有独特的扫描仪地缘测量和投影来源。 对于Just来说,所用的物理限制是用一个Elekta系统获得的临床生生CBCT预测,而对于SynthRAD2025来说,投影数据是从参考CT中模拟的,使用了用Poisson光子统计的Varian几何数据。 EPC-RawDC在两个组别中实现了0.97的SSIM,并在SynthRAD2025上的2.66分贝和Just上的2.10分贝上比DDPM改进了PSNR,同时将平均MAE分别减少20.3%和19.0%. 在SynthRAD2025上,相对于DDPM,投影一致性和等效误差分别减少了55.0%和41.4%. 这些结果表明,结合在扫描几何之前的体积扩散和扫描特定投影测量,可以改进CBCT到CT的定量合成,涵盖模拟和被测量的投影领域。 在https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC上公布后可获得代码。

articles.title: Segment Anything Model Based Context Guided Mamba Unet for Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning, requiring both global contextual understanding and fine-grained structural precision. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) demonstrates strong generalization capabilities, its direct application to medical images often lacks domain-specific adaptability. Meanwhile, State Space Models (SSMs)-based methods, such as Mamba, efficiently capture long-range dependencies but may struggle with preserving fine anatomical details. To address these challenges, we propose a segment anything model based context guided mamba unet, SAMBA-UNet, a novel framework that integrates SAM's context knowledge with Mamba's hierarchical feature learning to enhance both global representation and local detail refinement. Specifically, we introduce the Hierarchical Context Enhancement Module (HCEM), an attention-based fusion module that deeply incorporates the multi-level features of SAM and Mamba to improve detail perception and segmentation precision. Additionally, we employ LoRA and Adapter-based fine-tuning to adapt SAM to medical imaging tasks, further enhancing its domain-specific segmentation capability and robustness. We conducted a comprehensive study on several medical segmentation datasets, including Synapse, ISIC17, and ISIC18, evaluating our method across multiple metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMBA-UNet achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively balancing generalization, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency. Our code will be released upon acceptance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 医疗图像分解模式上下文引导的Mamba Unet
articles.content_zh: 医疗图像分解对于临床诊断和治疗规划至关重要,需要全球背景理解和精细结构精确度。 虽然片段"任何物"模型(SAM)表现出了强大的通俗化能力,但其直接应用于医疗图像往往缺乏特定域的可适应性. 同时,以国家空间模型为基础的方法,如曼巴,有效地捕捉了远距离的依赖性,但可能难以保存精细的解剖细节。 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议建立一个基于任何模式的背景指导mamba unet,即SAMBA-UNet,这是一个将SAM的背景知识与Mamba的分级特征学习相结合的新框架,以加强全球代表性和地方细节的完善。 具体来说,我们引入了分层环境增强模块(HCEM),这是一个基于注意力的聚变模块,它深深地融入了SAM和曼巴的多层次特征来提高细节感知和分化精度. 此外,我们利用LORA和适应器进行微调,使SAM适应医疗成像任务,并进一步加强其特定域的分化能力和稳健性。 我们对包括突触、国际标准工业分类17和国际标准工业分类18在内的若干医疗分化数据集进行了全面研究,评估了我们采用多种计量方法的情况。 实验结果表明,SAMBA-UNet实现了最先进的性能,有效平衡了通论,分化精度,计算效率. 我们的代码会在接受后公布

articles.title: DINOv2 for PET: A Pre-Training Domain Benchmark Across Classification, Segmentation, and Prognosis
articles.content: DINO (self-DIstillation with NO labels) has become a stan- dard for self-supervised pre-training, producing features that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks. In medical imaging it has been adopted mainly for radiology (X-ray, CT and MRI), where even natural- image DINO features transfer well. In the literature, these features have been reported to transfer worse to functional imaging such as PET. Yet PET-specific DINO models have barely been introduced, and even less validated across multiple tasks and datasets. We present PET-DINOv2-2D, the first DINOv2 model pre-trained on 2D PET, and benchmark it against open-source encoders: the origi- nal DINOv2 (pre-trained on the LVD-142M natural-image dataset) and OmniRad (pre-trained on CT, MRI and ultrasound). Using the same lightweight heads for every backbone, and despite far less pre-training data, PET-DINOv2-2D matches or outperforms both on three down- stream PET tasks: normal/abnormal classification, lesion segmentation and recurrence-free survival prognosis. Its advantage is largest when few labels are available, suggesting that PET pre-training gives more transferable, label-efficient features. Code is made available at https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DINOv2 用于 PET: 跨分类、分门别类和预测的培训前领域基准
articles.content_zh: DINO(无标签自定式)已成为自我监督的预训的活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活 在医学成像中,它主要用于放射学(X-射线、CT和核磁共振),即使自然-影像DINO特征也能够很好地传递。 在文献中,据报道这些特征转移到PET等功能成像上更糟糕. 然而,针对PET的DINO模型几乎没有被采用,在多个任务和数据集中更没有被验证. 我们提出PET-DINOv2-2D,这是首个在2D PET上预先训练的DINOv2型号,并以开源编码器作为基准:origi-nal DINOv2(在LVD-142M自然图像数据集上预先训练)和OmniRad(在CT,核磁共振和超声波上预先训练). PET-DINOv2-2D使用每个骨干相同的轻量级头部,尽管训练前的数据要少得多,但在三个下行的PET任务上,PET匹配或表现均超过:正常/异常分类,损伤分化和无复发存活预后. 它的优势最大,因为很少有标签可用,这表明PET预训会给出更多可转移,标签效率更高的特征. 守则可在https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/上查阅。

articles.title: Greenscapes: Optimized Vegetation Configurations in Cities
articles.content: Vegetation plays a central role in cities, serving functional roles such as balancing shade and sky exposure, shaping the microclimate, carbon sequestration, and providing acoustic screening. Furthermore, aesthetic choices in landscape styles (formal, modernist, picturesque) are important for citizens' well-being and should be considered in the design of urban landscapes. In this paper, we present a novel method for placing vegetation, ranging from shrubs to large trees, in 3D urban scenes. Our method uses individual lots as input and employs a conditioned Vision-Language Model (VLM) to generate a top-down rendering of vegetation, placing large trees, small trees, and shrubs on lawn areas. This rendering is then converted into a 3D scene by detecting individual plants and selecting appropriate 3D assets. To refine the proposed configurations, we define an optimization loop that keeps the VLM-generated positions fixed after a deterministic feasibility repair and uses CMA-ES to optimize per-instance scale transformations along with discrete vegetation asset substitutions. To define the objective function for the optimization, we evaluate the generated 3D scenes with efficient surrogate models of shade and path-based acoustic exposure. Furthermore, we render in-scene views at each optimization step to compute view-dependent perceptual descriptors, enabling the generation of both aesthetic and functional vegetation layouts for urban scenes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 绿景:优化城市植被配置.
articles.content_zh: 植被在城市中起中心作用,发挥平衡遮荫和天空照射等功能作用,塑造微观气候,固碳,提供声学筛选. 此外,景观风格的审美选择(正规的、现代的、平面的)对于公民的福祉很重要,在设计城市景观时应予以考虑。 在本文中,我们提出了一种将从灌木到大树的植被放入3D城市场景的新颖方法. 我们的方法使用单个地块作为输入,并使用有条件的VLM-Langage Model(VLM)生成自上而下地渲染出植被,将大树,小树和灌木放入草地地区. 然后通过探测单个植物并选择适当的3D资产,将这种渲染转化为3D场景. 为了完善提议的配置,我们界定了一个优化循环,使VLM产生的位置在确定可行性修复后保持固定,并使用CMA-ES来优化每层规模的转换以及离散植被资产替代。 为了定义优化的客观功能,我们用高效的代位模型来评价所生成的3D场景的阴影和基于路径的相声曝光. 此外,我们在每个优化步骤上都提出场景,以计算视线依赖的能见度描述符,从而能够为城市场景提供美学和功能性植被布局。

articles.title: How Much Should a VLA Trust Its Reasoning? Step-Level Guidance as a Measured Action-Value Function
articles.content: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) policies write a reasoning trace and then decode the action from it. A wrong trace yields a wrong action, and even a correct-looking trace can mislead the plan. Existing remedies ask whether the reasoning is right. We ask how strongly it should steer. CoC-CFG applies classifier-free guidance between the policy's context and the same context without the reasoning span. One weight per Euler step attenuates or amplifies the reasoning, and w=1 recovers the original policy. We treat the choice of this weight as a Markov decision process whose action values are measured, not bootstrapped. With the expert frozen and the noise fixed, applying a weight for one step and finishing the plan under the current controller returns that weight's value exactly. Q-adaptive guidance fits these values with small critics and improves the controller conservatively. In the Alpasim driving simulator it outperforms every fixed weight and online RL (SAC, GRPO) in open loop, and in closed loop it passes 262 of 300 scenes, against 252 for the original policy. On held-out frames of the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, its first three stages outperform every fixed weight, four adaptive-guidance methods, SAC and GRPO. On the hidden test set, a frozen Alpamayo 1.5 with rule-based camera and vehicle conversions and Q-adaptive guidance sets a new state of the art among published methods: 8.135159 rater feedback score, against 8.079 for the best published method.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个VLA信托基金应该有多少理由? 作为衡量行动价值函数的分级指导
articles.content_zh: 理性视觉-语言-行动(VLA)政策写出推理追踪,然后从中解码动作. 错误的踪迹会产生错误的行动,甚至正确的目光也会误导计划. 现有补救办法询问推理是否正确。 我们问,它应如何有力地指导。 CoC-CFG在不设推理跨度的情况下,在政策上下文和同一上下文之间适用无分类器指导. 每欧勒一克会削弱或放大推理,而w=1则会恢复原来的政策. 我们把这种权重的选择当作一个马可夫决定过程,它的动作值是被测量的,而不是被拖出. 随着专家被冻结,噪音被固定,一个步骤应用了权重,然后在目前的控制器下完成计划,准确返回权重值. Q-适应性引导与小批评者相匹配这些值,并保守地改进了控制器. 在阿尔帕西姆驱动模拟器中,它的表现超过了每一个固定重量和在线RL(SAC,GRPO)的公开循环,在封闭循环中,它通过300个场景中的262个场景,而原政策为252个. 关于Waymo端到端驱动基准的搁置框架,其前三个阶段的绩效超过每个固定重量,四个适应性指导方法,即SAC和GPRO。 在隐藏的测试集上,一款有基于规则相机和车辆转换和Q适应制导的被冷冻的阿尔帕马约1.5在已公布的方法中设定了一个新的最先进水平:8.135159的评分反馈分数,而最佳被公布的方法为8.079分.

articles.title: Blind Video Denoising for Vocal Tract rtMRI using a Self-Supervised Ensemble
articles.content: Real-time magnetic resonance imaging of the vocal tract makes speech articulation directly observable, but the trade-off between temporal resolution and signal quality introduces substantial noise and obscures fine articulatory detail. Since clean references cannot be acquired for a moving vocal tract, supervised denoising approaches are not applicable in this setting. We propose a self-supervised denoising framework that combines spatiotemporal super-resolution learning with pseudo-supervision derived from a variance-stabilized non-local means filter. A dual-model fusion strategy balances noise suppression and preservation of high-frequency articulatory structure. Experiments on the USC-75 multi-speaker dataset under natural noise conditions show that the ensemble raises the signal-to-noise ratio by 11.9 dB on unseen subjects while attaining more high-frequency articulatory content in the frames. Among tuned implementations of anisotropic diffusion, block-matching filtering, non-local means and pre-smoothed non-local means, every configuration that achieves comparable noise suppression does so at the cost of high-frequency content or of structural fidelity. Under severe added Gaussian, Rayleigh and Rician noise, peak signal-to-noise ratio improves by 7.6 to 11.8 dB and structural similarity roughly triples. An ablation shows that the variance-stabilized pseudo-supervision is an essential element for denoising, and that the effect is attributable to the hard thresholding contained in the stabilization transform.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Blind Video Denoising for Vocal Tract rtMRI 使用自导自演集
articles.content_zh: 声道的实时磁共振成像可以使语音表达直接被观察到,但时间分辨率和信号质量之间的取舍引入了实质性噪声并模糊了精细的动画细节. 由于移动的声道无法获得干净的参考文献,因此在此情况下不适用受监督的发音方法。 我们提出一个自我监督的去诺化框架,将spatiopal超分辨率学习与从差异稳定的非局部手段滤波器所衍生出的伪高超视觉相结合. 双模型聚变战略平衡了噪音抑制和高频动脉结构的保存. 在自然噪声条件下的USC-75多语种数据集上进行的实验表明,综艺在未见主体上将信号与噪声之比提高了11.9分贝,同时在框中实现了更高频的动脉内涵. 在调谐地实施异同位素扩散、块相配过滤、非局部手段和先发制人的非局部手段中,每个达到类似噪声抑制的配置都以高频含量或结构忠诚为代价。 在严重的加高斯语,雷利语和里克语噪声下,峰值信号-噪声比提高了7.6到11.8分贝,结构相似性大致为三相. 减值表明,差异稳定伪超视是去诺效应的基本要素,其影响可归因于稳定变形中包含的硬门槛.

articles.title: Mind The Gap (MTG-AD): Dataset and Fine-grained Evaluation for End-to-End Inline Audio Descriptions
articles.content: Audio descriptions (AD) are essential for making visual media accessible to blind and low-vision (BLV) users. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a scalable solution for generating audio descriptions on-demand, their performance on ``inline'' audio descriptions -- which must fit within existing silences in a video -- remains under-explored, particularly for diverse user-generated content (UGC). We present a comprehensive investigation into MLLM-generated inline audio descriptions. First, we introduce MTG-AD, a professionally annotated dataset of 36 hours of videos, each averaging $\sim$5 mins. and 8k+ descriptions in total, co-created by paired blind and sighted AD professionals to provide a high-quality benchmark for this task. Second, we propose MTG-AD-Eval, an evaluation framework based on audio description expert guidelines that provides fine-grained, reference-free actionable metrics for model improvement. Crucially, our framework evaluates the end-to-end task: it renders the generated scripts into audio tracks to assess their fit within the original video's natural silences, minimizing disruptive overlaps. Our analysis across frontier MLLMs reveals that while models accurately describe visual events and substantially reduce speech overlaps, gaps persist in narrative pacing and flow. Finally, we empirically validate that our automated and reference-free metrics correlate significantly with human quality ratings from sighted raters and 7 BLV participants, finding that while users narrowly prefer human-authored audio descriptions, they find MLLM-generated audio descriptions highly beneficial for comprehension. We provide actionable system design guidance and release MTG-AD at https://hf.co/datasets/google/mind-the-gap-inline-ad and MTG-AD-Eval at https://github.com/google/mtg-ad.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Mind The Chap (MTG-AD): 端到端内置音频描述的数据集和精细评价
articles.content_zh: 音频描述(AD)对于盲人和低视(BLV)用户无障碍使用视觉媒体至关重要. 虽然多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)为按需生成音频描述提供了一个可扩展的解决方案,但其在“inline”音频描述上的性能 -- -- 必须与视频中的现有沉默一致 -- -- 仍然没有得到充分利用,特别是对于用户生成的多种内容(UGC)而言。 我们对MLLM产生的内含音频描述进行全面调查。 首先,我们介绍MTG-AD,一个由36小时视频组成的专业附加说明的数据集,每集平均5分。 和8k+的描述,由双盲和有视力的AD专业人员共同创建,为这项任务提供高质量的基准. 第二,我们提出MTG-AD-Eval,这是一个基于音频描述专家准则的评价框架,为模型改进提供了精细、无参考可操作的衡量标准。 关键是,我们的框架评价了端到端的任务:它使生成的脚本被收录入音频轨道,以评估它们是否适合原视频的自然沉默,将破坏性重叠降到最低. 我们跨越前沿的MLLMs的分析表明,虽然模型准确地描述了视觉事件并大大减少了语音重叠,但在叙事速度和流量方面仍然存在差距. 最后,我们通过经验验证,我们的自动化和无参考度的衡量标准与视觉测评人和7名BLV参与者的人类质量评级密切相关,发现虽然用户狭隘地倾向于人类授权的音频描述,但他们认为MLLM生成的音频描述非常有利于理解。 我们在https://hf.co/datasets/google/mind-the-gap-inline-ad和MTG-AD-Eval上提供可操作的系统设计指导并发布MTG-AD。

articles.title: UniRA: Unified Representation Alignment and Auto-Encoding for Efficient Diffusion Generation
articles.content: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image synthesis, yet they suffer from slow training convergence and high computational cost. Two recent lines of work address this from complementary angles: Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates DiT training by aligning intermediate features with a pretrained external representation model (e.g., DINOv2), while Representation Auto-Encoders (RAE) replace the pixel-space VAE with a compact representation-space tokenizer learned from self-supervised features. However, these approaches are developed and applied in isolation: REPA still relies on a pixel-space VAE for latent diffusion, and RAE does not exploit the alignment signal that accelerates the diffusion backbone. We present \textbf{UniRA}, a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective. UniRA learns a representation-space tokenizer whose output serves simultaneously as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so the tokenizer, the diffusion backbone, and the external representation model are co-optimized. We give a theoretical result showing that this joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model while accelerating diffusion convergence, and we derive a principled weighting that balances the reconstruction, alignment, and generation objectives. On ImageNet class-conditional generation at 256*256 and 512*512, UniRA matches or surpasses state-of-the-art DiTs (SD3, REPA, RAE) in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5*. We further show that the unified representation space supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a shared, aligned latent space.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UniRA: 用于高效传播生成的统一代表对接和自动编码
articles.content_zh: 分化变压器(DiTs)已经成为高真能图像合成的主导架构,然而它们却遭遇了训练缓慢的趋同和高计算成本. 最近两条工作线从互补角度解决了这个问题:通过将中间特性与预先训练的外部代表模型(如DINov2)相接来加速DiT培训,而代表自动编码器(RAE)则用从自我监督的特性中学习的紧凑的表示-空间表示器来取而代之. 然而,这些方法是孤立地制定和应用的: REPA仍然依靠像素-空间VAE进行潜在扩散,RAE没有利用加速扩散主干线的对接信号. 我们提出\textbf{UniRA},一个统一的框架,使夫妇代表的协调和代表自动编码为一个单一的目标。 UniRA学习了一种表示-空间表示器,其输出同时作为扩散靶和对齐主锚,因此表示器,扩散主干线,以及外部表示模型被协同优化. 我们给出了一个理论结果,表明这种联合优化在加快传播趋同的同时保持了外部模式的代表性质量,我们得出了平衡重建、调整和生成目标的原则性加权。 在ImageNet的类条件生成时为256*256和512*512,UnirA匹配或超过FID中最先进的DiTs(SD3,REPA,RAE),同时将培训步骤减少至5*. 我们进一步表明,统一代表空间支持改进零射分级和线性测试,确认生成和理解受益于共享、一致的潜在空间。

articles.title: ElasticFormer: Detecting Objects in HRW Shots via Elastic Computing Vision Transformer
articles.content: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and diverse target counts. This makes traditional close-up detectors inaccurate and slow as they are overwhelmed by the background. Although previous research has explored sparse backbones, their fixed sparsity patterns lack the adaptability required to handle diverse target numbers. To address this, we introduce ElasticFormer, a sparse backbone that dynamically allocates computational resources based on foreground proportion. After scoring windows based on variance, proposed ElasticSelector module will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selection. The mechanism guides the model to select target-containing windows, scaling resources in areas where objects are clustered. We introduce a novel loss function combined with the 3-phase training strategy for ElasticSelector, allowing it to function properly when bounding box annotations are missing. A WSOD study is carried on PASCAL VOC 2007 to evaluate its extensibility. Further, ElasticNet is created to verify its backbone-agnostic nature. In experiments on the PANDA gigapixel benchmark, ElasticFormer reduces backbone FLOPs by 80% while achieving a significant improvement in AP50 when compared to fixed-ratio sparse methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 弹性前置:通过弹性计算视觉变形器在人权观察拍摄中检测物体
articles.content_zh: 最近千兆像素级成像工作的进展,使高分辨率宽镜头成为研究的前沿。 然而,这些图像提出了重大挑战:前景的极端模糊;千兆像素级分辨率和各种目标计数。 这使得传统的特写探测器不准确而缓慢,因为它们被背景所压倒. 尽管之前的研究探索了稀有的骨干,但其固定的筋挛模式缺乏处理不同目标数所需的适应性. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了ElasticFormer, 一个稀有的主干线,根据前景比例动态分配计算资源. 在基于差异的评分窗口后,所拟议的ElasticSelector模块会预测出顶-k选择的前景比例. 该机制指导模型选择包含目标的窗口,在对象集群的区域缩放资源. 我们引入了一种新的损失功能,结合了“弹性选择器”的三相培训策略,使其在框注缺失时能够正常运行。 对2007年PASCAL VOC进行了WSOD研究,以评估其扩展性。 此外,还创建了弹性网络,以验证其骨干不可知性。 在PANDA Gigapixel基准的实验中,ElasticFormer将骨干FLOP减少了80%,同时与固定比例稀有方法相比,AP50取得了显著的改进.

articles.title: BiHashFormer: Hash-Driven Dual-Branch Transformer for Efficient Object Detection in HRW Shots
articles.content: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and interleaving of foreground and background. This causes traditional detectors and attention mechanisms to be hindered by background, resulting in inefficiency and inaccuracy. To tackle this problem, we propose BiHashFormer, a dual sparsified branch transformer built on hashing. RoI Selector will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selecting target-containing windows. The compression branch processes windows selected and refines attention into HashAttention by discarding half of the key-value pairs, reducing cost and improving efficiency. The compensation branch uses HashMiner to perform low-cost hash searches in the remaining regions, recovering features of missed objects. Experiments confirm that the selection relationship in HashAttention is one-way and reveal the preference of different queries for keys. In experiments on the gigapixel benchmark PANDA, BiHashFormer reduces 37.5% backbone FLOPs while improving AP50 to 81.0%. Moreover, this parallel dual-branch structure allows the model to avoid inference delays caused by inter-branch dependencies, while achieving much greater stability than single-branch models, specially with low rates of RoI selection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 波黑前身: Hash-Driven 用于在人权观察拍摄中有效检测物体的双块变压器
articles.content_zh: 最近千兆像素级成像工作的进展,使高分辨率宽镜头成为研究的前沿。 然而,这些图像带来了重大挑战:前地的极端伸缩、千兆像素级分辨率以及前地和背景的交接。 这导致传统的探测器和注意机制受到背景的阻碍,导致效率低下和不准确。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议波黑铸币局(BHAHashFORmer),一个以散列为主的双螺旋分枝变压器。 RoI 选择器将预测顶端- k 选择目标窗口的前景比例 。 压缩分支处理窗口通过丢弃一半的密钥值对,降低成本并提高效率来选择和完善注意力入HashAtthy. 补偿处利用Hashminer在其余区域进行低成本散列搜索,恢复被丢失物体的特征. 实验证实HashAttenty中的选择关系是单向的,并揭示了不同查询键的偏好. 在千兆像素基准PANDA的实验中,波黑Former将骨干FLOP降低37.5%,同时将AP50提高到81.0%. 此外,这种平行的双分支结构使模型能够避免由分支间依赖引起的推论延迟,同时实现比单分支模型更大的稳定性,特别是RoI选择率低.

articles.title: MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments
articles.content: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MLLM-GS:在极端环境中的多模式大语言模型前导快取小说视图合成
articles.content_zh: 退化场景中的小说取景合成(NVS)旨在从受各种退化影响的多景观测中再现出3D场景,并生成清晰而光现实的画面取景于看不见的视点. 尽管最近取得了进展,但现有方法往往依赖针对退化的模式,限制了它们在不同极端环境中的概括。 基因模型提供了丰富的视觉前兆,但其输出往往会受像素错位和色彩偏差的影响,这可以被传播到被重建的3D场景并损害重建质量. 此外,3D重建的高计算和内存成本阻碍了NVS在极端环境中的实际应用. 为此,我们提出MLLM-GS,这是在极端环境中快速NVS的多式大型语言模型(MLM)的前导框架. MLLM-GS由两个分支组成:MLLM前导取景增强和快取3D场景重建. 前者利用被冷冻的MLLM丰富的视觉前科来增强不同严重降解下的观点,并引入了轻量级的校正网络来减少MLLM输出中像素相变和颜色扭曲. 在仅从少数对等的干净观点进行监督的情况下,这个分支会为所有退化的观测产生可靠的增强观点,为之后的3D重建提供伪GT观点. 后者通过优化光栅化,高斯内存布局,和参数更新来提高3DGS的效率,减少冗余计算,内存访问间接费用,并优化成本. 对多场退化场景的广泛实验表明,MLLM-GS能有效处理各种严重退化,并实现高质量的NVS,重建时间和记忆消耗明显降低. 项目网页:https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS

articles.title: Spectral Invariant Fusion and Refinement for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: Domain generalized semantic segmentation is challenging because it requires accurate dense prediction on unseen domains without any access to target-domain data during training. Existing methods improve transferability through data diversification, invariant learning, or direct use of foundation models, but they often struggle to simultaneously suppress domain-sensitive interference and preserve fine-grained spatial cues. In this work, we propose SIFR, a frequency-aware dual-stream framework that tackles domain shift at both the fusion and decoding stages. SIFR uses spectral modeling as a unified principle to regulate both heterogeneous prior interaction and dense decoder refinement. Instead of directly fusing frozen CLIP and DINOv2 features, SIFR performs spectral-guided invariant fusion to filter out domain-sensitive responses while preserving complementary semantic and structural information. In addition, SIFR incorporates a spectral decoder refinement module that stabilizes multi-scale decoder features through low-frequency statistics-based normalization and adaptive frequency selection, thereby reducing the propagation of residual domain bias in dense prediction. This design enables SIFR to jointly improve domain robustness and segmentation precision under severe distribution shifts. Extensive experiments on multiple DGSS benchmarks, including synthetic-to-real, real-to-real, and adverse-weather settings, demonstrate consistent improvements over previous state-of-the-art methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 域名通用语义分解的分化和精准化
articles.content_zh: 域名通俗语义分解具有挑战性,因为它要求在未见域上准确的密集预测,在训练期间无法获取目标域数据。 现有方法通过数据多样化,无常的学习,或直接使用地基模型来提高可转移性,但它们往往会同时努力抑制对域敏感的干扰并保存精细的地基空间提示. 在这项工作中,我们提出SIFR,一个能分频感知到的双流框架,在聚变和解码两个阶段处理域位相变. SIFR将光谱模型作为统一的原则来规范多相的前期相互作用和密集的解码器完善. SIFR没有直接使被冻结的CLIP和DINOv2特性相接,而是进行光谱导出变异聚变来过滤出域敏感响应,同时保留互补的语义和结构信息. 此外,SIFR还包含一个光谱解码器完善模块,通过以低频统计为基础的常态化和适应频率选择来稳定多尺度解码器特征,从而减少在密集预测中剩余域偏差的传播. 这种设计使得SIFR能够在严重的分布转移下共同提高域稳和分化精度. 对多种DGSS基准的广泛实验,包括合成-现实、真实-现实和不利-天气环境,显示出与以往最新方法相比的不断改进。

articles.title: PhysAg3D: Bridging 3D Generative and Agentic Models for High-Fidelity and Physically-Interactive Assets
articles.content: Generating interactive 3D assets from a single image requires realistic appearance, fidelity to the depicted object, and plausible physical behavior. Yet detailed geometry alone does not determine how an object should move or deform. We introduce PhysAg3D, which couples 3D generative models with agentic reasoning and tool use. A vision-language agent first infers semantic parts, candidate interactions, and physical priors from the image; a 3D generator then produces a textured whole-object mesh from the same image. A hierarchical interaction representation links these revisable priors to mechanisms and the generated surfaces they control, organizing interaction construction and refinement. Guided by this representation and observations of the mesh, the agent uses geometric and physical tools to construct parts, joints, deformable regions, and surface bindings while retaining useful generated geometry and materials. Rendered interactions and execution measurements guide targeted revisions within a fixed budget. The framework accommodates both rigid articulation and compliant deformation. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on real photographs and external benchmarks demonstrate detailed, image-aligned assets with plausible interactions. Ablations support bounded refinement and source-surface preservation. Project Page: supra-3d.github.io/PhysAg3D.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PhysAg3D:用于高密和物理交互资产的3D基因模型和活性模型
articles.content_zh: 从单一图像中生成交互式的3D资产需要现实的外观,对被描绘对象的忠诚,以及可信的物理行为. 然而,仅是详细的几何并不能确定物体应如何移动或变形。 我们介绍PhysAg3D, 夫妇3D基因模型 具有代理推理和使用工具。 一个视觉语言剂首先从图像中推断出语义部分,候选相互作用,以及物理前缀;一个3D生成器然后从同一张图像中生成一个有文字的全对象网. 分级的相互作用表现将这些可追溯的前科与机制及其控制的所生成的表面联系起来,组织相互作用的构建和完善. 以这种对网状物的表示和观测为取向,物剂使用几何和物理工具来构筑零件,关节,可变形区和地表绑定物,同时保留有用的生成的几何和材料. 互动和执行计量指导在固定预算中进行有针对性的修订。 该框架既包括僵硬的表述,也包括符合要求的变形。 对真实照片和外部基准进行定量和定性评价,显示出详细、与图像相匹配、有合理互动作用的资产。 差额支持有限度地改进和源地表保护。 项目页: 上-3d.github.io/PhysAg3D。

articles.title: TokenRepel: Generating Diverse Image Sets Without Compromising Quality
articles.content: We present an inference-time approach that enhances the visual diversity of image sets generated by text-to-image models, without compromising the average image quality. Our method leverages the intrinsic geometry of hidden representations in pretrained models to diversify images generated from the same prompt. First, we introduce a token repulsion mechanism that increases the angle between feature tokens across samples. It takes a negative Riemannian gradient step on a von Mises-Fisher mixture distribution of tokens on the unit hypersphere. Second, to preserve the quality of each output image, we propose a token density preservation mechanism that projects the repulsion-induced prediction change onto a half-space aligned with the model's score direction. This encourages the updates to remain within the high-density regions learned by the generative model. We further extend this mechanism to the output of each intermediate layer, enabling finer-grained iterative guidance. We evaluate our method on three types of pretrained text-to-image models. Experiments show substantial gains in visual diversity under identical prompts, while maintaining a comparable level of image fidelity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TokenRepel: 生成多样的图像集而不损害质量
articles.content_zh: 我们提出了一个推论-时间方法,在不损害平均图像质量的前提下,增强由文本到图像模型生成的图像集的视觉多样性. 我们的方法利用了预先训练过的模型中隐藏的表达的内在几何学,使从同一提示产生的图像多样化. 首先,我们引入了一种符号反推机制,它增加了特征符号之间跨样本的角度. 它在单位超相圈上对一个冯·米塞斯-费舍(英语:Von Misses-Fisher)的代币混合分布进行负的里曼梯度步骤. 其次,为了保持每个输出图像的质量,我们提出了一个象征性的密度保存机制,将反推引发的预测变化投射到与模型的分数方向一致的半个空间上. 这鼓励将更新保留在基因模型所学的高密度区域。 我们进一步将这一机制扩大到每个中间层的输出,从而能够提供更精细的迭接指导。 我们评价我们的方法 三种类型的 预先训练的文本到图像模型。 实验显示,在相同的提示下,视觉多样性有了很大进步,同时保持了相当水平的图像忠实。

articles.title: sDMD: Sinkhorn Distribution Matching Distillation
articles.content: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) distills multi-step diffusion models into few-step generators by minimizing reverse KL divergence. Despite its strong performance, DMD guides samples by local density alone, which introduces two limitations: teacher scores can be unreliable in regions of low teacher density, and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can collapse the student onto a subset of the teacher modes. We first connect DMD to Wasserstein gradient flow, showing that its gradient follows from a fixed-point formulation with integral KL (IKL) as the energy functional. This perspective motivates augmenting IKL with an optimal transport term that addresses these limitations by guiding outlier samples toward the target and promoting mode coverage. We realize this term using Sinkhorn divergence estimated from finite batches. In practice, however, errors in the estimated Sinkhorn velocity can perturb in-domain samples for which IKL guidance is already accurate. To this end, we introduce sDMD, which adaptively activates the Sinkhorn correction based on discriminator outputs, focusing on outlier samples where IKL may be unreliable. With 2--4 sampling steps on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image-20B, and Wan2.1-14B, sDMD outperforms distillation baselines on GenEval, DPG, WISE, and VBench while improving sample diversity over DMD2.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SDMD: Sinkhorn 分布匹配抖动
articles.content_zh: 分布相匹配分解(DMD)通过将逆向KL相差最小化,将多步分解模型分解为几步分解出. 尽管表现很强,但DMD仅通过局部密度来引导样本,这引入了两个限制:教师分数在教师密度低的地区可能不可靠,而逆向KL的寻模式行为可以使学生倒向教师模式的一个子集. 我们首先将 DMD 与 Wasserstein 梯度流连接起来, 显示它的梯度来自一个固定点的配方, 以 整体 KL (IKL) 作为能量功能. 这种观点通过引导外部样本向目标走去并推广模式覆盖,用一个解决这些局限性的最佳运输术语来增强IKL。 我们用Sinkhorn从有限的批量中估计出来的分量来认识这个术语。 然而,在实践中,估计Sinkhorn速度的误差可以干扰IKL指导已经准确的域内样品。 为此,我们引入了SDMD,它根据歧义输出,适应性地激活了辛克霍恩校正,专注于IKL可能不可靠的外围样本. 在FLUX.1-dev、Quen-Image-20B和Wan2.1-14B上的2-4个取样步骤下,SDMD在GenEval、DPG、WISE和V Bench上的分馏基线超过了业绩,同时在DMD2上改进了样品多样性。

articles.title: What Survives Label Downsampling? Exact Region Survival for Coarse Segmentation Targets
articles.content: Segmentation networks that predict at an output stride are trained against label maps downsampled by strided sampling, nearest-neighbor resampling or majority pooling. These methods label each coarse grid cell on its own, so a region that wins no cell is absent from the target and receives no positive label. We present MatchDown, which builds the coarse target from a minimum-cost matching between regions and the grid cells they occupy. It keeps as many regions as any one-region-per-cell target can, certifies how many losses are unavoidable, and with priority tiers (MatchDown-P) keeps every evaluated region (a region that a metric scores) of at least one cell's area. On COCO, Cityscapes and BBBC038 at factors 2 to 16, MatchDown-P loses exactly the minimum number of regions, whereas the downsampling used by StarDist, nnU-Net and connectomics pyramids loses four to five times as many on COCO at factor 8. Keeping a region in the target and reconstructing its shape are different problems: we show that no region lost by majority pooling can be reconstructed above IoU 0.5 by upsampling any coarse target, yet on BBBC038 a star-convex head trained on MatchDown targets segments 35% of the nuclei that majority pooling loses above IoU 0.5, against 15% when trained on majority targets and 24% on StarDist's strided target. On two nucleus datasets, with thresholds cross-validated for count error, this head has instance accuracy at IoU 0.5 (Acc50) 2.6 to 4.2 points above the strided target and at most 2.8 points below cell-center sampling, and a lower count error than the strided and cell-center targets on BBBC039. On BBBC039, an affinity head, which outputs one label per cell, lowers count error relative to majority targets by 9.3 nuclei per image at 7.2 points lower Acc50. MatchDown runs once, before training, in place of the label-downsampling step.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 什么活生生的标签 唐斯普林? 粗细分化目标精确区域生存
articles.content_zh: 在输出步道上预测的分块网络根据被分块取样、近邻再取样或多数集合所取样的标签地图进行培训。 这些方法将每个粗网格细胞单独贴上标签,因此一个没有胜出细胞的区域不会从目标中消失,也不会得到正标签. 我们介绍MatchDown,它从最小成本在区域与它们占据的网格细胞之间匹配来构建粗细的目标. 它保持了任何一个区域每个细胞目标所能保持的尽可能多的区域,证明有多少损失是不可避免的,并且有优先级(MatchDown-P)将每个被评价的区域(一个至少一个细胞面积的分数为一分的区域)保留下来. 在COCO, Cityscapes和BBBC038的系数2至16中,MatchDown-P损失了精确的最小区域数,而StarDist,nnU-Net和连通相机金字塔使用的下采样在COCO上损失了4至5倍的系数. 8. 联合国 将一个区域保留在目标上并重建其形状是不同的问题:我们显示,大多数集合失去的区域,任何粗细的目标都无法在IoU 0.5以上重建,然而在BBBC 038上,一个星孔头在MatchDown目标区段接受过训练,而大多数集合失去的核部分35%在IoU 0.5以上,而在多数目标区(StarDist)被训练时为15%,在StarDist所标定的目标上为24%。 在两个核心数据集上,由于计数出错的阈值交叉验证,这个头在IoU 0.5(Acc50)上比标定目标高2.6至4.2分,在细胞中心采样下最多2.8分,且比BBC039上标定和细胞中心取标的计数出错更低. 在BBC039上,一个亲和头,每个单元格输出一个标签,相对于多数目标,在下Acc50的7.2分上将每个图像的9.3个核数误差降低. 匹配 下行一次,训练前,取而代之的是"标签下采样"步骤.

articles.title: Parametric Gaussian Noise Mixer (PGNM): Unified Synthesis of Camera Noise and Film Grain
articles.content: Noise synthesis is commonly approached through physical models of image formation or neural networks trained to generate noisy images. We explore a middle ground: an explicit statistical model fitted directly from paired clean and noisy images. A normalized convolution correlates a Gaussian field across pixels and color channels, and a lookup maps each Gaussian value to a residual given the clean intensity. Because the field stays standard Gaussian, the two components are fitted separately, without reproducing the physical process or training a neural generator. With one formulation for camera noise from SIDD and simulated film grain from Newson, the model has the lowest average distribution and correlation errors on SIDD among the evaluated methods and remains competitive on film grain. A denoiser trained on its noise comes closest to one trained on real noise, and a 1080p frame renders in 10 ms on GPU.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 参数高斯噪音混合器(PGNM):相机噪音和相片谷物的统一合成
articles.content_zh: 噪声合成通常通过图像形成或神经网络的物理模型来进行,这些模型经过培训,可以生成吵闹的图像. 我们探索一个中间点:一个直接取自一对干净而吵闹的图像的明确的统计模型。 一个正常的演化将一个高斯场连接到像素和色道之间,并且将每个高斯场的值与一个残留值相匹配,因为强度是干净的。 由于球场保留了标准的高斯人,因此两个组件是分开安装的,没有复制物理过程或训练神经发生器. 该模型有一个来自SIDD的相机噪声配方和来自Newson的模拟胶片谷粒配方,在评价方法中SIDD的平均分布和相干误差最低,在胶片谷粒上仍然具有竞争力. 一个受过噪音训练的Denoiser最接近一个受过真正噪音训练的Denoiser,一个1080p相框在GPU上以10ms来制取.

articles.title: M-PFT: Angular Margin for Calibrated Prompt-Tuning of Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Prompt-tuning has emerged as a parameter-efficient technique for adapting large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks while keeping the pre-trained weights frozen. However, prompt-tuned VLMs often suffer from a base-to-novel dual miscalibration problem, where models typically show underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes. Current VLM calibration approaches address this dual miscalibration either separately or jointly, but lack a geometric understanding of the hyperspherical embedding space and thus fail to exploit angular discriminative properties to adjust distorted decision boundaries. To address this, we propose M-PFT, a novel angular-margin approach for prompt tuning that introduces two complementary objectives to promote class discriminability and semantic anchoring. This enlarges the angular margin by 1) minimizing the maximum cosine similarity between tunable class embeddings to reduce embedding collapse and 2) minimizing the angular distance between each tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding to preserve semantic geometry. Extensive experiments across 9 prompt-tuning methods with various backbones on 15 diverse datasets show that our approach reduces the average calibration error on novel classes, while remaining competitive on base classes and maintaining comparable accuracy. Further analyses reveal that M-PFT effectively adjusts distorted decision boundaries induced by prompt tuning while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, improving calibration with negligible computational overhead.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: M-PFT:用于校准精细透视-语言模型的角边
articles.content_zh: 即时调制已经成为一种参数效率高的技术,用于使大型视觉语言模型(VLMs)适应下游的任务,同时使预先训练的重量被冻结. 然而,即时调取的VLM经常会遇到从基础到小的双重校正问题,模型通常表现出对基础课的不信任和对小说课的过度自信. 目前的VLM校正方法可以分别或联合地解决这种双重校正错误,但对超球形嵌入空间缺乏几何理解,因此无法利用角分辨性来调整被扭曲的决定边界. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用M-PFT这一新的角-边距方法来迅速调整,引入两个相辅相成的目标来推动阶级歧视性和语义定位。 这扩大了角边:1)将可捕金枪鱼类嵌入物的最大同位素相似性最小化,以减少嵌入倒塌;2)将可捕金枪鱼类嵌入物与相应零发入物之间的角相距最小化,以保留语义几何. 9个快速调试方法在15个不同数据集上进行了广泛的实验,显示我们的方法减少了小说类的平均校正误差,同时保持了基础类的竞争能力并保持了可比较的准确性. 进一步的分析表明,M-PFT在保持预先训练的嵌入空间的同时,有效地调整了通过即时调取而引发的扭曲的决定界限,用可忽略不计的计算间接费用改进了校正.

articles.title: Open-set multi-view seahorse re-identification from underwater photograph sequences
articles.content: Automated animal re-identification from photograph sequences can facilitate minimally invasive Capture-Mark-Recapture studies at scale. Yet, photographs taken during an observation session can vary greatly in quality, not always providing the necessary information for accurate re-identification. In this paper, we present new methods for taxonomic classification, sex determination, and open-set re-identification from image sequences. We train and evaluate our models on a dataset of 35,914 photographs of 474 individual seahorses observed in the wild. We demonstrate that our approach, by combining information from multiple photographs, yields state-of-the-art performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从水下相片序列中重新识别出多景海马
articles.content_zh: 从相片序列中自动对动物进行重新识别,可以促进规模最小的入侵性捕获-Mark-Capture研究. 然而,在观测过程中拍摄的照片在质量上可能有很大差异,并不总是为准确的重新识别提供必要的信息。 在本文中,我们提出了分类分类分类,性别确定,以及从图像序列中开放设置再识别的新方法. 在野外观测到的474个个体海马的35 914相相片的数据集上,我们训练和评估我们的模型。 我们表明,通过结合多张照片中的信息,我们的做法产生了最先进的性能。

articles.title: LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models
articles.content: LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. The framework supports both 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection through the same engine-service protocol, integrating a task-aware suite of state-of-the-art attacks, including PGD and Square Attack for segmentation, and point perturbation, point removal, point injection, and LiDAttack for detection. This enables systematic exposure of corner cases and vulnerabilities across heterogeneous LiDAR backbones. The LiDAR-Shield codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/alexandrosgk/LiDAR-shield.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LiDAR-SHIELD:基于LiDAR的3D能见度模型的完全多克力克强度评估框架
articles.content_zh: 基于LiDAR的3D感知支撑了自主驱动和机器人,然而安全地部署这些模型则需要在现实世界使用之前,针对对抗性输入进行压力测试. 虽然存在最先进的对抗性攻击,但其执行往往分散于各个存放处,每个存放处都与特定的架构或任务相接并需要人工环境重建和模型特定整合代码。 我们提出LIDARSHIELD,这是一个统一和完全的多克化的框架,它扭转了这一工作流程:LIDARSHIELD不是在工具包内安装目标模型,而是通过三个轻量级的HTTP端点,即/info,/forward,和/gradient,曝光任何模型. 因此,连接一个新的模型或数据集只需要一个单一的加载器功能或适配器. 该框架通过相同的引擎服务协议支持3D语义分解和3D对象检测,整合了一套任务感知最先进的攻击,包括用于分解的PGD和Square Attack,以及用于检测的点触,点取,点入等. 这样,就能够系统地暴露各种LiDAR主干体的角落和脆弱性。 LiDAR-Shield代码库在https://github.com/alexandrosgk/LiDAR-shield上可公开查阅.

articles.title: Aligning Medical Vision Language Models at the Capability Boundary with Entropy Adaptive Rubric Grounding
articles.content: Medical diagnostic reasoning requires verifiable links between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, yet current medical vision language models are aligned with objectives that reward the wrong behavior. Uniform supervised fine tuning lets easy cases dominate updates while clinically critical boundary cases saturate prematurely. Sparse rewards based only on final-answer correctness cannot assess anatomical grounding or clinical logic, inviting reward hacking through answer shortcuts. We propose MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework coupling boundary-aware preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning. First, we construct counterfactual boundary preferences at the model's capability frontier using empirical pass rates and preference pairs that share reasoning prefixes but diverge at decisive diagnostic branches. Difficulty Weighted Boundary Preference Optimization (DBPO) concentrates learning on this calibrated boundary region. Second, we distill reusable clinical rubrics from boundary trajectories and activate them according to prediction entropy. Entropy Gated Grounded Policy Optimization (EGPO) rewards answer correctness, anatomical grounding, and reasoning fidelity while suppressing rubric noise on reliable samples. A reference policy anchored to the boundary-aligned model couples population-level boundary priors with instance-level uncertainty, making diagnostic reasoning more accurate and clinically grounded. Experiments on six medical benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong general, specialized, and reinforcement learning baselines, reaching 61.2% average accuracy with the largest gains on challenging differential diagnosis tasks. Ablations show super-additive gains: combining the two stages exceeds the sum of their individual improvements.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 将医用视觉语言模型在能力边界上与 Entropy 适应性Rubric 地平线对齐
articles.content_zh: 医学诊断推理需要可核查的视觉证据与临床知识之间的联系,然而目前的医学视觉语言模型与奖励错误行为的目标一致. 统一监督的微调使易发病例主导更新,而临床上的关键边界病例过早地饱和. 仅仅基于最终答案正确性的Sparse奖励无法评估解剖地基或临床逻辑,通过答案快捷键邀请奖励黑客. 我们提议MDCBR,一个两阶段的对接框架,将边界感知偏好优化与有分寸的强化学习相结合。 首先,我们在模型的能力前沿构建反事实边界偏好,使用经验通过率和偏好对,这些偏好共享推理前缀,但在决定性的诊断分支上却存在分歧. 难以加权的边界优化(DBPO)将学习集中在这个校准的边界区域上. 其次,我们从边界轨迹中提炼出可重复使用的临床图,并根据预测的 en来激活. Entropy Gated Grounded Political Optimation(EGPO)的奖励回答正确性,解剖地基,以及推理忠心,同时抑制了可靠样本上微小的噪声. 一项参照政策,其基础是边界对接模式的夫妇人口一级边界的前身是实例一级的不确定性,使诊断推理更加准确并基于临床。 对6个医疗基准的实验表明,相对于强健的一般、专门和强化学习基线而言,持续改善,平均准确度达到61.2%,在挑战性差分诊断任务方面取得最大进展。 分解显示超增益:将两个阶段合并,超过各自改进的总和.

articles.title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
articles.content: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark.
