The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 缩小 LM 数据分配的设计空间
articles.content_zh: 语言模型(LMs)的数据归属方法一般使用事实检索等下游任务进行评估. 然而,现有的评价同时不同多个数据集属性,使得无法准确隔离归属算法失败的原因. 为了诊断这些失误,我们探索LLM数据归属的设计空间,主要侧重于评价. 我们采用了 " 控制下归属基准 " (CATT),用于追踪事实,其中我们根据完全虚假的知识对有限责任清单进行微调,为归属提供明确的基础真相。 这种合成设置使我们能够一次系统地改变一个数据集配置,例如文档冗余和词典分光器. 通过这一可描述的评价,我们表明冗余和分散注意力者不断降低归属性能。 我们没有提出新的估算标准,而是审查了两个未得到充分探讨的设计选择:用于计算梯度的损失和如何将每笔归属分数汇总成一个文件分数。 我们发现,训练文件中的真正因果关系是高度本地化的,但标准方法通过在整个文件中平均的归属分数来将这种证据稀释为噪音。 我们发现,用负对数梯度来取代标准跨直径损失梯度,可以从其他非信息化的梯度中看到关键符号。 然后,我们只能将最高的得分汇总起来,以便根据我们的诊断基准,在多个基线中将地面真实性提高35-72个百分点。 负对数校正也概括为FTRACE-TREX,提高了我们测试的每一种方法的反事实再培训性能,最高可达4.9x.

articles.title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
articles.content: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 浅色防御:利用浅色防御系统
articles.content_zh: 安全协调使大型语言模型能够可靠地直接拒绝有害的请求,但在整个多回合对话中分发的同一请求仍然往往成功。 这种脆性有一个机械根:对接很浅,安全行为集中在模型最早的少数输出符上,而现有的防御力继承了弱点,监督反应的表面形式而从未给模型一个明确的安全决定来学习. 我们对浅度持相反的看法:如果一个短的跨度决定了整个反应的轨迹,那么这个跨度是干预的最高杠杆地,捍卫者可以先占领. 我们提议评估美元-决定美元-答复,在这个框架中,辩护人评估用户的意图,承诺作出明确、可解析的安全决定,然后提出答复条件,承诺在有效载荷转弯处通过强化学习加以培训。 由于决定是象征性的跨度,奖励可以是一条规则:自我验证的奖励对照对话的已知性质检查承诺的标签,不需要法官或注释,而同样的格式也支持LLM-asjudge奖励一个等级化的决定空间,安全地重定向. 在整个两个模范家庭和14个涵盖安全、效用和帮助度的基准中,我们的捍卫者在有控制的比较中实现了最强的多回合安全,在安全中保持领先地位,同时以适度的代价保持效用,以取得帮助。 一种可切入的 KL 分析和干预探测器可以证实它为什么起作用: 训练将它的效果集中在确定反应轨迹的简短考虑上,而所承诺的决定是一个因果控制点. 极浅的攻击者利用它成为防御机制。

articles.title: Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses
articles.content: Ask a language model whether sales tend to dip after a product recall, or whether one side effect tends to follow another after a vaccine, and it answers in a fluent sentence that reads like a finding, with no test behind it. Assertions about how events unfold across many cases fill the Web, and each is a temporal hypothesis that only a significance test over the right records can settle. The verifier must specify the null, select the test and decide which records bear on the hypothesis, and any of these choices can go wrong while the conclusion still comes out right. Yet benchmarks for language-model data analysis grade only the conclusion, with the relevant data handed over. We study the problem in health, where a wrong verdict is costly, and present STRATA, a benchmark that grades every decision on the way to a verdict: 8,735 hypotheses over the clinical timelines of vaccine adverse-event reports, with gold plans, evidence sets, p-values and verdicts derived under a released codebook and reproduced by a deterministic oracle. We also propose ART (articulate, retrieve, test), a staged paradigm that exposes each decision as an inspectable output. Extensive experiments with five model configurations show that systems fail mostly at choosing which records count, a verdict-evidence gap that accuracy alone conceals. ART closes most of this gap and brings a 31B open model to within 0.01 of the frontier models under the same paradigm; the frontier models succeed once given the codebook.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 时间线的证明:对临时临床假说进行证据分析
articles.content_zh: 问一个语言模型,销售在产品召回后是否倾向于下降,或者一个副作用在疫苗后是否倾向于跟随另一个副作用,它用一个流利的句子回答,句子读来像一个发现,后面没有测试. 关于事件如何在很多案件中发生的说法填满了网络,每一个都是时间假说,只有对正确的记录进行意义测试才能解决. 核查者必须指定无效者,选择测试,并决定哪些记录与假设有关,在结论仍然正确时,这些选择中的任何选择都可能出错. 然而,语文模型数据分析的基准仅将结论分级,并附上相关数据。 我们研究健康问题,因为错误判决的代价很高,我们提出STATA, 这个基准是每个判决在判决的道路上的分级: 对疫苗不良事件报告临床时间的8,735个假设,其中黄金计划、证据集、p值和判决都是根据公布的密码本得出的,由决定性的神谕复制。 我们还提出ART(拼接、检索、测试),这是一种将每项决定暴露为可检查产出的分阶段范例。 5个模型配置的广泛实验显示,系统大多在选择哪些记录计数时失败,这个判断-证据差距仅能掩盖准确性。 ART缩小了这一差距的大部分,使31B的开放模型在同一范式下的边疆模型0.01范围内;边疆模型一旦获得密码本就成功.

articles.title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
articles.content: We present TextSeal2, a distortion-free watermark for large language models that keeps its signal under speculative decoding: tokens that replace rejected drafts remain watermarked with the same keys, and the acceptance rate is unchanged. It also preserves output diversity and adds no measurable inference latency. Its predecessor, TextSeal, restores diversity in the Gumbel-max scheme by routing each token to one of two keys via a coin flip. This is suboptimal because the detector averages the scores from both keys without knowing which key was used. TextSeal2 instead merges two or more keys into a single virtual key and couples it to fresh noise through AutoMark's Gaussian copula. Any number of keys, including publicly shared keys, can be merged this way without diluting detection. Under speculative decoding, TextSeal2 verifies keyed drafts with one more exponential race, run on the leftovers of the draft races. By memorylessness, this race reproduces block verification, so the output follows the target model exactly. We evaluate TextSeal2 on three LLMs. At equal output token diversity, TextSeal2 detects 8 to 22 percentage points more 100-token answers than TextSeal at a false-positive rate of $10^{-3}$, and is comparable to textGrain while requiring no post-logits optimization. Under speculative decoding, it detects 18 and 22 percentage points more 200-token answers than TextSeal and textGrain, respectively, at the same acceptance rate.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 文本Seal2: 扭曲- 自由 LLM 带有 Copula 混音和无记忆种族的水印
articles.content_zh: 我们提出TextSeal2,是大型语言模型的无扭曲水印,使其信号处于投机解码状态:取代被否决的草稿的活字符号仍用同一种键作水印,接受率不变. 它还保留了产出的多样性,没有增加可衡量的推断延迟。 其前身"TextSeal"恢复了Gumbel-max图案的多样性,通过硬币翻转将每个令牌通向两个键中的一个. 这是次优的,因为探测器平均从两个键得到的分数,而不知道使用了哪个键. 文本 海豹2取而代之,将两个或两个以上的密钥合并成一个单一的虚拟密钥,并通过AutoMark的"高斯克相接器"(AutoMark's Gaussian codula)将它配给新鲜噪音. 任何数量的密钥,包括公开共享的密钥,都可以这样合并,而不稀释检测. 在投机性的解码下,TextSeal2用再一个指数赛跑来验证被键入的草稿,跑在草稿所剩的赛跑上. 通过失忆,这个种族复制了块验证,因此输出完全遵循了目标模型. 我们评价TextSel2的3个LLM。 在等同输出符的多样性下,TextSeal2检测出比TextSeal多出8到22个百分点的100个托肯答案,假阳性率为10^{-3}$,与textGrain相当而不需要后日志优化. 在投机解码下,它检测出比TextSeal和textGrain分别多出18分和22分的200个托肯答案,接受率相同.

articles.title: When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder
articles.content: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end precision is 0.2387, leaving substantial headroom. A gate pays off through precision and compute, whose saving falls from 4.39x with an 8B generator to 1.38x with a 1B one. The memory profile drives hint quality: removing it costs 24.7 exact-match points (rescaled BERTScore 0.57 to 0.35), while retrieval and a larger generator add nothing on exact match. One 1B decoder can do both, gating from an intermediate layer and generating in the same pass. At its final checkpoint it matches or exceeds the two-model pipelines on automatic end-to-end measures with 1.31-1.76x less wall-clock time than the matched 1B pipeline; across three seeds, its deeper exit ties the separate gate. A human evaluation (1,144 ratings over 32 dialogues) supports the memory effect and rates the single model level with the matched 1B pipeline and below the 8B one. Graded metrics and LlamaPIE's native judge track human ratings more closely than exact match, which we report as a strict lower bound.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 何时协助和提出什么建议:在一个契约解码器中联合取暖和内存取暖
articles.content_zh: 主动助手在谈话中提供简短的,基于内存的提示,决定何时提供帮助和提出什么建议. 目前的系统将这分为一个闸门和一个更大的发电机;我们共同评价28 058个决策点。 相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 一个门通过精度和计算得到回报,其节省额从4.39x与8B发电机相接降至1.38x与1B发电机相接. 内存剖面能驱动提示质量:去掉它需要24.7个精确匹配点(重新调整为BERTScore 0.57到0.35),而检索和更大的生成器则不会在精确匹配上添加任何内容. 1B解码器既可以做到两者兼有,从中间层取出并在同一通路中生成. 在其最后检查站,它与自动端到端措施的双型输油管相匹配或超过双型输油管,比相匹配的1B型输油管少1.31-1.76x的墙上行车时间;通过三个种子,它的更深的出站口连接了独立的出站口. 一个人类评价(超过32个对话的1,144分)支持内存效应并用匹配的1B管和低于8B管的单模型级别进行评分. 分级的度量衡和LlamaPIE的本土评委追踪人类的分数比精确的比分更接近,我们报告这比分更低。

articles.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
articles.content: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VeriCUA:作为计算机使用代理人的代理勘探的核查
articles.content_zh: 跨越桌面、移动和网络环境建立和扩展计算机使用代理,需要对数据整理、评价和强化学习进行可靠的任务完成核查。 典型的自动化方法会促使视觉语言模型(VLMs)来判断轨迹或生成程序来检查应用状态. 然而,两者都依赖于对复杂数字环境的部分观点. VLM法官仅限于提供观察,而生成的程序取决于无障碍状态. 这些意见可能忽略决定性证据,或使完成判决得不到支持。 对不同的平台和访问设置进行单独的核查,增加了进一步的工程成本。 我们介绍VeriCUA,这是一个通过代理人探索进行核查的平台不可知框架。 它将核查视为在跨平台和观测模式的在线和离线设置共同程序范围内的动态证据收集和评估。 在检查可用上下文以构建一个任务标题后,核查者会选择GUI或代码检查未解决的要求,并根据明确的证据规则综合其调查结果. 实验表明,在比较基线的基础上,这些环境的参考标签更加一致,在困难案件中离线收益最大,网上更强烈地拒绝虚假的完成索赔。 进一步的分析将这些成果与补充证据和试验时间探索联系起来。

articles.title: Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation
articles.content: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training, allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. Multi-View further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input, reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. Each selected expert executes one forward pass, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained on 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. Multi-Router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility, with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on both the expert and the token.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多视频 MoE: 让每个路由器形状专家计算
articles.content_zh: Sparse 混合专家模型(MoE)通过激活每个符号的一小群专家来扩展参数能力. 专家的选择直接影响到固定的活跃专家预算下的模型能力。 对所有专家的深入评价表明,单行道排名与专家实用性评价排名之间缺乏一致,特别是在中层和深层。 用于选择和计算的更丰富的信号会产生额外的成本:基于内部专家激活的筛选需要初步计算,而通过同一专家单独处理多个完整的表示则重复其计算. 我们提议多视频部改进多路由器的专家选择,并重新利用他们的偏好,在固定的专家预算下对专家计算进行调制。 其多路透子模块聚合 sigmoid 从独立初始化路由器得分. 这些路由器在培训期间发展出高度差异化的专家偏好,使得专家能够被选取一个路由器或几个路由器共同支持. 多维进一步利用每个被选取的专家跨路由器的相对分数,将所学到的潜在观点混合到其输入中,再用路由偏好进行选择和计算. 每个选定的专家执行一个前行传,保留主动专家计数,专家FLOP,以及所有通信量. 在经过708B道具培训的24层10B-A1B型机上,全多维尤MOE改进了下游九任务平均比基线高出1.18个百分点. 单是多路特就获得0.6个百分点的增益,并改进了路由器分数与评估的专家效用之间的排名关联,全球相对增长8.1%,单路特调整率最低的地层增长约58%. 受控混合干预显示该模型使用了取决于专家和符号的输入差异.

articles.title: PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction
articles.content: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal. Stronger teachers can provide additional guidance, but this raises a central question: how can such signals be incorporated into RLVR to support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student? We distinguish two complementary mechanisms: trajectory-level intervention, which improves access to reward-bearing trajectories, and token-level supervision, which provides dense targets to guide student learning. Our controlled experiments show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient, motivating their combination. We therefore introduce PIVOT, which inserts teacher-generated corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level KL supervision to these segments alongside the RLVR objective. Beyond their combination, we systematically analyze where to intervene and how to supervise, yielding a recipe for effective guidance. Across hard logic games and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PIVOT consistently outperforms existing methods, nearly doubling mean avg@8 on logic games from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PIVOT:通过在线教师矫正逐步干预
articles.content_zh: 从可核查的奖励(RLVR)中加强学习受到对硬推理任务的少量结果层面反馈的限制:当一个团体的所有推出失败时,奖励不会提供学习信号. 强壮的教师可以提供额外的指导,但这提出了一个中心问题:如何将这些信号纳入RLVR,以支持成功的推广,同时让学生能够学习? 我们区分两种互补机制:轨迹层面的干预,这种干预改善了获得奖励的轨迹的机会;和象征性层面的监管,这种监管为指导学生学习提供了密集的目标。 我们的受控实验表明,任何一种机制都可能仍然不足,促使它们结合。 因此,我们引入了PIVOT,它将教师产生的校正纳入学生的推广,并将象征性的KL监督与RLVR目标一起应用于这些部分。 除了两者的结合外,我们系统地分析在哪里进行干预和如何监督,从而产生有效指导的良方。 透过硬逻辑游戏和数学推理基准, PIVOT 持续超越现有方法,

articles.title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
articles.content: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 每个托肯需要自己的老师:多教师适应政策自我调整
articles.content_zh: 实践证明,通过建立以特准推荐为条件的教师,政策上的自我消化(OPSD)对于培训后大型语言模式是有效的。 然而,现行做法要么使教师在整个培训过程中保持固定,始终将教师置于全面参考之下,要么在每项答复中仅通过在答复中不同程度的局部参考接触加以调整。 在这份文件中,我们争辩说,两者都不够。 相反,每个标志都需要自己的老师,因为老师的偏好可以在同一反应中逐一地改变。 通过一项教师干预试点研究,我们确认教师的偏好在不同标志上有所不同,并表明可以通过多数投票和以KL为基础的选择,为每个标志物确定一个偏好教师。 基于这些调查结果,我们提出了多教师适应政策自我调整(MTA-OPSD),这是第一个象征性的适应性OPSD方法。 我们的方法构建了一个由候选教师组成的多教师人才库,使每一个标志都能在培训期间适应性地选择其偏好教师。 使用Qwen3模型进行数学推理任务的实验表明,MTA-OPSD一直比现有的OPSD方法表现优于基础模型,平均收益最高可达5.9美元,凸显了在象征层面调整教师监管的重要性. 该代码可在https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD上查阅.

articles.title: Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns
articles.content: This study investigates the capabilities of Large Language Models to simulate counselling clients in educational role-plays in comparison to human role-players. Initially, we recorded role-playing sessions, where novice counsellors interacted with human peers acting as clients, followed by role-plays between humans and clients simulated by Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b using 4-bit quantization. These interactions were analysed with a counselling communication pattern system at sentence level. We investigated two key questions: (1) to what extent LLM-generated responses replicate authentic conversational dynamics and (2) whether counsellors' communication behaviour differs when interacting with human versus LLM-simulated clients. The findings highlight both similarities and differences in the application of counselling patterns across scenarios, showing the potential of LLM-based role-playing exercises to enhance counselling competencies and to identify areas for further refinement in virtual client simulations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在在线咨询中比较人类角色扮演者与LLM模拟客户 培训:咨询模式分析
articles.content_zh: 本研究调查了"大语言模型"与"人类角色扮演者"相比,在教育角色扮演游戏中模拟咨询客户的能力. 最初,我们录制了角色扮演会话,由新人辅导员与作为客户的人类同龄人互动,然后由Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b用4位分量来模拟人类和客户之间的角色扮演. 通过在判刑一级采用咨询交流模式系统对这些互动进行了分析。 我们调查了两个关键问题:(1) LLM生成的回复在多大程度上复制了真实的对话动态;和(2) 咨询员的沟通行为在与人互动时与LLM模拟客户时是否有所不同. 研究结果凸显了不同情景间咨询模式应用中的相似和不同之处,显示了基于LLM的角色扮演演练在增强咨询能力和确定在虚拟客户模拟方面需要进一步改进的领域方面的潜力.

articles.title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
articles.content: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics. The Ramanujan Challenge is a benchmark comprised of research-level problems in number theory, including unpublished results and open conjectures. It presented concrete formulas for mathematical constants whose correctness can be checked numerically, while their proofs may require non-obvious mathematics. Here, we analyze the Challenge submissions, measuring the relative success of different AI models, Computer Algebra Systems (CAS), and formal tools. We find correct submissions that are conceptually distinct from the official solutions, and a proof of one of the published open conjectures. Evaluating the submissions exposed a second challenge: judging complex proofs reliably at scale. We introduce an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations that assesses semantic and logical correctness. Compared with the conventional one-shot LLM judgment, our pipeline reduces false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and improves judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%. This approach provides a methodology for evaluating research-level mathematics at scale, with potential applications across mathematics and AI for science.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 拉马努扬挑战结果:AI-Assisted评价 多格式证明管道
articles.content_zh: 随着AI的数学能力迅速提高,有意义的基准正在从大学层次的问题和数学奥林匹克转向研究层次的数学. 拉马努扬挑战(英语:Ramanujan Challenge)是一个由数论的研究层次问题所构成的基准,包括未发表的结果和开放的猜想. 它提出了数学常数的具体公式,其正确性可以通过数字来检查,而其证明可能要求非明显的数学. 在这里,我们分析挑战提交,衡量不同AI模型,计算机代数系统和正式工具的相对成功. 我们发现在概念上不同于官方解决办法的正确意见,并证明公开发表的一种推测。 评估提交材料暴露出第二个挑战:在规模上可靠地判断复杂的证据。 我们为自然语言证明、化学文摘社代码和精益正规化引入了人工辅助评估程序,评估语义和逻辑正确性。 与传统的一发LLM判断相比,我们的管道将自然语言证明的假阳性判断从23%降低到6%,并将支持代码的判断精度从46%提高到58%. 这种方法为评价研究层次的数学提供了一种规模化的方法,在数学和科学的AI中都有潜在的应用.

articles.title: On the Fundamental Limits of Prefill-Based Decoding Length Prediction
articles.content: Predicting how many tokens a large language model (LLM) will decode, using only prefill-phase hidden states, is a key primitive for inference scheduling. We show that current benchmarks conflate predictor quality with task hardness: when the target model, dataset, or sampling configuration changes, reported accuracy collapses even though the predictor is unchanged. We trace this instability to an overlooked error source---the inherent stochasticity of autoregressive decoding---and derive bounds that every prefill-side method must obey. Our analysis treats decoding as a stopped stochastic process. The per-step stopping probability of a response is not constant but ramps up over hundreds of steps, so the decode length inherits a central limit theorem from the many local decisions that determine where a response ends; this yields per-prompt normality with an explicit error term, together with an affine variance law $σ=αμ+b$ whose slope is the coefficient of variation of the number of response segments. Empirically, the normal law reproduces the per-prompt MAE and the central mass of the decode-length distribution to within a few percent, and the residual departures from normality (mild right skew, slight excess kurtosis) are the ones predicted by the sampling-noise correction. Under fixed model, data, and sampling conditions, a broad design space of predictors (MLP, EGTP, FiLM, soft-label, and Mixture-of-Experts variants) converges to similar performance close to the bound, confirming that \emph{system error dominates model error}. We argue for a benchmarking protocol that fixes the model, data, and sampling parameters and that reports relative-error metrics alongside absolute ones. Code and analysis tools are available at https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 预填解码长度的基本限度
articles.content_zh: 预测一个大语言模型(LLM)会解码多少个令牌,只使用预填相隐藏状态,是推论调度的关键原始. 我们显示,目前的基准将预测器质量与任务硬度相混合:当目标模型、数据集或采样配置发生变化时,尽管预测器没有变化,但报告的准确性崩溃。 我们追踪到这个不稳定 被忽略的错误源 - - - - 自动解码的内在的花纹 - 并得出每个预填边方法必须遵循的界限。 我们的分析将解码视为一个停止了的分解过程。 每一步停止响应的概率不是常有的,而是攀升了上百个步骤,因此解码长度继承了决定响应结束地点的许多本地决定的中限定理;这与一个明确的出错名词一起产生每瞬态的常态,加上一个相邻差异定律$σ=αμ+b$,其坡度为响应分数的变异系数. 从经验上看,正常定律复制出每瞬间MAE和解码长分布的中央质量到几分之内,与常态的剩余偏离(mild Right skew,略为过量的kurtosis)是采样-噪声校正所预测的. 在固定模型,数据和采样条件下,预测器(MLP,EGTP,FiLM,软标签,和Mixture-of-Experts等变体)的宽度设计空间会趋同到接近约束的类似性能上,确认\emph{系统错误主导了模型错误}. 我们主张制定基准协议,确定模型、数据和抽样参数,并报告相对不公的衡量标准以及绝对的衡量标准。 守则和分析工具见https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict。

articles.title: Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese
articles.content: Building a language model of one's own no longer requires a data centre. This tutorial trains one from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and shows how to tell whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. It proposes no new method. It releases a tested Python package and two notebooks in Brazilian Portuguese with autoregressive and masked diffusion generation on one network, a preregistered comparison protocol, legal tasks built from text alone with a Kneser-Ney floor and public yardsticks, reference numbers for models of 11 to 12M parameters, and a catalogue of defects that only measurement revealed. On Brazilian prose and federal laws, at minutes per run, the autoregressive mode peaks at 64 epochs over the same text and then memorises it, while masked diffusion improves up to 256. At their best points on test, the diffusion bound exceeds the autoregressive likelihood by 0.06 bits per byte, within the preregistered minimum effect. On held-out laws and on acts published after training, the model ties a 6-gram floor in likelihood on the same windows, and it loses to the floor at continuing those acts. It beats the floor at detecting tampered text, and fills cross-references more often than the floor and public models of 160M and 630M parameters, only in decrees, a genre absent from training, where those scorers stay near or below chance, and in filling the blank only when each group weighs the same, since per item it ties the 630M model. On laws, the public models, trained with about 5x10^2 to 10^5 times its compute, lead in tampered text and continuation. The blind human reading is preregistered and not part of this version.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Homebreed SLMs:为葡萄牙人在家建造的自递式和自蒙式传播语言模型
articles.content_zh: 建立自己的语言模型不再需要一个数据中心。 这种从零开始的教程,包括一个消费GPU上的标注器,并显示如何判断它是否适合一个专业领域的任务。 它没有提出新的方法。 它发布了一个经测试的Python软件包和两个巴西葡萄牙语笔记本,在一个网络上具有自相递回和蒙面扩散生成,一个预先注册的比较协议,仅用克内塞尔-内地和公用标尺就用文本构建的法律任务,11至12M参数模型的参考编号,以及只有测量才揭示的缺陷目录. 关于巴西的传教法和联邦法,每跑几分钟,自递式模式在64个纪元上在同一文本上达到顶峰,然后将其记起,而蒙面传播则改善到256个. 在其测试的最佳点上,扩散约束在预先注册的最小效果范围内,每字节超过自旋概率0.06位. 在被搁置的法律和在培训后公布的行为方面,模式将同一窗口上6克的楼层联系起来,在继续这些行为时,模式将失去。 它在探测被篡改的文字时胜过地板,并且比160M参数和630M参数的地板和公共模型更经常地填入交叉参照,只有在法令中,一个没有参加训练的流派,在这些流派中,得分者几乎或低于机会,只有在每组人体重相同时才填入空白,因为每个项目都与630M模型挂钩. 在法律方面,公共模型经过了大约5x10^2到10^5倍的计算训练,在被篡改的文字和续作中领先. 盲人读取被预先注册,而不是这个版本的一部分.

articles.title: IndicIPR-QA: A Benchmark for Extractive Question Answering on Indian IPR Laws
articles.content: Legal Question Answering (QA) over statutory texts is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially in low-resource settings with complex legal systems. It requires answers that are precise and grounded in the law. However, to the best of current knowledge, no existing extractive QA benchmark provides exact answer spans from statutory texts across all seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Acts. This paper presents IndicIPR-QA1, an extractive QA benchmark for Indian IPR laws. The proposed dataset contains 4,462 QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts across seven Acts. Questions and answers are generated using GPT-4o and validated through nine automatic quality checks, single and multi-model LLM evaluations, and a 200-pair human audit. Section-level partitioning prevents source-context overlap across the training, validation, and test sets. Further analysis examines answer span length, lexical overlap, and multi-clause structure across the corpus and individual Acts. BM25 achieves a token-level F1 score of 20.21, while fine-tuned InLegalBERT reaches 85.02 under a unified sliding-window inference protocol. The large performance gap between BM25 (20.21 F1) and InLegalBERT (85.02 F1) shows that simple word matching is not enough to answer these legal questions. Performance also varies across the seven Acts, indicating substantial differences in answer-extraction performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 指标IPR-QA:印度知识产权法采掘问题回答基准
articles.content_zh: 在自然语言处理(NLP)中,特别是在法律制度复杂的低资源环境下,法律问题回答(QA)相对于法定文本是一项具有挑战性的任务. 它需要准确和以法律为基础的答案。 然而,就目前所知,没有一项现有采掘质量保证基准从所有7个《印度知识产权法》的法规中提供准确的答案。 本文件介绍了印度知识产权法的采掘质量评估基准IndicIPR-QA1。 拟议的数据集包含4 462对来自7个法案中1 116个法定背景的质量保证。 问答使用GPT-4o生成,并通过9个自动质量检查,单模式和多模式的LLM评价,以及200平方英尺的人力审计验证. 科级分接可防止培训、验证和测试集的源文本重叠。 进一步的分析审查了答复的长度、法理上的重叠以及各项法令和个别法令的多语种结构。 BM25实现符号级的F1得分为20.21分,而微调的InLegalBERT则在统一的滑窗推断协议下达到85.02分. BM25 (20.21 F1)和InLegalBERT (85.02 F1)之间的巨大性能差距表明,简单的单词匹配不足以回答这些法律问题. 7个法案的性能也各不相同,表明答案-取出性能有很大差异。

articles.title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
articles.content: Safety alignment for Large Language Models is heavily focused on English with limited multilingual representation, particularly damaging low-resource language performance. Related open training datasets are often limited in size or do not follow region-localized harmful topics to broaden the scope of alignment beyond cultures. We propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline to produce massive multilingual refusal and benign corpora, extracting safe templates from harmful prompts, translating them and then filling in the slots with culturally authentic entities, both harmful and benign. As a result, we release MSafeTemp, a validated corpus spanning 60 languages useful for multilingual safety alignment and evaluation. Using the dataset, we show that English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety: for several models, attacks that fail in English succeed once translated, while culturally localized variants expose further failures that translation alone misses. We also confirm that augmenting safety training data through templates allows for higher diversity and quality of alignment, resulting in improved safety performance beyond English. MSafeTemp and the respective pipeline are aimed at facilitating research and development of safer and more responsible models for less-represented cultures.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 我如何调整你的模式:用模板加强多种语言的安全培训
articles.content_zh: 大语文模型的安全协调主要集中于英语,多语种代表性有限,特别是破坏低资源语言表现。 相关的开放式培训数据集往往规模有限,或者没有遵循区域本地化的有害专题,以扩大统一范围,超越文化。 我们提议一个可扩展的基于模板的增强管道,以产生大量的多语种拒绝和良性公司,从有害的提示中提取出安全模板,翻译这些模板,然后将有害和良性的文化实体填入槽中。 因此,我们发布了MSafeTemp,这是一个经过验证的涵盖60种语言的文件,可用于多语种安全协调和评估。 使用该数据集,我们显示,只有英语的评价会错误地判断多语种的安全性:对于几个模型来说,英语中失败的攻击一旦翻译成功就会成功,而文化本地化的变体则暴露出更多仅翻译缺失的失败. 我们还确认,通过模板增加安全培训数据可以提高一致性的多样性和质量,从而改进英语以外的安全性能。 MSafeTemp和相应的管道旨在促进为代表性较低的文化研究和开发更安全和更负责任的模式。

articles.title: A Low-Rank Space Captures Linear Alignment Between LLM and Human Neural Activity During Naturalistic Language Listening
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human language processing, yet it remains unclear which components of their representations drive alignment with neural activity. Here, we use ridge reduced-rank regression to identify the brain-predictive subspace of LLM representations: the representational directions that support linear prediction of neural responses. Across three naturalistic language-listening datasets spanning intracranial electrophysiology and fMRI, and six model conditions spanning autoregressive, bidirectional masked, and randomly initialized language models, we find that full linear encoding performance can be recovered using only 1-3% of the original embedding dimensionality. These low-dimensional subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, to a lesser extent, across datasets, suggesting that neural predictivity is concentrated in a compact and partially shared representational space. We next compare these brain-predictive directions with the principal axes of variation in the embeddings. Principal component analysis requires substantially more dimensions to recover neural prediction, demonstrating that the directions most useful for predicting neural activity are distinct from those capturing the most overall variance within LLM representations themselves. Finally, characterizing the learned subspaces allows us to surface interpretable features that are overrepresented in neural activity above and beyond the LLM representations. Together, these results show that LLM-brain alignment is supported by a small, structured subset of model representations and provides a framework for better understanding exactly why these representations align. Code can be found at: https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-alignment
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在自然语言听觉过程中 LLM 和人类神经活动之间的线性对接
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用作人类语言处理的计算模型,然而仍然不清楚其表达的哪个组成部分驱动与神经活性相协调. 在这里,我们利用脊下级回归来识别LLM表达的大脑预测子空间:支持神经反应线性预测的表达方向. 跨越三个自然语言学语言学语言学和fMRI的数据集, 以及六个模型条件, 跨越自旋性,双向遮掩,随机初始化的语言模型, 我们发现完全的线性编码性能 只能使用 原始嵌入维度的 1-3 。 这些低维子空间泛指被搁置的参与者,在较小的程度上指跨数据集,说明神经预测力集中在一个紧凑而部分共享的代表性空间. 我们接下来将这些大脑预测方向 与嵌入物中的主要变化轴进行对比 主要组成部分分析需要大大地增加维度来恢复神经预测,表明预测神经活性最有用的方向与记录LLM表达本身最总体差异的方向不同. 最后,对所学到的子空间进行特征分析,使我们能够在LLM表达值之上和之外神经活性中出现过多的可解释特征。 这些结果共同表明,LLM-大脑对接得到一小段结构化的模型表示的支持,并为更好地理解这些表示为何一致提供了一个框架。 代码见:https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-ignment

articles.title: Discovering Interpretable Acoustic Features in Autoregressive Voice-Cloning TTS Models
articles.content: Voice-cloning TTS models synthesize an unseen speaker's voice from brief speech prompts, but it remains unclear which acoustic properties they represent and use. We introduce a feature-based interpretability framework for autoregressive voice-cloning TTS models, analyzing features from sparse autoencoders (SAEs), PCA, and random directions via sparse probing, steering, and quantitative auto-interpretability. We focus on Qwen3-TTS and extend probing and steering to $5$ additional models to test generalization across architectures. These models encode concepts like pitch, energy, noise, and accent, but sparse prediction and steering are effective only for some concepts. Strong probing does not always translate to steering or vice-versa. SAEs are useful for sparse probing of human-labelled concepts and novel-concept discovery, while PCA is competitive for dense probing and steering. Auto-interpretability finds $684$ automatically validated SAE features in Qwen3-TTS covering speaker clusters, speaking style, and recording conditions beyond known concepts. Overall, we perform a comprehensive interpretability study of autoregressive voice-cloning TTS models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在自递式语音-克隆 TTS 模型中发现可解释的相声特性
articles.content_zh: 语音克隆 TTS模型从简短的语音提示中合成出一个看不见的扬声器的声音,但是仍然不清楚它们代表并使用的是哪个声学属性. 我们为自递式语音克隆TTS模型引入了基于特性的可解释性框架,通过稀有的自发编码器(SAEs),PCA(PPC)和随机方向分析功能,通过稀有的检测,引导和定量自发可解释. 我们侧重于Qune3-TTS,并将探测和引导扩大到5美元的额外模型,以测试整个建筑的通化. 这些模型编码了投出,能量,噪音,口音等概念,但稀有的预测和指向只对一些概念有效. 强力探测并不总是会变成方向或相反。 SAE对于人类标有标志的概念和新概念的发现的微乎其微的探索很有用,而五氯苯甲醚则对密集的探测和引导具有竞争力。 自动可解释性在Qwen3-TTS中找到684美元自动验证的SAE特性,涵盖演讲者集群,演讲风格,以及记录超出已知概念的条件. 总体而言,我们对自旋式语音克隆TTS模型进行全面可解释性研究.

articles.title: Agentic University: Collaborative Agents for Personalized Learning
articles.content: Large language models support personalized tutoring, content generation, and adaptive learning paths. However, capability development requires these resources and interactions to form a coherent learning process that evolves with the learner. A central challenge is to align goals, activities, and assessment while using learning evidence to decide what should follow. We introduce Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and instantiate it in Agentic University (AU). In AU, learners participate as organization members and work with specialized agents to maintain a revisable Capability Program. The program connects personal goals, learning activities across modalities, and layered assessment, while learner feedback and performance guide subsequent support. Our evaluation shows advantages in program organization, assessment design, and revision quality. Users achieved larger mean assessment gains (12.19 versus 5.61 points on a 50-point scale) and reported stronger cognitive support. This work contributes an organizational approach to adaptive learning that makes learner participation a continuing basis for multi-agent coordination. The Agentic University project is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/AgenticUniversity.git}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理大学:促进个性化学习的协作机构
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型支持个性化的辅导,内容生成,以及适应性的学习路径. 然而,能力发展需要这些资源和互动,以形成一个与学习者一起演变的协调一致的学习进程。 一项中心挑战是在利用学习证据决定应该遵循什么目标的同时,调整目标、活动和评估。 我们介绍人类参与的多代理组织,并在代理大学(AU)进行即时分析。 在非盟,学习者作为组织成员参与,并与专门机构合作,维持一个可修改的能力方案。 该方案将个人目标、跨模式的学习活动以及分层评估联系起来,而学习者的反馈和业绩则指导随后的支助。 我们的评价显示了方案组织、评估设计和修订质量方面的优势。 用户取得了更大的平均评估收益(50分比分比分12.19分比分5.61分)并报告了更强的认知支持. 这项工作有助于对适应性学习采取组织办法,使学习者参与成为多机构协调的持续基础。 代理大学项目可在\href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/Agentic University.git}查询。

articles.title: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
articles.content: Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: rtaste:研究人员有口味吗? 评价早期研究判决
articles.content_zh: 研究人员有品味吗? 在得知实验结果之前,判断哪些实验值得进行? 我们给出了6个前沿模型 7个最近的NLP文件。 每个模型作为研究代理人或团队单独工作,提出最小可行的实验(MVES),预测每个模型是否会通过它设定的阈值并排出它们. 然后,一个单独的执行人尝试每个MVE,包括那些排名最后的,三个模型审计员判断结果. 在415个MVE中,194个被评为有声,有价值和有新意,但其中不到一半(73个)被评为出自种子纸而非明显. 代理商的最初选择与审计师最受重视的实验比随机选择更频繁地相匹配,但并没有显示在选择先被写入的实验时有所改进. 他们的预测率高于基准率,但比仅从纸张和登记来看,同一模型的新例子的预测率要准确得多。 团队的成本更高,提案质量没有明显的全面改善。 代理人产生许多有价值的实验,但他们的排名改善选择运行的证据仍然有限. 可在https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste上查阅所有415 MVes的评价手段和数据集及其预测和审计结果。

articles.title: Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections
articles.content: Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch. While unlearning requests happen continuously during a model's lifetime, the vast majority of LLM unlearning methods are ill-suited for iterated removal, yielding steep decay in forgetting and utility upon sequential unlearning. This decay stems from interference between successive updates, as each new deletion can undo earlier ones or push the model further along directions already degraded by them. To address this, we introduce Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP), a gradient-projection scheme that restricts each update to the orthogonal complement of activation subspaces cached from prior forget sets. This approach provably guarantees first-order non-interference with earlier deletions. COP stores only a low-rank basis per layer, requiring neither past gradients nor previous forget sets, and plugs into unlearning methods that update the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss without modifying its objective. Experiments on standard LLM unlearning benchmarks (TOFU and RWKU) show that COP preserves utility across sequential requests without weakening forgetting, preventing the collapse of standard objectives and forgetting more effectively than continual-specific baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在连续LLM中保留工具 通过正弦预测不学习
articles.content_zh: 失学涉及从模型中去除培训数据敏感部分的影响,例如受保护、版权或私人文本,而不从零开始对其进行再培训。 虽然在模型存在期间不断出现不学习请求,但绝大多数LLM不学习方法不适合累赘去除,导致在相继去学时遗忘和有用性急剧衰减。 这种衰变源于相继更新之间的干扰,因为每次新删除都会使更早的版本被取消,或者将模型进一步推向它们已经退化的方向. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了连续正弦投影(COP),这是一个梯度-投影方案,它将每次更新限制在从先前的遗忘集中缓存的激活子空间的正弦补充. 这种做法可以证明是先行先行,先行后行,先行后行。 COP只存储每层的低等基数,既不需要过去的梯度,也不需要以前的被遗忘的套数,并插入不学习的方法,通过梯度步骤将模型更新到不同的损失上而无需修改其目标. 关于标准LLM的不学习基准(TOFU和RWKU)的实验表明,缔约方会议在不削弱遗忘、防止标准目标倒闭和比持续的特定基线更有效地忘记的前提下,保持了连续请求的效用。

articles.title: FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge
articles.content: Financial AI workflows that reuse investor knowledge need persistent memory that integrates observations across sources and periods without losing identity or provenance. In a knowledge graph, recurring observations may use different surface forms, fragmenting relationship histories and preventing evidence from accumulating. We introduce Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution (FIRME), a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships and retains their source, time, and context. Within periods, rule-based fusion links investor-call discussions to portfolio cash-flow signals, directly or through a fixed product-topic ontology. Across periods, canonical identities and persistent aliases direct recurring observations to the same relationship history; deterministic updates summarize reinforcement, inactivity, and reactivation. We evaluate FIRME on proprietary investor-call and cash-flow records and on S&P 500 earnings-call transcripts. Compared with a historical registry that retains canonical identities and semantic fallback but omits alias memory, FIRME increases final-period Correct Match Rate by 7.8-12.1 percentage points across four dataset-backend settings under a fixed-judge and fallback-review protocol. A blinded human audit of 200 incoming observations per setting finds Correct Match Rate gains of 9.0-16.5 points and reattachment-recall gains of 22.5-29.0 points, with higher observed merge precision in all four samples. A separate audit finds valid evidence paths for 293 of 300 outputs from full within-period fusion in the investor-call setting. Extraction-faithfulness and round-trip diagnostics assess source grounding and preservation of extractor-derived graph content.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FIRME: 登记册 -- -- 演变记忆图,异质投资者知识
articles.content_zh: 重新利用投资者知识的财务AI工作流程需要持续的内存,将各种来源和时期的观察综合起来,而不失去身份或来源。 在知识图中,反复出现的观测可能使用不同的表层形式,使关系历史分解并阻止证据积累. 我们引入了记忆进化的融合和身份登记(FIRME),这是一个登记册所选择的内存图,它将收到的观测结果与持续的犬科关系相协调,并保留其来源、时间和背景。 在一段时间内,基于规则的聚变将投资者呼吁的讨论直接或通过固定的产品专题本体将投资组合现金流量信号联系起来。 跨时期,犬科特征和持续的别名直接重复对同一关系史的观察;决定性的更新总结了加强、不活动和恢复活动。 我们根据专有投资者呼吁和现金流动记录以及S&P 500收入呼吁记录,评估FIRME。 与一个历史登记册相比,该登记册保留了犬科特征和语义倒置,但省略了别名内存,FIRME在固定判断和倒置审查协议下,将四个数据集后端设置的末期正确匹配率提高了7.8-12.1个百分点。 盲目的对每场200个输入的观测结果进行人工审计后发现,正确的匹配率收益为9.0-16.5分,重新接合-召回收益为22.5-29.0分,在所有四个样本中观测到的合并精度更高. 一项单独的审计发现,在投资人调用的情况下,300项产出中有293项产出在期内全部合并后有有效的证据途径。 采掘信仰和回程诊断评估提取出图表内容的来源地和保存情况。

articles.title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
articles.content: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 为精神病患者进行模拟语言模型培训
articles.content_zh: 在精神病学实践中,临床摄取的面谈仍然是初级诊断工具,要求临床医生建立关系,同时解开复杂,重叠的介绍. 在这里,我们表明,模拟环境中的多回合强化学习(RL)在结构化的基于文本的精神病摄入量,跨越历史记录,差异诊断,以及初步管理规划上,改善了语言模型的性能. 在随机的双盲交叉研究中(一美元=60美元相匹配的情景配对,120次相遇)将RL训练剂与其同样激发的基模进行比较,32名经董事会认证的精神病医生角色扮演标准化患者,而由15名独立,经董事会认证的精神病医生组成的单独小组则得分解识别的笔录. 受过训练的药剂在76.7%的对应假想配对(p < 0.0001美元)中超过了基本模型,在适应性临床检查(d_z=0.77美元,p < 0.0001美元)、以病人为中心的通信(82.0%对65.2%,p < 0.001美元)和诊断适当性(68.3%对33.3%,p < 0.001美元)上都有收益。 在127个心理医生验证的模拟摄入情况中,受过训练的药剂几乎是其基本模型临床分数的两倍(0.706对0.379;复合奖励0.564对0.294,0.0001美元)。 为了系统地探索对话安全,我们建立了两个关于临床安全风险和关系能力的Delphi-consensus分类系统,从中得出256个具有挑战性的对抗性陈述;我们发现,模拟环境的培训将急性安全风险的不足比例减半(12.9%对30.5%,0.0001美元)。 因此,模拟环境为培训和压力测试精神病谈话代理人提供了一个可控的测试床,其收益可转移到精神病患者的接触,尽管剩余差距需要保障措施和临床医生的监督。

articles.title: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
articles.content: Retrieval-augmented generation commonly serves separate models for reranking and answering, duplicating model residency and passage processing. We introduce Glance, which equips the generator with a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to score candidate passages from a shared prefill. Short relevance probes branch from the cached context, producing one score per passage without separately prefilling each query-passage pair. A single resident 9B backbone supports generation, general decisions and reranking, with approximately 0.1 GiB of additional memory per decision skill. After 39 minutes of MS MARCO fine-tuning, Glance achieves nDCG@10 of 0.741 on SciFact and 0.345 on NFCorpus, compared with 0.721 and 0.326 for bge-reranker-v2-m3. On 300 HotpotQA questions, its selected context improves answer F1 by 0.045 over cross-encoder-selected context under the same base generator (paired bootstrap 95% CI [0.014, 0.076]). In a scaling study, reranking quality keeps rising up to 200 candidates (43k tokens) scored from one shared prefill, where it exceeds the cross-encoder by 0.058 nDCG@10, and a probe-only activated adapter lets generation continue from the original passage cache. These initial results demonstrate generator-based reranking with one resident backbone; evaluation currently covers two retrieval datasets, one QA dataset and one backbone family.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 相片: 发电机是它自己的重排
articles.content_zh: 寻回式增强型一代通常为重新排队和回答、复制模式居住和通过处理提供单独的模式。 我们引入了Glance,它为发电机配备了轻量级的适配器和指针头来从共享预填中给候选者分分. 短相关探针从缓存上下文中分出一分,每段产生一分而无需分别预填每对查询-通过对. 一个单一的居民9B骨干支持生成,一般决定和再排位,每个决定技能的附加内存大约为0.1 GiB. 经过39分钟的MS MARCO微调后,相较于bge-reranker-v2-m3,Glance在SciFact上实现了0.741和0.345在NFCorpus上的nDCG@10. 在300个"热点QA"问题上,其所选上下文比同基生成器下跨编码器所选上下文(paired boostrap 95% CI [0.014, 0.076])改进了F1的回答. 在一项缩放研究中,再排质量不断上升,从一个共享预填中得分高达200名入选者(43克令牌),其中超过交叉编码器的0.058 nDCG@10,一个只被探测器激活的适配器让从原来的通道缓存中继续生成. 这些初步结果显示,以发电机为基础的重新排序采用一个驻地主干线;评价目前包括两个检索数据集、一个质量保证数据集和一个主干线。

articles.title: Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
articles.content: Tool-use benchmarks often score agents by final task success, but terminal outcomes can obscure whether the intermediate tool-call trajectory was executable. We propose prefix executability as a trajectory-level evaluation protocol for tool-using agents. The protocol measures whether every prefix of a predicted tool-call sequence remains executable under tool schemas, state preconditions, and data dependencies, and summarizes reliability using Prefix Executability Curves (PEC), First-Error Depth (FED), Trajectory Executability Rate (TER), horizon-normalized AUC-PEC, and Recovery Rate (RR). We instantiate the protocol on stratified samples from BFCL-v3 multi-turn and ToolSandbox, and on the complete Airline/Retail base splits of $τ^3$-bench. We observe that outcome-only and prefix-level rankings diverge: agents whose execution is conditioned on an unverified plan often achieve higher point-estimate final success than non-plan-conditioned baselines while substantially lowering TER and AUC-PEC. These divergences are precisely the failure modes that prefix executability is designed to expose: they reveal whether apparent success rests on an executable trajectory, where invalidity first enters, and whether success follows recovery from an earlier failure. As a validation intervention, explicit pre-execution plan checking can improve executable-prefix survival while maintaining competitive terminal success. These results show that final success alone is insufficient for evaluating tool-use agents and that prefix-level executability provides an actionable reliability signal for comparing agents, diagnosing failures, and assessing validation mechanisms.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 前缀可执行性:评估最终成功之外的工具使用代理
articles.content_zh: 工具使用基准往往通过最终任务的成功来评分代理商,但终端结果可能模糊中间工具调用轨迹是否可以执行。 我们建议将前缀可执行性作为工具使用剂的轨迹级评价协议. 协议衡量一个预测工具调用序列的每个前缀是否仍可在工具计划、状态先决条件和数据依赖下执行,并使用前缀可执行性曲线(PEC)、第一错误深度(FED)、轨迹可执行性率(TER)、地平线正常化的ACUC-PEC和回收率(RR)来总结可靠性。 我们在BFCL-v3多回转和TolleSandbox的分层样本上,以及在完整的Airline/Retail base分取$-3-bench的分层上,即时发布协议. 我们注意到,只注重结果和前缀等级的排名不同:其执行取决于未经核实的计划的代理人往往比非计划基准获得更高的点估计最终成功率,同时大幅降低毒性接触率和急性毒性接触率。 这些差异恰恰是前缀可执行性旨在暴露的失败模式:它们揭示了明显的成功是否取决于可执行轨迹,是否首先进入无效状态,以及成功是否是在从早先的失败中恢复之后出现的. 作为一种验证干预,明确的执行前计划检查可以改善可执行性-前缀存活,同时保持竞争性终端成功. 这些结果表明,仅靠最后的成功不足以评价工具使用剂,前缀级可执行性为比较剂,诊断出故障,评估验证机制提供了可操作的可靠性信号.

articles.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
articles.content: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 结构化教科书的数学证明
articles.content_zh: 对语言模型的数学监督一般被平整为孤立的问题解决对,抛弃了原始来源的课程组织和证据结构. 我们引入了TOME-Math(Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Information),这是一个大型的教程,将2,118本涵盖大学数学学科核心领域的教科书转换为大约380K个结构化的校正-监督记录,同时保留了章节顺序,命题防链接,依赖性参考和源出地. 利用这些结构信号,我们探索课程学习跨越多个数学科目,并用监督量和源宽来描述缩放规律. 全面调整TOME-Math,将未加权平均得分提升到我们所有被搁置的评价中,并将公共基准比基准模型高出16.7%,同时超过了所有三个总体评价的公共指导数据基线。 我们的结论强调结构化教科书既是数学监督的可扩展来源,也是研究数据组织对数学推理的影响的经验框架. 我们将公布这项文书,以便进一步研究结构化的数学监督。

articles.title: Agentic LLM reasoning in pediatric diabetes outcome prediction from multimodal medical records
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) agents are proposed for clinical prediction but are untested in pediatrics, where cohorts are small and outcomes are uncommon. Using records from 2,489 youth with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and 4,018 with type 1 diabetes (T1D), spanning structured data, note-derived social determinants and, in T1D, continuous glucose monitoring data, we predicted seven T2D outcomes, four also in T1D, at 24 months from 18 months of follow-up. CEDAR (Clinical Evidence-Driven Agent for Risk-prediction), an evidence-citing, self-auditing LLM pipeline, outperformed trained machine learning in both cohorts (pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.815 versus 0.656 to 0.700 in T2D and 0.756 versus 0.603 to 0.631 in T1D), most on the sparsely screened outcomes. Only 4 of 70,246 values it cited did not match the chart. Reading only the evidence and reasoning cited by CEDAR, two pediatric endocrinologists reached the same prediction as CEDAR in about nine of ten cases, agreeing with each other on 90.5%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从多模式医疗记录中预测儿科糖尿病结果的代理LLM推理
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)剂被提议用于临床预测,但在儿科中未经测试,其中组群很小,结果少见. 使用2,489名患有2型糖尿病(T2D)和4,018名患有1型糖尿病(T1D)的青年的记录,包括结构化数据、注释产生的社会决定因素,以及在T1D中持续的葡萄糖监测数据,我们预测了7个T2D结果,其中4个是T1D结果,从后续行动的18个月起24个月。 CEDAR(风险预测的临床证据驱动代理),一种引出证据、自我审计的LLM管道,在两个组群中都超过了训练有素的机器学习(接收器操作特征曲线下集合区为0.815,T2D为0.656至0.700;T1D为0.756至0.603至0.631),大部分是在筛选的结果上。 它提到的70 246个数值中只有4个与图表不符。 两名儿科内分泌学家只读到CEDAR引用的证据和推理,在大约10个病例中,有9个病例得出了与CEDAR相同的预测,彼此同意90.5%.

articles.title: Don't Lose the Thread: Empowering Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation
articles.content: Agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in solving complex reasoning tasks. However, LLM agents often falter on long-horizon tasks due to cognitive overload, as their working memory becomes cluttered with expanding and irrelevant information, which dilutes their attention and hinders effective planning and reasoning. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation (CORAL), a novel reasoning paradigm that empowers agents to proactively optimize their context. Implemented as an agent-callable working memory management toolset, CORAL allows an agent to checkpoint its task progress and verified facts, and adaptively initiate a new problem-solving episode by resetting cluttered context while preserving only the checkpointed information, enabling it to resume reasoning from a clean state. We further enhance the agent's checkpointing capabilities using a Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization algorithm. On the GAIA benchmark, CORAL with an 8B model achieves 42.8% average accuracy, with particularly strong gains on the most challenging long-horizon tasks (Level 2 and Level 3). Crucially, these gains come at a substantially lower inference cost: CORAL consumes 6-7$\times$ fewer input tokens than a ReAct agent. It also generalizes to multi-hop Knowledge QA benchmarks and to the considerably harder BrowseComp, where it improves a strong proprietary agent by 8.0 points.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 别丢掉线条:赋予长视线LLM特工认知资源自主定位能力.
articles.content_zh: 由大型语言模型(LLMS)提供动力的代理人在解决复杂的推理任务上表现出了显著的进步. 然而,由于认知超载,LLM代理经常在长距离任务上步履维艰,因为他们的工作记忆被不断扩展和无关的信息所缠绕,这削弱了他们的注意力并阻碍了有效的规划和推理. 为了减轻这一挑战,我们引入了认知资源自我配置(CORAL),这是一种新的推理范式,它赋予代理人主动优化背景的能力. CORAL作为可调用的工作内存管理工具集加以实施,允许一个代理检查任务进度并核实事实,并因地制宜地启动一个新的解决问题的插曲,重新设置杂乱的上下文,同时只保存检查信息,使其能够从干净状态恢复推理. 我们利用多集代理强化政策优化算法,进一步提高代理商的检查能力. 在GAIA基准上,采用8B模型的CORAL平均精度为42.8%,在最具挑战性的长视距任务(第2级和第3级)上特别大有收获. 关键是,这些收益的推论成本要低得多:CORAL的消费比ReAct代理公司少了6至7美元/时间。 它还概括到多跳"知识QA"基准和更难浏览的Comp中,将强大的专有剂提升了8.0分.

articles.title: Factorized Representations of Concurrent Temporal Variables in Pretrained Language Models
articles.content: Language models often need to maintain multiple contextual variables that evolve independently within a document. Prior work has identified structured representations of individual temporal or contextual quantities, but their joint organization remains less understood. We study this question using controlled documents with independently phased language-switch and topic-change timers. Across ten pretrained checkpoints, both timers are linearly decodable from the same hidden states. Removing a timer-associated centroid plane substantially reduces access to its associated variable while having little effect on the concurrent timer, although the planes are nonorthogonal and contain cross-timer information. Separate timer contributions also explain most reproducible variation among joint-state centroids. These signatures persist from 3 to 51 timer values and across Qwen3 checkpoints from 0.6B to 14B. Schedule position affects continuation probabilities, but the tested centroid displacement produces no consistent timer-specific output effect. Together, these results support approximate factorization based on selective accessibility and approximately additive joint-state geometry in overlapping subspaces.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 预培训语言模型中同时时间变量的因数化表示
articles.content_zh: 语言模型往往需要保持多个在文档中独立演化的上下文变量. 先前的工作确定了个别时间或背景数量的结构化表述,但对其联合组织的理解仍然较少。 我们利用具有独立相继语言开关和主题变化计时器的控制文件来研究这个问题。 在10个事先经过训练的检查站,两个计时器都线性地可以从同一个隐藏州解码。 移除一个与计时器相关联的百分位平面会大大减少对其相关变量的获取,同时对并发计时器影响不大,尽管平面是非正交的并包含跨计时器信息. 单独的计时器贡献也解释了大多数可再生异构在联合态的百分数中的差异. 这些签名在3至51个计时器值之间以及从0.6B到14B的Quen3检查站之间持续存在。 时刻表位置会影响持续概率,但被测试的百分子迁移不会产生一致的定时器特定输出效果. 这些结果共同支持了基于选择性可获取性和相重叠子空间中大约添加型联态几何的近似入计量.

articles.title: Decision and System One models in rheumatology: accuracy and calibration on specialty-training examination questions and diagnostic case vignettes
articles.content: Objectives: To evaluate the accuracy and calibration of Decision and System One models on rheumatology examination questions and diagnostic vignettes. Methods: Two benchmarks were analysed: 172 rheumatology questions from Spanish specialty-training examinations (expanded RheumaMIR dataset) in Spanish and English, and 70 English diagnostic vignettes from RheumBench with 5-18 candidate diagnoses, 52 of which included the reference diagnosis. Four System One models (Jev 1.13, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1, Laya) and GPT-6 Luna (OpenAI Decisions API) were compared with GPT-6 Sol and two local generative models. The primary outcome was accuracy; secondary outcomes included calibration, discrimination, accuracy of answers with probability >=0.90 and language differences. Results: In RheumaMIR, Jev's accuracy was 93.0% in Spanish and 91.9% in English, below GPT-6 Sol (99.4%; Holm-adjusted P<=0.005); GPT-6 Luna reached 97.7%, Clef 91.9-93.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 86.0-87.8%, without detectable language differences. Jev's answers with probability >=0.90 (76-77% of answers) were 98.5% correct. In RheumBench, accuracy was lower: GPT-6 Sol 76.9%, GPT-6 Luna 63.5%, Clef 59.6%, Jev 50.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 40.4% (each System One model below GPT-6 Sol, Holm-adjusted P<=0.045; chance 9.6%). Jev became overconfident (mean probability 0.659; over/underconfidence index +0.159), and its answers with probability >=0.90 (25% of cases) were 84.6% correct, against 95.5% for GPT-6 Luna (42%). Laya performed near chance in both benchmarks. Conclusion: The best-performing System One models were highly accurate on examination questions but less accurate on diagnostic vignettes, remaining below GPT-6 Sol. Jev's high-confidence predictions were less reliable on vignettes, highlighting the need for task-specific evaluation and calibration.
