articles.title_zh: 决定和制度 风湿学的一个模型:专门训练检查问题的准确性和校准性以及诊断性病例的花样
articles.content_zh: 目标: 评价关于风湿病检查问题和诊断阴道的决定和系统一模型的准确性和校正性。 方法: 分析了两个基准:172个来自西班牙语和英语的西班牙专业训练考试的风湿病学问题(扩展了RheumaMIR数据集),70个来自Rheum Bench的英语诊断阴道有5至18个候选诊断,其中52个包括参考诊断. 四系统 1个模型(Jev 1.13, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1, Laya)和GPT-6 Luna(OpenAI Scions API)被与GPT-6 Sol和两个本地基因模型相提并论. 主要结果是准确性;次级结果包括校准、歧视、回答的准确性(概率为0.90)和语言差异。 结果: 在"RheumaMIR"中,Jev的精度在西班牙语中为93.0%,在英语中为91.9%,低于GPT-6 Sol(99.4%;Holm调整后为P<=0.05;GPT-6 Luna达到97.7%,Clef91.9-93.0%和Microsoft-Decision-1 86.0-87.8%,没有可察觉的语言差异. Jev的回答概率为~0.90(76-77%的回答),正确率为98.5%. 在Rheum Bench中,准确度较低:GPT-6 Sol 76.9%,GPT-6 Luna 63.5%,Clef 59.6%,Jev 50.0%和微软-决定-1 40.4%(每个系统) GPT-6 Sol以下的一个型号,Holm调整后P<=0.045;概率为9.6%. Jev变得过度自信(平均概率为0.659;过度/不信任指数+0.159),其概率为0.90的答案(25%的病例)为84.6%正确,而GPT-6 Luna为95.5%(42%). 在这两项基准中,Laya都表现了近乎偶然。 结论: 业绩最好的系统 一个模型在检查问题上非常准确,但在诊断阴道上不太准确,仍然低于GPT-6 Sol. Jev的高度自信预测在vignettes上不那么可靠,凸显出需要针对具体任务的评估和校正.

articles.title: Leveraging Recourse and Size Bounds for OnlineKnapsack with Removable Items
articles.content: In the online unweighted knapsack problem, items arrive sequentially and must be accepted or rejected immediately for a bounded-capacity knapsack, aiming to maximize the total size of accepted items. When decisions are irrevocable, no algorithm achieves a non-trivial competitive ratio. An essential relaxation that circumvents this impossibility is to allow previously accepted items to be removed from the knapsack (a.k.a. removal). In this work, we investigate possible further improvements on the competitive ratio with removal by bringing together two other previously proposed model extensions: knowledge of an upper bound on the item sizes (a.k.a. bound awareness) and ability to reinsert previously rejected items(a.k.a.recourse). Our contributions are twofold. First, we establish close upper and lower bounds on the competitive ratio under bound awareness, removal and recourse. We show that significant improvements on the best known competitive ratio are possible when the upper bound on the item sizes is not too restrictive and only few uses of recourse are available. Second, we introduce the notion of adaptive online algorithms which do not require to know any upper bound on the item sizes but still achieve performance guarantees comparable to the ones obtained under the bound awareness model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用可移动项目在线获取和大小约束
articles.content_zh: 在在线无加权背包问题中,物品按顺序运出,必须立即接受或拒绝装入有限度容量的背包,目的是尽量扩大被接受物品的总尺寸。 当决定不可撤销时,没有算法实现非三角竞争比率. 避免这种不可能发生的一种基本放松是允许将原先接受的物品从背包取出(a.k.a.去除)。 在这项工作中,我们通过将先前提议的另外两个模型扩展合并起来,调查是否可能进一步改进与去除有关的竞争比率:对物品大小的上限(a.k.a. 约束意识)的了解和重新插入先前拒绝的物品(a.k.a.reference)的能力。 我们的贡献是双重的。 首先,我们在约束意识、消除和追索权下对竞争比率设定了上下界限。 我们显示,如果物品尺寸的上限不至于太严格,而且只有很少的追索办法,那么已知的竞争比率就有可能得到显著改善。 第二,我们提出适应性在线算法的概念,这种算法不需要知道物品大小的上限,但仍实现与在约束性认识模型下获得的性能保证。

articles.title: Latent Path Exploration via Potential-Guided Subtrajectory Balance
articles.content: Continuous latent reasoning enables language models to perform intermediate computation without generating explicit reasoning traces. Advances in stochastic latent reasoning allow multiple paths to be sampled in continuous space, but stochasticity alone does not ensure effective exploration. A key challenge is guiding stochastic transitions between intermediate latent states toward useful reasoning paths. We introduce SubLAT, which couples a relative answer potential with Subtrajectory Balance to learn stochastic latent exploration. The relative potential evaluates the answer support of sampled states against replacement states, with a correctness signal at the terminal state. Subtrajectory Balance relates potential differences to forward and backward transition densities across subtrajectories of different lengths. The model is jointly trained with answer supervision, CoT supervision, and representation distillation. Experiments on arithmetic and deductive reasoning show increasing solution coverage with larger sampling budgets across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, as well as improvements on several structural OOD benchmarks. Trajectory analyses reveal progressive divergence among sampled latent paths and higher mean relative potentials for correct trajectories across arithmetic benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过潜在引导的子导出平衡进行慢路探索
articles.content_zh: 持续的潜入推理使语言模型能够进行中间计算而不会产生明显的推理痕迹. 在有花样的潜入推理上的进步使得多条路径可以在连续的空间中被采样,但光有花样性并不能保证有效的探索. 一项关键挑战是指导中间潜在国家之间的分层过渡,走向有用的推理道路。 我们引入了SubLAT, 它将一个相对的回答潜力 与Subtrajectory 平衡,学习有花样的潜在探索。 相对潜力评价被采样状态相对于替换状态的答案支持,在终端状态下有正确性信号. 亚射线平衡与不同长度的子射线的上向和后向过渡密度有关的潜在差异。 该模型与回答监督、CoT监督以及代表分馏共同培训。 关于算术和推算推理的实验表明,溶液的覆盖面正在扩大,在域内和域外基准的抽样预算增加,一些结构上的OD基准也有所改善。 轨迹分析显示,抽样潜入路径之间逐渐相去甚远,跨算术基准正确轨迹的相对潜力较高。

articles.title: Neighborhood Elites: Quality-Diversity Search for Uncertainty Quantification in Question Answering
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable, yet they produce wrong answers indistinguishable from correct ones. In question answering (QA), such an error propagates unnoticed into downstream tasks. Perturbation-based uncertainty quantification (UQ) addresses this by probing a model over a set of input rewrites and reading uncertainty from how much its predictions vary. Yet this set is usually built generically, by free paraphrasing, token-level perturbation, or adversarial search. Such rewrites leave two things uncontrolled that matter in QA: what kind of change is made to the context, and how explicitly the context supports the answer. When neither is controlled, the composition of the set is determined by the generator rather than by design, and the estimate inherits whatever that generator happens to produce. Quality-diversity (QD) search is built to cover a predefined exploration space, so we recast input perturbation as a QD problem and propose \emph{neighborhood elites (NE)}, a neighborhood constructor that spreads answer-preserving rewrites across two axes, the kind of edit and the explicitness of support. We compare NE against three other neighborhood constructors, holding the editor, QA model, uncertainty measure and search objective fixed, and against three scores read from the original context. Across five extractive-QA datasets and five instruction-tuned LLMs, NE improves failure detection against every other constructor in at least 24 of the 25 dataset-model pairs, reaching 0.726 AUROC and 0.211 AUPRC lift over the base rate. Additionally, NE detects failure better than semantic entropy computed over decoder samples, by 0.074 AUROC and 0.062 AUPRC lift, and this advantage widens as the neighborhood grows.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 邻接精英:在问答中寻找不确定的量化质量-多样性
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)的能力越来越强,然而它们却产生错误的答案,与正确的答案无法区分. 在回答问题时,这种错误在下游任务中传播。 基于扰动的不确定性量化(UQ)通过在一组输入重写上测试一个模型并读取其预测差异有多大的不确定性来解决这个问题. 然而,这一集通常通过自由抛写、象征性扰动或对抗性搜索来通用地构建。 这种改写留下了两件事,在质评中是无关紧要的:对上下文做了什么样的改变,以及上下文如何明确支持答案. 当两者均不受控制时,集合的构成由生成者决定,而不是由设计,无论生成者碰巧产生什么,估计都会继承. 质量-多样性(QD)搜索是用来覆盖一个预先定义的探索空间的,因此我们把输入扰动重新设定为一个QD问题,并提议\emph{邻里精英 (NE)},一个邻里建筑师,将保存的答案重写在两个轴上,编辑的类型和支持的清晰性. 我们比较NE和另外三个邻里构造者, 持有编辑器,QA模型,不确定度量和搜索目标固定, 在5个采掘-QA数据集和5个经指导调整的LLMs中,NE在25个数据集模型对中至少24个改进了对每个其他构件的故障检测,达到0.726 AUROC和0.211 AUPRC的升力超过基准率。 此外,NE通过0.074 AUROC和0.062 AUPRC升降机检测出比从解码器样本中计算出的语义通量更好的故障,而这一优势随着邻近地区的扩大而扩大。

articles.title: When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
articles.content: To succeed in real-world long-horizon software development, coding agents must satisfy multi-dimensional task specifications, such as interface compatibility and error handling, and do so without breaking existing dependencies. However, current works lack specification in both quantity and diversity, often emphasizing primary goals while ignoring complex constraints. Synthesizing tasks to bridge this gap presents two challenges: naively adding specifications risks reducing tasks to trivial checklists rather than compelling joint reasoning, and verifying these subtle interactions risks overlooking hidden flaws or rejecting valid alternatives. To address these challenges, we introduce CodeSpecWeave, a framework for synthesizing tasks with rich, interdependent specifications. Grounded in real developer seeds, a synthesis agent iteratively develops both coupled task requirements and executable tests, while a review agent audits solution trajectories from multiple models to guarantee test reliability. Using this pipeline, we construct 4,670 training tasks across 2,865 repositories. Applying Reinforcement learning on these tasks significantly improves performance over the base model on DeepSWE-v1.1, largely outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, we curate CodeSpecWeave-Bench, a rigorous benchmark comprising 100 tasks and 1,044 specifications, which clearly separates frontier models and reveals significant headroom in handling interdependent engineering constraints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当要求交互:通过独立规格放大长视距编码
articles.content_zh: 要在现实世界长视距软件开发中取得成功,编码代理必须满足多维任务规范,如接口相容和出错处理等,并在不突破现有依赖的情况下完成. 然而,目前的工作在数量和多样性方面都缺乏具体的规定,往往强调首要目标而忽视复杂的制约因素。 综合各项任务来弥补这一差距带来了两个挑战:天真地增加规格有可能将各项任务降低到无关紧要的清单中,而不是强制进行联合推理;核查这些微妙的相互作用有可能忽略隐藏的缺陷或拒绝有效的替代办法。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了CodeSpecWeave,这是一个以丰富而相互依存的规格来综合任务的框架. 以真正的开发者种子为依托,合成剂迭代地发展了结合的任务要求和可执行测试,而审查剂则从多模型中审核解决方案轨迹以保证测试可靠性. 利用这一管道,我们在2 865个储存库中建造了4 670个培训任务。 运用对这些任务的强化学习,大大改善了DeepSWE-v1.1上的基础模型的性能,在很大程度上超过了现有基线。 此外,我们研究了密码SpecWeave-Bench,这是一个由100项任务和1 044个规格组成的严格基准,它明确区分了前沿模型,并揭示了在处理相互依存的工程制约因素方面的重要头室。

articles.title: Judged in Company: In-Context Batching Makes LLM Verdicts Depend on Other Items
articles.content: To save cost, practitioners often ask a language model to grade many independent items in one prompt. This assumes that verdicts are separable: that the verdict on an item does not depend on the other items in the prompt or on its position among them. Across three judgement tasks (harm in social-media comments, short-answer grading and review star ratings) and five open-weight models with 4-9B parameters, assigning the same 2,000 items to different random batches of 25 changes 11-22% of decisions on harm and grading, 6.5-13.3 points more than renaming the item keys or rewording the instruction, while AUROC against human labels differs from single-item grading only by -0.033 to +0.010; for four models with 14-32B parameters, 6-15% of decisions change, 4.2-9.1 points more. We show that flip rates decompose exactly into components of order, slot and membership, and that under a threshold model they grow with the square root of the variance that the context contributes, so that effects that are small for scores are large for decisions. Most of the latent dissimilarity between partitions comes from the order of the neighbours and the slot. The main effect of which items share the prompt, the part that voting over permutations of a batch cannot remove, accounts for 0.11-0.22 of it, and majority votes over nine permutations still leave 52-60% of the flips. Batched verdicts also differ systematically from single-item verdicts: even the majority of fifteen random batches disagrees with them on 8.4-17.8% of decisions. Editing a single generation shows that both the model's own earlier verdicts and the neighbours' texts carry the effect. On the easy task, star ratings, only 2.9-3.9% of decisions change. We recommend grading ambiguous items one per prompt, recovering most of the cost with a cached prefix, and reporting agreement with single-item grading whenever items are batched.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 公司评委:内文Batching制作LLM 取决于其他项目的判决
articles.content_zh: 为了节省成本,从业者经常要求一个语言模型对许多独立项目进行一个快分. 这假定判决是可分开的:对某一物品的判决不取决于即时的其他物品或其在其中的立场。 在三项判断任务(危害社会媒体评论,短答分级和审查星等评分)和5个有4-9B参数的开放量级模型中,将相同的2000个项目分配给不同随机批量的25个变化中11-22%的伤害和分级决定,6.5-13.3分比重命名项目键或重写指令多出一分,而AUROC针对人类标签的单项分级只有-0.033分到+0.010分;对于4个具有14-32B参数的模型,6-15%的决定变更分多出4.2-9.1分. 我们显示翻转率完全分解成顺序,档次和会籍的成分,在一个阈值模型下,它们随着上下文所促成的差异的平方根而增长,因此对于分数来说较小的影响对于决策来说是很大的. 分区之间的潜在差异大多出自相邻者的顺序和槽. 其主要作用是分享快取,对一批的地表进行投票的部分不能去除,占了其中的0.11-0.22,超过9个地表的多数选票仍然留有52-60%的翻转. 批判判决也与单项判决有系统差异:即使是15个随机批判的多数对8.4%至17.8%的判决都不同意. 单代编辑显示,模型自身的更早判决和相邻的文本都带有效果. 在简单的任务上,明星收视率,只有2.9%至3.9%的决定有变化. 我们建议把模棱两可的项目逐一分级,用缓存前缀收回大部分费用,并在每批项目时报告单项分级协议。

articles.title: ScienceJudge: Pattern Perturbation Augmentation for Sentence-Level Scientific Claim Verification
articles.content: Sentence-level scientific claim verification determines whether each sentence in an AI-generated scientific paragraph is supported by a given multimodal evidence bundle. Fine-grained reporting errors often preserve fluent and plausible statements while introducing subtle evidence-claim deviations, making them difficult to detect under sparse and imbalanced supervision. We propose Pattern Perturbation Augmentation (PPA), which models reporting errors as label-specific faithfulness breaking transformations and induces reusable error patterns from labeled examples. PPA applies these patterns to supported claims to construct controlled hard negatives and expands their coverage through pattern-level, operation-level, and cross-domain augmentation. Based on these augmented views, we develop ScienceJudge, which integrates PPA-trained vision-language predictors and instruction-guided LLM predictors through class-weighted ensemble inference. On the local development set, ScienceJudge improves the average score from 0.8124 to 0.8692, achieving a Macro-F1 of 0.8466 and a Paragraph Exact Match score of 0.8919. Our submitted system ranks first on the official NLPCC 2026 Task 10 Track 1 leaderboard with a final score of 0.6890.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 科学法官:加重判刑模式 -- -- 一级科学索赔核查
articles.content_zh: 判决一级的科学索赔核查决定AI生成的科学段落中的每个句子是否得到特定多式联运证据捆绑的支持. 细微的报告错误往往保留流利和可信的陈述,同时采用微妙的证据-索赔偏差,使其难以在稀少和不平衡的监督下被发现。 我们提出模式扰动增强(PPA),该模式将错误报告为特定标签的忠诚性打破了变换并诱发从被标注的例子中可重复使用的错误模式. PPA将这些模式应用于支持的索赔,以构建受控制的硬底,并通过图案级,操作级和跨域增强来扩大其覆盖范围. 基于这些扩大的意见,我们发展了科学法官,通过阶级加权综艺推论,将PPA训练有素的视觉语言预测器和教学制导的LLM预测器结合起来. 在本地开发集上,科学评委将平均分从0.8124分提高到了0.8692分,实现了0.8466分的宏-F1分和0.8919分的段落精确匹配分. 我们提交的系统在正式的NLPCC 2026 Tesk 10 Track 1领跑板上排名第一,最终得分为0.6890.

articles.title: Mobilizing the Archive: Bitext Extraction at Scale from Archival Documents for Extremely Low-resource Languages
articles.content: While mining parallel sentences from web pages has proven effective for low-resource machine translation, the majority of the world's languages have little to no web presence. What they do have, though, are resources that are the result of centuries of efforts by linguists, such as grammars, dictionaries, and other documentation materials. We propose extracting translation examples from such linguistic resources, which offer parallel data for languages under-represented online and could potentially scale to thousands more languages. We develop a pipeline to achieve this, leveraging an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model as well as a vision language model (VLM), to ensure identified content to be aligned with visual layout information. We demonstrate the utility of the extracted bitexts for bootstrapping translation systems across 20 languages, both by training machine translation models and by applying in-context learning for large language models. For in-context learning, we observe improvements of +15.78 and +6.94 chrF2++ over zero-shot translation for into low- and high-resource languages, respectively.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 动员归档:从极低资源语言档案文件中按比例提取文本
articles.content_zh: 虽然从网页中挖掘平行的句子已证明对低资源机器翻译是有效的,但世界上大多数语言几乎没有网络存在。 然而,他们所拥有的资源是语言学家几个世纪努力的结果,例如语法、词典和其他文献材料。 我们建议从这些语言资源中提取翻译实例,为在线代表不足的语文提供平行数据,并有可能扩大到数千种其他语文。 我们利用光学字符识别模型和视觉语言模型(VLM),开发了实现这一目的的管道,以确保所确定的内容与视觉布局信息保持一致。 我们通过培训机器翻译模型和通过应用大语言模型的内文学习,来证明提取的比特exts对于20种语言的脚印翻译系统的效用。 对于内文学习,我们观测到+15.78和+6.94 chrF2++的改进,分别比零镜头翻译为低资源语言和高资源语言.

articles.title: EpiAgent: Epistemic Self-Play for LLM Agents
articles.content: Epistemic game theory explains an agent's strategic behavior via the beliefs it holds about others and how these beliefs are updated as the interactions unfold. Modern LLM-based agents, however, often lack an explicit mechanism for learning and updating such beliefs to guide decisions under incomplete information. To bridge this gap, we propose EpiAgent, a framework that equips LLM-based agents with an explicit, learnable epistemic layer, which maintains beliefs over others' private information and combines these beliefs with the agent's available information into an epistemic state for action selection. Concretely, the agent's policy is decomposed into two coupled stages: Epistemic Update, which updates these beliefs from interaction histories, and Action Planning, which selects actions conditioned on the updated epistemic state. By formulating their dependency as a bi-level optimization problem, we introduce Epistemic Self-Play, an algorithm that alternately optimizes the two stages through self-play, utilizing an intrinsic prediction reward to evaluate how well inferred beliefs predict subsequent observations. Empirical results across both mixed and competitive scenarios show that EpiAgent consistently outperforms prompting-based and RL-based baselines. Further analyses reveal the benefits of dedicated epistemic training, improvements in belief inference accuracy, and the contribution of learned beliefs to action planning. These results demonstrate the value of an explicit, learnable epistemic layer for effective multi-agent interactions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EpiAgent: LLM 代理的 Epistemic 自玩
articles.content_zh: Epistemic游戏理论通过它持有的对他人的信念来解释一个代理人的战略行为,以及这些信念如何随着相互作用的发展而更新. 然而,基于LLM的现代代理人往往缺乏学习和更新这种信念的明确机制来指导在不完整信息下作出的决定。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出EpiAgent,这个框架使基于LLM的代理人拥有一个明确,可学习的感知层,这个层保持了对他人私人信息的信仰,并将这些信仰与代理人现有的信息结合起来,形成一个感知状态,以便选择行动. 具体来说,代理的政策被分解成两个并联的阶段:Epistemic Update,从互动历史中更新这些信念;Action Planning,选择以更新的感知状态为条件的行动. 通过把他们的依赖性表述为双层优化问题,我们引入了Epistemic Self-Play,这个算法通过自玩来交替优化两个阶段,利用内在的预测奖励来评价如何很好地推断出信仰预测后续的观测结果. 各种混合和竞争性假设的实证结果表明,EpiAgent的业绩一贯高于基于RL的基线。 进一步的分析揭示了专门进行流行病学培训的好处、信仰推论准确性的提高以及学到的信仰对行动规划的贡献。 这些结果表明,一个明确、可学习的认知层对于有效的多剂相互作用具有价值。

articles.title: Towards Full-Text Scholarly Argument Mining using Entity-Anchored Claim Extraction
articles.content: Argument mining in full-text scholarly articles remains an important yet challenging task. This difficulty stems not only from the need to model long-distance dependencies but also from the substantial effort required to annotate sentence-level argumentative components throughout lengthy documents. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel approach that leverages scientific entity mentions (e.g., tasks, datasets, and models) to identify and structure claims in scholarly literature. We validate our approach through a case study involving 50 full-text research papers on sentiment analysis. We first establish a reliable human gold standard (Krippendorff's $α= 0.80$), identifying 113 claim-bearing sentences and extracting 199 structured claim records from 300 candidate sentences. To address the annotation bottleneck, we employ a majority-voting ensemble of large language models (LLMs) to generate a silver-standard dataset comprising 1,487 claims. Encoders fine-tuned exclusively on the silver-standard dataset outperform those trained on a small human-annotated gold-standard dataset and demonstrate strong zero-shot transfer to NLP papers outside the training corpus.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 利用实体 -- -- 附带索赔提取法进行全文本学者论证采矿
articles.content_zh: 全文学术文章的论证仍然是一项重要而艰巨的任务。 这一困难不仅是因为需要模拟长途依赖关系,而且还因为需要作出大量努力,在整个冗长的文件中对句子层面的论证部分进行注释。 为了应对这些挑战,我们采用了一种新的方法,利用科学实体提及(例如,任务、数据集和模型)的机会,查明学术文献中的说法并加以结构。 我们通过一个案例研究验证我们的方法,其中涉及50份关于情绪分析的全文研究论文。 我们首先确定了可靠的人类金本位(Krippendorff的0.80美元),确定了113个含索赔的判决,并从300个候选判决中提取了199个结构化的索赔记录。 为了解决注释瓶颈问题,我们使用多数投票的大型语言模型(LLMS),生成包含1 487项索赔的银标准数据集。 完全根据银-标准数据集对编码器进行微调,超过了在小型人类附加说明的金-标准数据集上受训的编码器,并显示在培训大纲之外向NLP文件进行了有力的零发转接。

articles.title: It Takes Two to Probe, Thousands to Retrieve: Putting Vision--Language Probes to the Retrieval Test
articles.content: Vision--language models (VLMs) are tested for fine-grained understanding with image--text matching probes, a model must prefer the correct image or caption over handcrafted negative. In retrieval, the correct item must beat thousands of alternatives. We measure how these two evaluation methods relate by using two probing benchmarks, \svo{} and SugarCrepe, for retrieval tasks. For 100 image and caption queries we judge the top-10 retrievals from full dataset of six VLMs, with human annotators and an LLM assessor. We than compare how well models rank pool of items on the same queries, while changing only where the negatives comes from: the benchmark, a random draw, or the judged-incorrect retrievals of other models. On \svo{} the accuracy of retrieving a positive over handcrafted negatives is significantly higher than for retrieved ones (the correct item is preferred in 85\% against 77\% of the time). Using pool of ten retrieved negatives leads to same accuracy as when one uses pool of 200 to 430 random negatives. On SugarCrepe the order is reversed: its handcrafted negatives are harder than the retrieved ones. Incomplete relevance labels explain most of the low retrieval scores on \svo{}, where the top-ranked item is correct for 54--90\% of the queries under human labels against 6--21\% under the benchmark's labels. However, we detect no association between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first. The LLM assessor o3 agrees with individual annotators ($κ$ 0.57--0.61) slightly less than they agree with each other (0.64--0.68).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 它需要2到探测,数千到检索: 将视觉-语言探测器放到检索测试中
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)通过图像-文字匹配探测器进行精细的理解测试,一个模型必须选择正确的图像或标题而不是手动的负. 在取回时,正确的物品必须战胜上千种替代品. 我们通过使用两个测试基准,\svo{}和SugarCrepe来衡量这两种评估方法之间的关系。 对于100个图像和字幕查询,我们从6个VLM的完整数据集中判断出10个最高检索率,并配有人类注释员和一个LLM评估员. 我们比比较模型在相同的查询上排列项目库的级别好得多,而只改变负数的来源:基准、随机抽取或其他模型的判断不正确检索。 在\svo{}上,取出正反手动底片的准确性明显高于取回底片的准确性(正确的项目在85\%对时间的77\%). 使用10个检索到的底片池,与使用200至430个随机底片池一样准确。 在SugarCrepe上,订单被反转:其手动底片比取回的底片更难. 不完整的关联性标签解释了\svoQQ上大多数低检索分数,其中排行榜上的项目在人类标签下54-90QQ对基准标签下6-21QQ的查询是正确的. 然而,我们发现,通过探测器进行查询与首先取回正确物品之间没有任何关联。 LLM评估员o3同意个别注释员(0.57-0.61美元)的意见,略低于他们彼此之间的一致意见(0.64-0.68)。

articles.title: Upcycling Language Models for Multiple Specialized Domains
articles.content: Effective multi-domain adaptation of large language models requires prioritizing relevant domain knowledge while minimizing interference from irrelevant domains. Existing approaches commonly use Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to train a separate adapter for each domain and combine these adapters within one model. However, they either weight adapters equally regardless of the input domain or dynamically weight adapters while still activating all of them including irrelevant ones. Additionally, while efficient, their low-rank structure limits performance. In contrast, upcycling is a model expansion method that adds experts and a router to a dense Transformer layer offering larger capacity than LoRA approaches. In this paper, we propose Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling) for multi-domain adaptation. We introduce a new domain-aware supervision that allows the router to effectively learn to distinguish domains by selecting the appropriate experts. During fine-tuning on each new domain, we update only the corresponding expert and router while freezing all other parameters. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest average performance across the adapted domains compared to baselines while retaining general performance. With just 256 examples per domain for router supervision, DS-Upcycling achieves 90-98% routing accuracy after adaptation compared with 43-70% for routers trained without our approach.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多专业域的回旋语言模型
articles.content_zh: 对大语言模型进行有效的多域调整,需要优先安排相关域名知识,同时尽量减少来自无关域的干扰. 现有方法通常使用Low-Rank适应(LORA)为每个域培训一个单独的适配器,并将这些适配器结合在一个模型中. 然而,无论输入领域如何,它们要么是加权适配器,要么是动态加权适配器,同时仍然激活所有适配器,包括不相关的适配器。 此外,虽然效率很高,但其低级结构限制了业绩。 相形之下,回升是一种模型扩展方法,它将专家和路由器添加到密集的变形器层上,提供比LORA方法更大的容量. 在本文中,我们提议进行多领域改造的域外特制循环(DS-Upcycling). 我们引入了一种新的域意识监督,使路由器能够通过选择合适的专家来有效学习区分域. 在对每一个新域进行微调时,我们只更新相应的专家和路由器,同时冻结所有其他参数. 实验显示,我们的方法在保持总体性能的同时,在经过调整的领域实现了与基线相比最高的平均性能. 由于每个域只有256个路由器监督的例子,DS-Upcycling在适应后实现了90-98%的路由精度,相比之下,43-70%的路由器在没有我们的方法下受训.

articles.title: One Vector or Many? Clustered Optimal-Transport Steering under Quantization
articles.content:
Activation steering changes what a language model generates by editing its hidden states at inference time. Its most common form adds one vector, the difference of class means (DiM), to every hidden state. CHaRS (concept heterogeneity-aware representation steering) uses optimal transport instead: an entropic plan pairs the clusters of the two classes, and each hidden state moves along a mixture of the cluster displacements, weighted toward its nearest clusters. We study this family of clustered optimal-transport maps for toxicity mitigation in Gemma-2-2B and Granite-3.1-2B, and ask what the plan adds to DiM and whether that survives INT8 and NF4 quantization.
  We prove an identity: whatever the plan, the displacements averaged with the cluster sizes as weights equal DiM, so a clustered map can differ from DiM only for tokens whose routing weights depart from the cluster sizes. In the CHaRS protocol they stay close, and CHaRS is statistically equivalent to Mean-AcT, which adds DiM at every layer, in all eight pre-specified equivalence tests. A variant fitted on individual tokens, which routes each token mainly to its nearest clusters, leaves 37-39% less toxicity than DiM on Gemma and 51-61% less on Granite at steering strength 3 (toxic-bert), where DiM already removes 76-85% of it. Two other toxicity classifiers confirm the gain on Granite, but on Gemma only one does. At equal strength the variant has somewhat higher perplexity, but at matched toxicity it is slightly more fluent than DiM. Yet a nearly constant map from the same clusters also leaves about 30% less toxicity, so the role of treating tokens differently remains open.
  Under INT8 and NF4 the variant still leaves less toxicity than DiM, and transferring it from full precision to the NF4 model instead of refitting it adds no significant toxicity after correction for multiple tests.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个矢量还是很多? 量化下分组优化运输指导
articles.content_zh:
活化向导通过在推断时间编辑其隐藏状态来改变语言模型生成的东西. 其最常见的形式在每个隐藏状态中都增加了一个向量,阶级手段的区别(DIM). CHaRS(概念异质感-知觉代表引导)则使用最佳的迁移方式:一个演化计划将两个类的集群相配,每个隐藏状态会沿着一组群位相位移的混合体移动,向最近的集群加权. 我们研究了Gemma-2-2B和Granite-3.1-2B的一组集成的最佳运输图,以缓解毒性,并询问这个计划给Dim增加了什么,以及它是否在INT8和NF4的量化中存活下来。
我们证明了一种身份:无论计划如何,迁移均以集群大小为权重等同Dim来计算,因此一个集群地图只能与Dim区别于其路由权重与集群大小相去的符号. 在CHaRS协议中,它们保持相近,而CHaRS在统计学上相当于Mean-AcT,它在每个层都添加了DIM,在所有8个预先指定的等同测试中. 单个标志上安装的变体,每个标志主要通向最近的集群,在Gemma岛上的毒性比Dim要低37-39%,在Granite岛上的毒性为51-61%,在转向力3(毒伯特)下,Dim已经去除了其中的76-85%. 另外两个毒性分类器证实了Granite上的收益,但Gemma上只有一个。 在等效强度下,该变体具有比较高的迷惑性,但在相匹配的毒性下,其流利度略高于DIM. 然而,一个来自同一组的近乎恒定的地图也留下了大约30%的毒性,因此不同处理活物的作用仍然未变.
在INT8和NF4下,该变体的毒性仍然低于DIM,并将它从完全精度转移到NF4模型上,而不是在经过多次试验修正后进行再调整,不会增加显著毒性。

articles.title: Rethinking Pre-pretraining
articles.content: We report that allocating compute to synthetic pre-pretraining (PPT) never outperforms pure natural-language training in our compute-matched experiments. This holds across four PPT curricula (k-Dyck, neural cellular automata (NCA), declarative reference corpora, and code) and three training regimes: data-constrained, data-unconstrained, and a high token-to-parameter-ratio regime (881M parameters trained on 50B tokens). When natural language is scarce, repeated epochs over a 100M-token corpus beat every synthetic curriculum on natural-language validation loss, with no consistent downstream accuracy advantage from PPT. We find that PPT gains reported in prior work are sensitive to the weight initialization scheme. In an NCA reproduction, we recover a 5.4% perplexity improvement from PPT under the original initialization scheme. An alternative scheme improves both methods, but the no-PPT baseline more, closing the gap between them. However, when PPT receives additional compute rather than a share of the natural-language budget, gains persist at small natural-language budgets even with improved initialization, but disappear by 1B tokens. Finally, models forget what they learn during PPT in subsequent natural-language training; interleaving the same data throughout training prevents forgetting, but does not significantly improve natural-language performance. Our results suggest limited benefits of synthetic pre-pretraining as a distinct training stage and motivate rethinking how such data are used in language model training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重新思考预科培训
articles.content_zh: 我们报告说,分配计算到合成预训(PPT)中,在我们计算匹配的实验中,绝对不会超过纯自然语言训练. 这涉及四个PPT课程(k-Dyck,神经细胞自发性(NCA),声明性参考物和代码)和三个培训制度:数据约束,数据不约束,以及一个高标码到参数比例制度(581M参数在50B符上培训). 当自然语言稀缺时,100M-token活体上反复出现的时代会用自然语言验证损失来打败每一个合成课程,而PPT在下游没有一致的准确性优势. 我们发现,先前工作中报告的PPT增益对权重初始化计划很敏感. 在一次NCAA复制中,我们根据最初的初始化计划从PPT中恢复了5.4%的复杂度改善. 一种替代方案改进了这两种方法,但增加了不使用PPT的基线,缩小了两者之间的差距。 然而,当PPT收到额外的计算而不是自然语言预算的份额时,即使初始化改善,在小型自然语言预算上仍会持续得到收益,但被1B符所消失. 最后,模型在之后的自然语言培训中忘记了在PPT期间学到的东西;在整个培训中将同样的数据相互连接,防止了遗忘,但并没有显著地提高自然语言的性能. 我们的结果表明,合成预科培训作为一个独特的培训阶段的效益有限,并激励人们重新考虑这些数据如何用于语言模式培训。

articles.title: AI Cosmos: An Agentic Infra for Situated Learning
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) can improve task performance during learning, yet these gains do not necessarily reflect learners' ability to thereafter apply the knowledge and skills independently. We present AI Cosmos, an agentic infrastructure for situated learning that organizes learning around two complementary principles: scenario-based participation and cumulative assets of practice. AI Cosmos organizes learners and role-specialized agents within learning scenarios that integrate task-relevant knowledge and, when needed, executable workbenches. An asset-memory loop preserves the processes and outcomes of practice as reusable assets with explicit provenance and dependencies. We evaluate scenario-based interaction through two preregistered randomized controlled studies examining the acquisition of legal reasoning and programming competence, holding the same underlying LLM across conditions. AI Cosmos achieves greater learning gains than a conventional LLM in legal reasoning and higher mastery of unseen programming problems than an LLM-as-Teacher baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AI Cosmos: 定位学习代理
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)在学习期间可以改进任务性能,但这些成绩并不一定反映学习者此后独立应用知识和技能的能力. 我们介绍AI Cosmos是定位学习的代理基础设施,它围绕两个互补原则组织学习:基于情景的参与和累积的实践资产。 AI Cosmos在学习情景中组织学习者和角色专门人员,这些情景融合了与任务相关的知识,并在需要时结合了可执行的工作本位. 资产-模拟循环保留了作为可重复使用的资产的流程和结果,具有明确的出处和依赖性。 我们通过两项预先登记的随机控制研究来评价基于情景的相互作用,这些研究审查法律推理和编程能力的获得情况,在各种条件下维持同样的LLM。 AI Cosmos在法律推理方面比常规LLM获得更大的学习收益,并且比LLM-as-Teacher基线更能掌握看不见的编程问题.

articles.title: Can LLMs Ignore What They Know? Measuring Knowledge Leakage in Persona-Based User Simulation
articles.content: When persona-conditioned responses are read as respondent-level simulations, each response should reflect the described persona's knowledge, and the respondent written to know nothing must act as if the model's knowledge were not there. We test whether it can, and find persistent favourable-item real-twin rating separation under the tested low-knowledge and explicit-ignorance prompts. We define the resulting problem (knowledge leakage: a response bias that arises when knowledge the real user could not have enters the simulated response) and present a methodology for measuring it quantitatively. The core instrument pairs real items with fabricated twins matched in surface form: screened fabricated variants designed to minimize prior item-specific knowledge. The paired difference therefore provides a diagnostic contrast for knowledge leakage even in rating tasks where no answer is correct. In a rating experiment across three knowledge-handling arms and five API endpoints from two model families, we find, first, that the personas we test do not fully suppress real-item existence and familiarity signals: a favourable-item real-twin rating contrast remains under an explicit in-context statement that the persona has never heard of the item. Second, the unfavourable-item contrast reverses sign across domain groups: pooling all unfavourable-content items across domains the contrast sits near zero (+0.077 [-0.057, +0.204]), yet the same estimator in the same conditions returns -0.359 where the rating scale asks about an item's documented hazard and +0.438 where it asks about a company or an organisation. A pooled analysis of unfavourable-content items against zero therefore does not detect the opposing domain-group differences. All estimates are conditional on the adequacy of twin construction and screening; human low-knowledge baselines remain necessary for population-level interpretation.

articles.title_zh: LLMS能忽略他们所知道的吗? 衡量基于人的知识泄漏
articles.content_zh: 当人有条件的答复被读作应答级模拟时,每一份答复应反映被描述的人a的知识,而被写到什么也不知道的应答者必须像模型的知识不存在一样行事. 我们测试它是否能够,并找到在经过测试的低知识度和显性分级激励下持续的有利项目实赢评级。 我们界定了由此产生的问题(知识泄漏:当真正的用户不可能进入模拟反应时产生的反应偏差),并提出了定量衡量的方法。 核心仪器将真品与以表面形式配对的被制成的双胞胎配对:经过筛选的被制成的变体,旨在将先前的具体项目知识降到最低. 因此,对等差异为知识泄漏提供了一个诊断对比,即使在没有正确答案的评级任务中也是如此。 在对三个知识处理臂和两个模范家庭的五个API端点进行评级实验时,我们发现,首先,我们测试的人并没有完全压制真品的存在和熟悉信号:一个有利的项目真品评分对比仍然是在人物从未听说过这个项目的明确内文说明下. 第二,不利项目对比反向横跨域组的标志:将所有不利内容项目横跨域组,对比度接近于零(+0.077 [-0.057,+0.204]),但同一条件下的同一估计值返回-0.359,评级等级表询问某物品的有据危险,+0.438询问某公司或某组织。 因此,对照零对不利内容项目进行集合分析不能发现相反的域组差异。 所有估计都以双重构筑和筛选的充分性为条件;人的低知识基线仍然是人口一级解释所必需的。

articles.title: Prompts and probabilities in the linguistic assessment of language models: Evidence from semantic focus-sensitivity
articles.content: As language models (LMs) have improved, an increasingly common means of evaluating their linguistic competence is through explicit prompting (e.g., "Which sentence is more acceptable?"). Prior work indicates that such prompting underperforms compared to standard token-probability-based methods in smaller models, but improves in larger models. We test this in a new domain: semantic focus-sensitivity, responsible for contrasts like "Lucy only SWAM yesterday" vs. "Lucy only swam YESTERDAY". Testing models of various sizes using text-based focus markers like boldface and italics, we find universal above-chance performance for token probabilities. Prompting results mostly align with previous findings, but in some larger models they outperform probabilities by a wide margin. We propose that this is because LMs are not prone to produce out-of-the-blue focus marking, which muddies results from token probabilities in a way that does not affect prompting. We test this by replacing standard focus markers with randomly generated ones; token probabilities still beat chance but show significantly greater performance decrease compared to prompting. These results suggest that metalinguistic prompting, while non-trivial for LMs, can also be more robust when testing stylistically atypical data. We argue that this has important consequences for the assessment of LMs' language competence, even if LMs do not perform metalinguistic judgments through human-like introspection.

articles.title_zh: 语言模型语言评估的提示和概率: 语义重点敏感性的证据
articles.content_zh: 随着语言模型(LMs)的改进,评价其语言能力的一种越来越常见的方法就是通过明确的提示(如"哪个句子更能被接受?"). 先前的工作表明,在较小的模型中,与标准符号概率方法相比,这种诱发性表现不佳,但在较大的模型中则有所改善。 我们在一个新的领域测试:语义聚焦敏感,负责对比,如"Lucy only SWAM昨日"和"Lucy只游YSTERDAY". 使用粗体和斜体等基于文字的焦点标记来测试各种大小的模型,我们发现通用的上行性能以表示概率. 迅速的结果大多与以前的调查结果一致,但在某些较大的模型中,结果比概率大得多。 我们提议,这是因为LMs不易产生蓝外焦点标记,而泥土是象征性概率造成的,不会影响提示。 我们通过用随机生成的标准焦点标记来测试这一点;象征概率仍然比机会好,但显示与提示相比,性能显著地下降。 这些结果表明,金属活性催化在LMs的非三角作用下,在测试有型式的非典型数据时,也可更强。 我们争辩说,这对评估LMs的语言能力有重要影响,即使LMs不通过人性的内向分析来进行金属化判断。

articles.title: Tokenizer Tokens Tell Training Tales
articles.content: Tokenizers are usually treated as fixed preprocessing tools, but they are trained on text and can retain traces of that text in their vocabularies. We ask whether a BPE tokenizer can reveal if a candidate dataset was part of its training corpus. The key observation is simple. Rare strings become tokens only when enough corpus frequency pushes them over the merge threshold. This suggests that membership signal should appear in rare tokens used by the candidate dataset, rather than in the order in which merges were made. We formalize this under a threshold model of BPE inclusion, showing that the likelihood-ratio test assigns its largest weights to tokens that are rare in the background but frequent in the candidate dataset. The same model suggests that merge rank and merge-graph position should not add a first-order membership signal once token existence and dataset frequency are known. We instantiate this view as RTAM-Fusion, which calibrates rare-token mass with shadow tokenizers and combines signals across rarity levels. On the tokenizer membership benchmark, RTAM-Fusion improves AUC and balanced accuracy over Vocabulary Overlap while using fewer shadow tokenizers. Existing defenses also continue to leak membership signal against adaptive attackers at production vocabulary sizes. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RTAM-Fusion-F7EE/

articles.title_zh: Tokenizer Tokens 告诉培训故事
articles.content_zh: 托肯化器通常被作为固定的预处理工具处理,但他们接受过文字训练,可以在词汇中保留该文字的痕迹. 我们问一个BPE的标注器是否能够显示一个候选数据集是否是其培训内容的一部分。 关键观察很简单。 稀有的字符串只有在足够多的命题频率把它们推出合并阈值时才会成为符号. 这表明会籍信号应该出现在候选数据集使用的稀有符文中,而不是按照合并的顺序. 我们通过列入BPE的阈值模型正式确定这一点,表明概率-比率测试将最大权重分配给背景中罕见但经常出现在候选数据集中的标志. 同一模式建议,一旦知道有符号存在和数据集频率,合并等级和合并图位置不应增加一阶会籍信号. 我们即刻将这种观点作为RTAM-Fusion,它用阴影活化剂校正了稀有的托肯质量并结合了跨稀有水平的信号. 在象征性成员基准上,RTAM-Fusion改进了AUC和比词汇重叠更平衡的准确性,同时使用较少的阴影标记器. 现有的防御也继续在生产词汇大小上泄露针对适应性攻击者的会籍信号. 代码:https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RTAM-Fusion-F7EE/ (中文(简体) ).

articles.title: Attention, Dynamic Wave and Hybrid Sequence Mixers in Language Models
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on Multi-Head Attention (MHA) for sequence modeling, but scaling to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of attention, motivating sub-quadratic recurrent alternatives. This paper formalizes a Dynamic Wave recurrent layer, based on input-dependent exponential damping and cosine phase modulation, and evaluates three 10.94M-parameter configurations (Pure Transformer, Pure Wave, and Hybrid Wave-Attention) on TinyStories under perplexity, latency, throughput and peak VRAM profiling up to 4096 tokens. The Hybrid configuration reaches the best perplexity, 5.95 on the full held-out split against 6.93 for the Transformer and 7.26 for Pure Wave. The efficiency picture, however, is governed by implementation rather than by architecture. Against an unfused attention baseline, Pure Wave uses 78.7% less peak VRAM at a 4096-token context (1404.3 MB vs. 6601.6 MB); against a fused scaled-dot-product attention kernel the same comparison yields no advantage at all (1404.3 MB vs. 1403.6 MB), and in training mode Pure Wave is 8.3% more expensive than the Transformer. Likewise, hoisting elementwise terms out of the recurrence loop speeds the layer up 2.53-fold with no custom kernel, reducing its latency gap to attention from 2.48-fold to 1.12-fold. A hybrid stack is found to inherit the cost of its more expensive mixer rather than the advantage of its cheaper one, its peak VRAM matching the Pure Transformer to within 0.1%. A closed-form memory model reproduces these measurements and predicts the context length beyond which attention overtakes the vocabulary projection. The findings indicate that reported efficiency gains for recurrent attention replacements must be stated relative to a named attention backend and a named implementation, and that hybridization is best justified on quality grounds.

articles.title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

articles.title_zh: 车牌 传播语言模型缓存量
articles.content_zh: KV缓存量子化为自递回式语言模型被很好地研究了,其中缓存前缀状态在因果注意之下准确,量子化主要是缓存重建问题. 传播语言模型(dLLMs)打破了这个假设. 快速 dLLM 推想再利用 KV 状态跨越去诺化步骤,但双向符号表示可以随着被遮住的符号被揭示而改变,因此再利用的缓存在被分解之前可能已经不同于完全重解. 在此缓存再使用错误下, 我们研究 KV 缓存分解 。 我们改造了KIVI和KVQuant,以适应快活DLLM风格的前缀和双缓存再利用,并引入TRACE和dLLLM-KVQ. TRACE重建了可行的dLLLM从即时答对中揭示出轨迹,提供了匹配迭代口罩解码的校正状态. dLLM-KVQ使用这些轨迹来选择每层K-cache的条目,这些条目根据输出和注意力级的行为度量,保持高精度,同时应用了标准的低位值量化. 对GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH和MBPP的全LLADA和Dream评价,dLLM-KVQ在报告的4位和2位前缀/二位缓存设置中,在四分法中取得了最高的平均得分。

articles.title: Surprise Alone Learns Lies: Evidence-Gated Continual Learning for LLMs from Streaming Claims
articles.content: Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable. This rule is unsafe when the stream contains lies. A planted falsehood about something the model knows has low probability under the model's belief, so it is highly surprising by construction, and a surprise-driven learner absorbs nearly every such lie, at a rate similar to random selection with the same budget. We study the problem with LoRA-adapted students (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B) that learn from a stream of true and false claims about invented people and real CounterFact facts. We report four findings. (1) A verifier key, a judge that must approve each claim, removes lies to the extent that its verifier is accurate; real LLM judges are cautious and reject unsourced truths and even source-backed updates. (2) Calibrated regression tests on unrelated knowledge slow learning down without filtering out lies. (3) The original model's own prior flags claims that contradict what it knows, without a judge. It separates lies about known facts from true new facts (AUC 0.78-0.83 across three models) but not from legitimate updates of the same kind of fact (AUC 0.53). It saves 43% of judge calls, but an attacker with access to the model can choose lies that pass it. (4) If trusted sources exist that an attacker cannot plant, routing contradicted claims to evidence recovers legitimate updates and the combined system has the lowest poison rate among learned claims; when an attacker plants matching sources for 30% of the lies, the system ends up worse than the judge alone. The acceptance signals answer different questions, and none of them decides on its own whether a claim is true.

articles.title_zh: 《惊喜独自学习谎言:流出索赔中的法学硕士继续学习》
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型的不断学习方法越来越多地以出乎意料的方式决定学习什么,使模型发现其投入最不可预测。 当溪流包含谎言时,这个规则是不安全的. 在模型的信念下,一个关于模型所知道事物的被埋设的假说概率很低,因此通过构建这个假说非常出人意料,一个出乎意料的学习者吸收了几乎所有这样的假说,其速率类似于预算相同的随机选择. 我们研究了LORA适应的学生(Quen2.5-1.5B,Quen2.5-3B和Llama-3.2-3B)的问题,他们从一流的关于发明人和真实反事实的真假说法中学习. 我们报告四项调查结果。 (1)核查员的密钥,即必须批准每项主张的法官,去除其核查员准确的谎言;真正的LLM法官是谨慎的,拒绝无来源的真理甚至来源支持的更新. (2)对无关知识的校正回归测试在不过滤谎言的情况下缓慢地学习. (3)原型自有的前旗声称与所知道的相矛盾,没有法官. 它把关于已知事实的谎言和真实的新事实(AUC 0.78-0.83跨出三种模式)分开来,但并不与对同一种事实的合法更新(AUC 0.53)分开来. 它能省下43%的裁判电话,但是一个能够访问模型的攻击者可以选择通过它的谎言. (4)如果存在可信赖的源来证明攻击者不能植入,则线条与证据的声称相矛盾,恢复了合法更新,而综合系统在所学的声称中毒性最低;当攻击者植入的源来匹配30%的谎言时,系统最终会比法官本身更糟糕. 接受信号回答了不同的问题,其中没有一个能自行决定一个要求是否属实.
